ex.en: a facile victory
ex.cn: 唾手可得的胜利

senses.def: to make an action or a process possible or easier

ex.en: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
ex.cn: 新贸易协定应当会加快经济发展。

ex.en: Structured teaching facilitates learning.
ex.cn: 有条理的教导有利于学习。

senses.def: a person who helps sb do sth more easily by discussing problems, giving advice, etc. rather than telling them what to do

ex.en: The teacher acts as a facilitator of learning.
ex.cn: 教师是学习的引导者。

senses.def: a thing that helps a process take place
buildings, services, equipment, etc. that are provided for a particular purpose

ex.en: sports/leisure facilities
ex.cn: 体育／休闲设施

ex.en: conference facilities
ex.cn: 会议设施

ex.en: shopping/banking/cooking facilities
ex.cn: 商店／银行设施；炊事设备

ex.en: The hotel has special facilities for welcoming disabled people.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆有专供残疾人使用的设施。

ex.en: All rooms have private facilities (= a private bathroom).
ex.cn: 每一个房间都有独立的浴室。

senses.def: a special feature of a machine, service, etc. that makes it possible to do sth extra
senses.chn: （机器等的）特别装置；（服务等的）特色

ex.en: a bank account with an overdraft facility
ex.cn: 提供透支服务的银行账户

ex.en: a facility for checking spelling
ex.cn: 检查拼写的设备

senses.def: a place, usually including buildings, used for a particular purpose or activity

ex.en: the world's largest nuclear waste facility
ex.cn: 世界最大的核废料处理场

ex.en: a new health care facility
ex.cn: 新保健中心

senses.def: a natural ability to learn or do sth easily

ex.en: She has a facility for languages.
ex.cn: 她有语言天赋。

senses.def: a layer of brick, stone, etc. that covers the surface of a wall to make it look more attractive
a layer of stiff material sewn around the inside of the neck, armholes, etc. of a piece of clothing to make them stronger
senses.chn: 领口衬里，袖口贴边，镶边（使衣服耐穿）

senses.def: the collar, cuffs, etc. of a piece of clothing that are made in a different colour or material
senses.chn: （不同质地或颜色的）领子（或袖口等）

senses.def: an exact copy of sth

ex.en: a facsimile edition
ex.cn: 摹本版

ex.en: a manuscript reproduced in facsimile
ex.cn: 精确复制的手稿

senses.def: used to refer to a particular situation that exists

ex.en: I could no longer ignore the fact that he was deeply unhappy.
ex.cn: 我再不能对他深感不快这个事实不闻不问了。

ex.en: Despite the fact that she was wearing a seat belt, she was thrown sharply forward.
ex.cn: 尽管她系了安全带，还是被猛然前抛。

ex.en: Due to the fact that they did not read English, the prisoners were unaware of what they were signing.
ex.cn: 这些囚犯由于看不懂英语，不知道自己在签什么。

ex.en: She was happy apart from the fact that she could not return home.
ex.cn: 除了不能回家之外，她很快活。

ex.en: Voluntary work was particularly important in view of the fact that women were often forced to give up paid work on marriage.
ex.cn: 鉴于妇女一结婚就常常被迫放弃有报酬工作的事实，义务工作尤其重要。

ex.en: How do you account for the fact that unemployment is still rising?
ex.cn: 你如何解释失业人数仍在增加这个现实？

senses.def: a thing that is known to be true, especially when it can be proved

ex.en: Isn't it a fact that the firm is losing money?
ex.cn: 公司正在亏本，这难道不是事实吗？

ex.en: I haven't spoken to anyone in English for days and that's a fact.
ex.cn: 我有好多天没和任何人说英语了，事实就是这样。

ex.en: I know for a fact (= I am certain) that she's involved in something illegal.
ex.cn: 我肯定她卷入了非法活动。

ex.en: The judge instructed both lawyers to stick to the facts of the case.
ex.cn: 法官责令双方律师要紧扣案情。

ex.en: First, some basic facts about healthy eating!
ex.cn: 首先，说说健康饮食的几点基本事实！

ex.en: The report is based on hard facts (= information that can be proved to be true).
ex.cn: 这个报告是以铁的事实为根据的。

senses.def: things that are true rather than things that have been invented

ex.en: The story is based on fact.
ex.cn: 这个故事是根据真人真事写的。

ex.en: It's important to distinguish fact from fiction.
ex.cn: 区别真实和虚构是重要的。

senses.def: after sth has happened or been done, when it is too late to prevent it or change it

ex.en: On some vital decisions employees were only informed after the fact.
ex.cn: 有一些重大决策雇员只在事后才获悉。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement, especially one that is the opposite of what has just been mentioned
senses.chn: （用以强调，尤其与刚提到的相反）事实上是，实际情况是

ex.en: A new car would be wonderful but the fact of the matter is that we can't afford one.
ex.cn: 有新车好是好，不过实际情况是我们买不起。

senses.def: a situation that cannot be changed, especially one that is unpleasant
accurate and detailed information
senses.chn: 准确的信息；精确的资料；确实的情报

ex.en: I've asked to see all the facts and figures before I make a decision.
ex.cn: 我已要求在看到所有的确切信息后再作决定。

senses.def: the details about sex and about how babies are born, especially as told to children
it is not necessary to give any further explanation about sth because the information that is available already proves that it is true
used to give extra details about sth that has just been mentioned

ex.en: I used to live in France; in fact, not far from where you're going.
ex.cn: 我曾在法国住过；确切地说，离你要去的地方不远。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement, especially one that is the opposite of what has just been mentioned
senses.chn: （用以强调，尤其与刚提到的相反）事实上，实际上

ex.en: I thought the work would be difficult. In actual fact, it's very easy.
ex.cn: 我原以为这工作会很难，事实上却很容易。

senses.def: used to reply to a statement that you find interesting or surprising, or that you do not believe
senses.chn: （回答认为有趣、惊奇或不相信的说法）是真的吗

ex.en: 'She says I'm one of the best students she's ever taught.' 'Is that a fact?'
ex.cn: “她说我是她教过的最好的学生之一。” “真的是这样吗？”

senses.def: used to add a comment on sth that you have just said, usually adding sth that you think the other person will be interested in

ex.en: It's a nice place. We've stayed there ourselves, as a matter of fact.
ex.cn: 那个地方不错。事实上，我们在那儿待过。

senses.def: used to disagree with sth that sb has just said

ex.en: 'I suppose you'll be leaving soon, then?' 'No, as a matter of fact I'll be staying for another two years.'
ex.cn: “我想你快要离开了吧？” “不。事实上，我还要再待两年呢。”

senses.def: used to say what is true in a situation

ex.en: In point of fact, she is their adopted daughter.
ex.cn: 实际上，她是他们的养女。

senses.def: done in order to find out information about a country, an organization, a situation, etc.

ex.en: a fact-finding mission/visit
ex.cn: 实情调查团；查访

senses.def: a small group of people within a larger one whose members have some different aims and beliefs to those of the larger group
senses.chn: （大团体中的）派系，派别，小集团

ex.en: rival factions within the administration
ex.cn: 政府中的对立派别

senses.def: opposition, disagreement, etc. that exists between small groups of people within an organization or political party

ex.en: a party divided by faction and intrigue
ex.cn: 因派系和阴谋诡计搞得四分五裂的政党

senses.def: films/movies, books, etc. that combine fact with fiction (= imaginary events)
senses.chn: 纪实与虚构相结合的电影（或书等）

senses.def: connected with the factions of an organization or political party

ex.en: factional conflict
ex.cn: 派系冲突

senses.def: not genuine but created deliberately and made to appear to be true

followed by a direct object and a complement . Factitive verbs describe a situation where there is a result to the action. In 'I painted it red' and 'they made her captain', 'painted' and 'made' are factitive.
senses.chn: 使役的（指后接宾语和补足语的，如 I painted it red 和 they made her captain 中，painted 和 made 是使役动词）

senses.def: something that is widely accepted as a fact, although it is probably not true
senses.chn: 仿真陈述（很可能不真实但使人信以为真）

senses.def: a small piece of interesting information, especially about sth that is not very important
senses.chn: 有趣消息（尤指有关不太重要事情的）

ex.en: Here's a pop factoid for you.
ex.cn: 告诉你一个广为流传的趣闻。

senses.def: one of several things that cause or influence sth

ex.en: economic factors
ex.cn: 经济因素

ex.en: The closure of the mine was the single most important factor in the town's decline.
ex.cn: 矿山的关闭是这个镇衰落的唯一重要的因素。

ex.en: the key/crucial/deciding factor
ex.cn: 关键的／至关重要的／决定性的因素

ex.en: Childhood obesity can cause / lead to long-term health problems.
ex.cn: 儿童肥胖可能导致长期的健康问题。

ex.en: Changes in lifestyle and diet over the last twenty years have caused / led to / resulted in a sharp increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 过去二十年生活方式及饮食的变化导致肥胖儿童数量急剧上升。

ex.en: Several factors, including changes in diet and lifestyle, have contributed to the increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 包括饮食及生活方式变化在内的多个因素促使肥胖儿童数量增加。

senses.def: a number that divides into another number exactly

ex.en: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12 are the factors of 12.

senses.def: the amount by which sth increases or decreases

ex.en: The real wage of the average worker has increased by a factor of over ten in the last 70 years.
ex.cn: 近 70 年来工人的实际工资平均增长超过了十倍。

senses.def: a particular level on a scale of measurement

ex.en: a suntan lotion with a protection factor of 10
ex.cn: 防护系数为 10 的防晒油

ex.en: The wind-chill factor will make it seem colder.
ex.cn: 风寒系数大，会使人觉得比实际温度更冷一些。

senses.def: a substance in the blood that helps the clotting process. There are several types of this substance.

ex.en: Haemophiliacs have no factor 8 in their blood.
ex.cn: 血友病患者的血液中缺乏凝血因子 VIII。

senses.def: (used especially in newspapers, etc.) the feeling of confidence in the future that is shared by many people
senses.chn: （尤用于报章等）前景美好的氛围

senses.def: to include a particular fact or situation when you are thinking about or planning sth

ex.en: Remember to factor in staffing costs when you are planning the project.
ex.cn: 规划该项目时，记住要把雇人费用这个因素考虑进去。

senses.def: the result when you multiply a whole number by all the numbers below it
to express a number in terms of its factors
senses.chn: 因数分解；因式分解；将…分解成因子

senses.def: to include a particular fact or situation when you are thinking about or planning sth

ex.en: Remember to factor in staffing costs when you are planning the project.
ex.cn: 规划该项目时，记住要把雇人费用这个因素考虑进去。

senses.def: a substance in the blood that helps it to clot (= become thick)
senses.chn: 因子 VIII；凝血因子 VIII

senses.def: a building or group of buildings where goods are made

ex.en: a car factory
ex.cn: 汽车制造厂

ex.en: factory workers
ex.cn: 工厂工人

ex.en: a chocolate/cigarette/clothing factory
ex.cn: 巧克力厂；香烟厂；制衣厂

ex.en: a nuclear power plant
ex.cn: 核电厂

ex.en: a manufacturing plant
ex.cn: 制造厂

ex.en: a cotton/paper/textile/woollen mill
ex.cn: 棉纺厂；造纸厂；纺织厂；毛纺厂

senses.def: a type of farm in which animals are kept inside in small spaces and are fed special food so that a large amount of meat, milk, etc. is produced as quickly and cheaply as possible
the part of a factory where the goods are actually produced

ex.en: Jobs are at risk, not just on the factory floor (= among the workers, rather than the managers) but throughout the business.
ex.cn: 职位不保，不仅对车间工人如此，而且危及整个行业。

senses.def: a large ship used for catching fish, that has equipment for cleaning and freezing the fish on board
senses.chn: 捕鱼加工船（有加工冰冻设备）

senses.def: a shop/store in which goods are sold directly by the company that produces them at a cheaper price than normal
senses.chn: 厂家直销店；工厂直营店

senses.def: a person employed to do a wide variety of jobs for sb
accurate and detailed information
senses.chn: 准确的信息；精确的资料；确实的情报

ex.en: I've asked to see all the facts and figures before I make a decision.
ex.cn: 我已要求在看到所有的确切信息后再作决定。

senses.def: a piece of paper or an electronic document giving information about a subject, especially (in Britain) one discussed on a radio or television programme
senses.chn: （尤指英国广播或电视节目中有关讨论题目的）资料页，资料电子文件

senses.def: based on or containing facts
senses.chn: 根据事实的；事实的；真实的

ex.en: a factual account of events
ex.cn: 事件的如实报道

ex.en: factual information
ex.cn: 事实信息

ex.en: The essay contains a number of factual errors.
ex.cn: 文章中有一些与事实不符的错误。

senses.def: any of the physical or mental abilities that a person is born with

ex.en: the faculty of sight
ex.cn: 视觉

ex.en: She retained her mental faculties (= the ability to think and understand) until the day she died.
ex.cn: 她直到去世那天一直保持着思维和理解能力。

ex.en: to be in full possession of your faculties (= be able to speak, hear, see, understand, etc.)
ex.cn: 拥有一切官能（能够说、听、看见、理解等）

senses.def: a particular ability for doing sth

ex.en: the faculty of understanding complex issues
ex.cn: 理解复杂问题的能力

ex.en: He had a faculty for seeing his own mistakes.
ex.cn: 他具有看到自己错误的能力。

senses.def: a department or group of related departments in a college or university

ex.en: the Faculty of Law
ex.cn: 法学院

ex.en: the Arts Faculty
ex.cn: 文学院

senses.def: all the teachers in a faculty of a college or university
senses.chn: （高等院校中院、系的）全体教师

ex.en: the Law School faculty
ex.cn: 法学院全体教师

ex.en: a faculty meeting
ex.cn: 全体教师会议

ex.en: faculty members
ex.cn: 全系教师

senses.def: all the teachers of a particular university or college

ex.en: faculty members
ex.cn: 全系教师

senses.def: something that people are interested in for only a short period of time
senses.chn: 一时的风尚；短暂的狂热

ex.en: the latest/current fad
ex.cn: 最新／当前的时尚

ex.en: a fad for physical fitness
ex.cn: 一阵健身狂热

ex.en: Rap music proved to be more than just a passing fad.
ex.cn: 事实证明，说唱音乐并不是昙花一现。

senses.def: liking some things and not others, especially food, in a way that other people think is unreasonable
senses.chn: 口味不寻常的；（尤指）挑食的，偏食的

ex.en: a faddy eater
ex.cn: 过分挑食的人

senses.def: to become or to make sth become paler or less bright

ex.en: The curtains had faded in the sun.
ex.cn: 窗帘已经给晒退了色。

ex.en: All colour had faded from the sky.
ex.cn: 天上的颜色都退去了。

ex.en: The sun had faded the curtains.
ex.cn: 太阳把窗帘晒退了色。

ex.en: He was wearing faded blue jeans.
ex.cn: 他穿着退色的蓝牛仔裤。

senses.def: to disappear gradually

ex.en: Her smile faded.
ex.cn: 她的笑容逐渐消失。

ex.en: Hopes of reaching an agreement seem to be fading away.
ex.cn: 达成协议的希望看来已逐渐渺茫。

ex.en: The laughter faded away.
ex.cn: 笑声逐渐消逝。

ex.en: His voice faded to a whisper (= gradually became quieter).
ex.cn: 他的声音越来越小，变成了耳语。

ex.en: All other issues fade into insignificance compared with the struggle for survival.
ex.cn: 与挣扎求存相比，所有其他问题都显得不重要了。

senses.def: if a sports player, team, actor, etc. fades, they stop playing or performing as well as they did before
senses.chn: （运动员、运动队、演员等）走下坡路，衰退，衰落

ex.en: Black faded on the final bend.
ex.cn: 布莱克在最后一个弯道处速度慢了下来。

senses.def: to behave in a way that does not attract any attention; to disappear or hide
senses.chn: 默默无闻；销声匿迹；蛰伏

senses.def: to become very weak or ill/sick and die

ex.en: In the last weeks of her life she simply faded away.
ex.cn: 她在生命的最后几个星期已是草枯灯油尽了。

senses.def: to become clearer or louder/less clear or quieter
senses.chn: （画面）淡入／淡出，渐显／渐隐；（声音）渐强／渐弱

ex.en: George saw the monitor black out and then a few words faded in.
ex.cn: 乔治看见屏幕变暗，接着出现了几个字。

senses.def: to make a picture or a sound clearer or louder/less clear or quieter
senses.chn: 使（画面）淡入／淡出；使渐显／渐隐；使（声音）渐强／渐弱

ex.en: Fade out the music at the end of the scene.
ex.cn: 在这个场景的末尾把音乐减弱。

senses.def: to become very weak or ill/sick and die

ex.en: In the last weeks of her life she simply faded away.
ex.cn: 她在生命的最后几个星期已是草枯灯油尽了。

senses.def: the process of making a sound or an image gradually appear; an occasion when this happens
the process of making a sound or an image gradually disappear; an occasion when this happens
a piece of equipment used to make sounds or images gradually appear or disappear
senses.chn: 音量控制器；光量控制器

senses.def: solid waste material that leaves the body through the anus
to spend time doing things in a way that is not well organized and that does not achieve much

ex.en: Stop faffing about and get on with it!
ex.cn: 别瞎摆弄了，干正事！

senses.def: a lot of activity that is not well organized and that may cause problems or be annoying

ex.en: There was the usual faff of finding somewhere to park the car.
ex.cn: 找地方停车照例又是一番忙乱。

senses.def: an offensive word for a male homosexual
something that is boring and tiring to do

ex.en: It's too much of a fag to go out.
ex.cn: 外出活动真叫人吃不消。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a boy at a public school who has to do jobs for an older boy
senses.chn: （尤指旧时）公学中受高年级男生使唤的低年级男生

senses.def: the last part of a cigarette that is left after it has been smoked
the last part of sth, especially when it is less important or interesting
senses.chn: （尤指不重要或索然无味的）结尾，末尾

ex.en: I only caught the fag end of their conversation.
ex.cn: 我仅听到他们谈话的结尾。

senses.def: very tired
used to say that you are too tired or bored to do sth
a ball of finely chopped meat mixed with bread, baked or fried and eaten hot
a bunch of sticks tied together, used for burning on a fire
a woman who likes to spend time with homosexual men
senses.chn: 喜欢与男同性恋者交往的女性

senses.def: the fourth note of a major scale
an illegal game in which you risk money on a particular number being chosen
senses.chn: 推筒子，押宝（一种对所选点数押钱赌博的游戏）

senses.def: of or using a scale of temperature in which water freezes at 32° and boils at 212°
senses.chn: 华氏温度计的，华氏的（冰点为 32 度，沸点为 212 度）

ex.en: fifty degrees Fahrenheit
ex.cn: 五十华氏度

senses.def: to not be successful in achieving sth

ex.en: Many diets fail because they are boring.
ex.cn: 许多规定饮食因单调乏味都不奏效。

ex.en: a failing school
ex.cn: 一所失败的学校

ex.en: I failed in my attempt to persuade her.
ex.cn: 我未能说服她。

ex.en: She failed to get into art college.
ex.cn: 她未能进入艺术学院。

ex.en: The song can't fail to be a hit (= definitely will be a hit).
ex.cn: 这首歌不可能不流行起来。

senses.def: to not do sth

ex.en: He failed to keep the appointment.
ex.cn: 他未履约。

ex.en: She never fails to email every week.
ex.cn: 每周她必定发电子邮件。

ex.en: I fail to see (= I don't understand) why you won't even give it a try.
ex.cn: 我不懂为什么你连试一试都不愿意。

ex.en: He felt he would be failing in his duty if he did not report it.
ex.cn: 他认为如果不报告就是他失职。

senses.def: to not pass a test or an exam; to decide that sb/sth has not passed a test or an exam

ex.en: He failed his driving test.
ex.cn: 他驾驶执照考试不及格。

ex.en: She was disqualified after failing a drugs test.
ex.cn: 她药检未通过，被取消了资格。

ex.en: What will you do if you fail?
ex.cn: 如果你考试失败打算干什么？

ex.en: The examiners failed over half the candidates.
ex.cn: 主考人员评定，半数以上考生不及格。

senses.def: to stop working

ex.en: The brakes on my bike failed half way down the hill.
ex.cn: 我的自行车下山至中途车闸失灵了。

senses.def: to become weak

ex.en: Her eyesight is failing.
ex.cn: 她的视力日渐衰退。

ex.en: His last months in office were marred by failing health.
ex.cn: 由于健康恶化，他最后几个月的公职工作受到了影响。

senses.def: to disappoint sb; to be unable to help when needed
senses.chn: 使失望；有负于；无能为力

ex.en: When he lost his job, he felt he had failed his family.
ex.cn: 他失去工作以后，感到辜负了家庭。

ex.en: She tried to be brave, but her courage failed her.
ex.cn: 她想勇敢，但却鼓不起勇气。

ex.en: Words fail me (= I cannot express how I feel).
ex.cn: 我无法表达自己的感受。

senses.def: to not be enough when needed or expected

ex.en: The crops failed again last summer.
ex.cn: 上个夏季庄稼又歉收了。

ex.en: The rains had failed and the rivers were dry.
ex.cn: 雨量不足，河流干涸。

senses.def: to be unable to continue

ex.en: Several banks failed during the recession.
ex.cn: 经济衰退期间有几家银行倒闭了。

senses.def: used to suggest sth that sb can do if nothing else they have tried is successful

ex.en: If all else fails, you can always sell your motorbike.
ex.cn: 如果所有别的办法都不行，你总还可以卖掉摩托车。

senses.def: the result of an exam in which a person is not successful

ex.en: I got three passes and one fail.
ex.cn: 我考试三门及格，一门不及格。

senses.def: a mistake or lack of success in doing sth

ex.en: The show was an epic fail.
ex.cn: 这场演出惨不忍睹。

ex.en: We have to wait for the final chapter for the big reveal.
ex.cn: 我们得等到最后一章才能看到大结局。

senses.def: when you tell sb to do sth without fail, you are telling them that they must do it

ex.en: I want you here by two o'clock without fail.
ex.cn: 我要你两点钟务必来到这里。

senses.def: always

ex.en: He emails every week without fail.
ex.cn: 他每周必定发电子邮件。

senses.def: not successful

ex.en: a failed writer
ex.cn: 不成功的作家

ex.en: a failed coup
ex.cn: 流产政变

senses.def: a country in which the government is so weak that it has lost control of the structures of the state and other groups have more power
senses.chn: 失败国家（政府软弱无能，而其他团体拥有更多权力）

senses.def: a weakness or fault in sb/sth

ex.en: She is aware of her own failings.
ex.cn: 她了解自己的弱点。

ex.en: The inquiry acknowledges failings in the judicial system.
ex.cn: 这次调查承认司法制度有缺陷。

senses.def: used to introduce a suggestion that could be considered if the one just mentioned is not possible

ex.en: Ask a friend to recommend a doctor or, failing that, ask for a list in your local library.
ex.cn: 请朋友推荐一位医生，如果办不到就向当地图书馆要一份名单。

senses.def: designed to stop working if anything goes wrong
senses.chn: 有自动保险装置的；具有自动防止故障性能的

ex.en: a fail-safe device/mechanism/system
ex.cn: 故障保护装置／机械装置／系统

senses.def: lack of success in doing or achieving sth

ex.en: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.
ex.cn: 这项计划的成败取决于你。

ex.en: The attempt was doomed to failure.
ex.cn: 这项尝试注定失败。

ex.en: All my efforts ended in failure.
ex.cn: 我的一切努力最后都无济于事。

ex.en: the problems of economic failure and increasing unemployment
ex.cn: 经济失败和失业人数增加的问题

ex.en: She is still coming to terms with the failure of her marriage.
ex.cn: 她还在努力适应婚姻失败的事实。

senses.def: a person or thing that is not successful

ex.en: The whole thing was a complete failure.
ex.cn: 整个事情彻底失败了。

ex.en: He was a failure as a teacher.
ex.cn: 他当教师并不成功。

senses.def: an act of not doing sth, especially sth that you are expected to do

ex.en: the failure of the United Nations to maintain food supplies
ex.cn: 联合国未能维持粮食供应

ex.en: Failure to comply with the regulations will result in prosecution.
ex.cn: 不遵守规章制度将被起诉。

senses.def: the state of not working correctly or as expected; an occasion when this happens

ex.en: patients suffering from heart/kidney, etc. failure
ex.cn: 心脏、肾等衰竭的病人

ex.en: A power failure plunged everything into darkness.
ex.cn: 停电使一切陷入黑暗。

ex.en: The cause of the crash was given as engine failure.
ex.cn: 撞车事故的原因被认定是发动机故障。

senses.def: a situation in which a business has to close because it is not successful
a situation in which crops do not grow correctly and do not produce food
willingly or with pleasure

ex.en: I would fain do as you ask.
ex.cn: 听候你的吩咐。

senses.def: that cannot be clearly seen, heard or smelt

ex.en: a faint glow/glimmer/light
ex.cn: 微弱的光亮／闪光／光

ex.en: a faint smell of perfume
ex.cn: 淡淡的香水味

ex.en: We could hear their voices growing fainter as they walked down the road.
ex.cn: 他们沿路走远时我们听见他们的说话声逐渐模糊。

ex.en: His breathing became faint.
ex.cn: 他的呼吸变得微弱了。

senses.def: very small; possible but unlikely

ex.en: There is still a faint hope that she may be cured.
ex.cn: 她的病还有一点点希望可以治愈。

ex.en: They don't have the faintest chance of winning.
ex.cn: 他们毫无获胜的可能。

senses.def: not enthusiastic

ex.en: a faint show of resistance
ex.cn: 软弱无力装模作样的抵抗

ex.en: a faint smile
ex.cn: 淡淡一笑

senses.def: feeling weak and tired and likely to become unconscious

ex.en: She suddenly felt faint.
ex.cn: 她突然感到快要昏倒。

ex.en: The walkers were faint from hunger.
ex.cn: 那些走路的人饿得头昏眼花。

senses.def: to not know anything at all about sth

ex.en: I didn't have the faintest idea what you meant.
ex.cn: 我一点也不明白你的意思。

senses.def: to praise sb/sth only a little, in order to show that you do not really like them/it
senses.chn: 用冷漠的赞扬贬低；寓贬于褒；名褒实贬

senses.def: to become unconscious when not enough blood is going to your brain, usually because of the heat, a shock, etc.

ex.en: to faint from hunger
ex.cn: 饿昏过去

ex.en: Suddenly the woman in front of me fainted.
ex.cn: 我面前的女人突然昏倒了。

ex.en: I almost fainted (= I was very surprised) when she told me.
ex.cn: 她告诉我时我吃惊得差点儿昏过去。

senses.def: the state of becoming unconscious

ex.en: He fell to the ground in a dead faint.
ex.cn: 他跌倒在地，昏死过去。

senses.def: lacking confidence and not brave; afraid of failing
not suitable for people who lack confidence or who get frightened easily
senses.chn: 不适合缺乏信心的人；不适合胆怯之人

ex.en: The climb is not for the faint-hearted (= is only for people who are brave).
ex.cn: 攀岩绝不是胆小的人做的事。

senses.def: the state of feeling weak and tired and likely to become unconscious
acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation

ex.en: a fair deal/wage/price/question
ex.cn: 公平交易；合理的工资；公道的价格；恰当的问题

ex.en: The punishment was very fair.
ex.cn: 这个处罚很公正。

ex.en: Was it really fair to him to ask him to do all the work?
ex.cn: 要他做所有的工作对他真的公平吗？

ex.en: It's not fair on the students to keep changing the timetable.
ex.cn: 不断改动时间表，这样对待学生不恰当。

ex.en: It's only fair to add that they were not told about the problem until the last minute.
ex.cn: 要补充说明以下情况才合理，即他们是最后一刻才获知这个问题。

ex.en: I think it is fair to say that they are pleased with this latest offer.
ex.cn: 我认为恰当地说，他们对最新的这一次提议很满意。

senses.def: treating everyone equally and according to the rules or law
senses.chn: （按法律、规定）平等待人的，秉公办事的，公正的

ex.en: She has always been scrupulously fair.
ex.cn: 她总是一丝不苟地秉公办事。

ex.en: demands for a fairer distribution of wealth
ex.cn: 更加公平分配财富的要求

ex.en: We have to be fair to both players.
ex.cn: 我们必须公正对待双方运动员。

ex.en: to receive a fair trial
ex.cn: 得到公正审判

ex.en: free and fair elections
ex.cn: 自由公正的选举

ex.en: It's not fair! He always gets more than me.
ex.cn: 这不公平！他得到的总比我多。

senses.def: quite large in number, size or amount

ex.en: A fair number of people came along.
ex.cn: 有相当多的人来了。

ex.en: a fair-sized town
ex.cn: 一座不小的市镇

ex.en: We've still got a fair bit (= quite a lot) to do.
ex.cn: 我们还有相当多的事要做。

senses.def: quite good

ex.en: There's a fair chance that we might win this time.
ex.cn: 这次我们可能胜算很大。

ex.en: It's a fair bet that they won't turn up.
ex.cn: 我敢打赌，他们不会露面。

ex.en: I have a fair idea of what happened.
ex.cn: 我相当了解发生的事。

ex.en: His knowledge of French is only fair.
ex.cn: 他的法语知识还算可以。

senses.def: pale in colour

ex.en: a fair complexion
ex.cn: 白皙的肤色

ex.en: She has long fair hair.
ex.cn: 她有一头浅色长发。

ex.en: All her children are fair (= they all have fair hair).
ex.cn: 她的孩子们都长着淡色的头发。

senses.def: bright and not raining

ex.en: a fair and breezy day
ex.cn: 风和日丽的日子

senses.def: not too strong and blowing in the right direction

ex.en: They set sail with the first fair wind.
ex.cn: 顺风一起他们就扬帆出航了。

senses.def: beautiful

ex.en: a fair maiden
ex.cn: 美丽的少女

senses.def: in some situations any type of behaviour is acceptable to get what you want
senses.chn: 在情场和战场上可以不择手段

senses.def: used to tell sb to be reasonable in their judgement of sb/sth

ex.en: Be fair! She didn't know you were coming.
ex.cn: 要讲道理！她不知道你要来。

senses.def: using dishonest methods if honest ones do not work
a reasonable opportunity to show that you can do sth

ex.en: I felt we weren't given a fair crack of the whip.
ex.cn: 我觉得我们没有得到适当的机会。

senses.def: used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable
senses.chn: （指想法、建议）有道理，说得对，行

ex.en: 'We'll meet at 8.' 'Fair enough.'
ex.cn: “我们 8 点钟见。” “行。”

ex.en: If you don't want to come, fair enough, but let Bill know.
ex.cn: 你要是不想来，可以，不过要让比尔知道。

senses.def: used, especially as an exclamation, to say that you think that an action, decision, etc. is acceptable and appropriate because it means that everyone will be treated fairly
senses.chn: （尤用作感叹词，表示认为行动、决定等可以接受）彼此都要公平，应该公正才是

ex.en: Fair's fair—you can't expect them to cancel everything just because you can't make it.
ex.cn: 彼此都要公平，不可能就因为你不能出席就指望他们取消一切。

senses.def: (to allow sb) the opportunity to give their opinion of sth before deciding if they have done sth wrong, often in court
senses.chn: （给某人）申辩机会；（让某人接受）公平审讯

ex.en: I'll see that you get a fair hearing.
ex.cn: 我务必使你有说明观点的机会。

senses.def: (to give sb/get) fair treatment that gives you the same chance as sb else
(more than) an amount of sth that is considered to be reasonable or acceptable
senses.chn: （超过）合理的数量，恰当的数量

ex.en: He has more than his fair share of problems.
ex.cn: 他的问题过多。

ex.en: I've had my fair share of success in the past.
ex.cn: 过去我已经取得了应有的成功。

senses.def: not particularly good or bad
used by sb who is caught doing sth wrong, to say that they admit that they are wrong
senses.chn: （当场被抓获时说）这是罪有应得，抓得有理

senses.def: according to the rules; in a way that is considered to be acceptable and appropriate
senses.chn: 按照规则；公正地；公平合理地

ex.en: Come on, you two, fight fair!
ex.cn: 得了，你们俩，要按规则比赛！

ex.en: They'll respect you as long as you play fair (= behave honestly).
ex.cn: 只要为人正直，别人就会尊敬你。

senses.def: honestly and according to the rules

ex.en: We won the election fair and square.
ex.cn: 我们光明正大地竞选获胜。

senses.def: in a direct way that is easy to understand

ex.en: I told him fair and square to pack his bags.
ex.cn: 我直截了当让他收拾好行李走人。

senses.def: exactly in the place you were aiming for

ex.en: I hit the target fair and square.
ex.cn: 我不偏不斜正中靶子。

senses.def: having the necessary qualities or conditions to succeed
senses.chn: 有成功的素质；具备成功的条件

ex.en: She seems set fair to win the championship.
ex.cn: 她似乎具备夺冠的条件。

ex.en: Conditions were set fair for stable economic development.
ex.cn: 形势适合经济稳定发展。

senses.def: used to say that you think the offer you are making is reasonable or generous

ex.en: Look, I'll give you £100 for it. I can't say fairer than that.
ex.cn: 你看，我出 100 英镑买它，这再公道不过了。

senses.def: a type of entertainment in a field or park at which people can ride on large machines and play games to win prizes

ex.en: Let's take the kids to the fair.
ex.cn: 咱们带孩子们到游乐场吧。

ex.en: all the fun of the fair
ex.cn: 露天游乐园的一切乐趣

senses.def: a type of entertainment in a field or park at which farm animals and products are shown and take part in competitions

ex.en: the county/state fair
ex.cn: 县／州农畜产品集市

senses.def: an event at which people, businesses, etc. show and sell their goods

ex.en: a world trade fair
ex.cn: 世界交易会

ex.en: a craft/a book/an antique fair
ex.cn: 工艺品展销会；书市；古玩交易会

senses.def: (in the past) a market at which animals were sold

ex.en: a horse fair
ex.cn: 马市

senses.def: an event at which people who are looking for jobs can get information about companies who might employ them
senses.chn: 职业介绍会；就业展览会

senses.def: honestly and according to the rules

ex.en: We won the election fair and square.
ex.cn: 我们光明正大地竞选获胜。

senses.def: in a direct way that is easy to understand

ex.en: I told him fair and square to pack his bags.
ex.cn: 我直截了当让他收拾好行李走人。

senses.def: exactly in the place you were aiming for

ex.en: I hit the target fair and square.
ex.cn: 我不偏不斜正中靶子。

senses.def: a neat version of a piece of writing
used to emphasize that sth is genuine or true, or to ask whether it is

ex.en: It's a fair dinkum Aussie wedding.
ex.cn: 那是地道的澳大利亚婚礼。

ex.en: 'Burt's just told me he's packing up in a month.' 'Fair dinkum?'
ex.cn: “伯特刚才跟我说，再过一个月他就收拾行李走人。” “真的吗？”

senses.def: used to emphasize that behaviour is acceptable

ex.en: They were asking a lot for the car, but fair dinkum considering how new it is.
ex.cn: 他们这辆车的要价很高，但考虑到车子很新，还是可以接受的。

senses.def: used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable
senses.chn: （指想法、建议）有道理，说得对，行

ex.en: 'We'll meet at 8.' 'Fair enough.'
ex.cn: “我们 8 点钟见。” “行。”

ex.en: If you don't want to come, fair enough, but let Bill know.
ex.cn: 你要是不想来，可以，不过要让比尔知道。

senses.def: if a person or thing is said to be fair game, it is considered acceptable to play jokes on them, criticize them, etc.
senses.chn: 可开玩笑（或嘲弄、作弄）的对象

ex.en: The younger teachers were considered fair game by most of the kids.
ex.cn: 多数小孩认为年轻教师是可作弄的对象。

senses.def: an outdoor area where a fair with entertainments is held
a place where a fair showing farm animals, farm products, etc. is held

ex.en: the Ohio State Fairgrounds
ex.cn: 俄亥俄州农畜产品集市场地

senses.def: a place where companies and businesses hold a fair to show their products
senses.chn: 商品交易会场址；展销会场地

ex.en: the Milan trade fairgrounds
ex.cn: 米兰交易会场址

senses.def: with light or blonde hair
to some extent but not very

ex.en: a fairly easy book
ex.cn: 一本相当浅易的书

ex.en: a fairly typical reaction
ex.cn: 相当典型的反应

ex.en: I know him fairly well, but I wouldn't say we were really close friends.
ex.cn: 我相当了解他，但并不是说我们是真正的密友。

ex.en: I go jogging fairly regularly.
ex.cn: 我基本上经常慢跑锻炼。

ex.en: We'll have to leave fairly soon (= before very long).
ex.cn: 我们不久得离开。

ex.en: I'm fairly certain I can do the job.
ex.cn: 我有相当把握能干这项工作。

senses.def: in a fair and reasonable way; honestly

ex.en: He has always treated me very fairly.
ex.cn: 他待我一直很公正。

ex.en: Her attitude could fairly be described as hostile.
ex.cn: 公平而论，她的态度可以说是怀有敌意。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth that you are saying

ex.en: The time fairly raced by.
ex.cn: 时间过得真快。

senses.def: honestly and according to the rules

ex.en: We won the election fair and square.
ex.cn: 我们光明正大地竞选获胜。

senses.def: in a direct way that is easy to understand

ex.en: I told him fair and square to pack his bags.
ex.cn: 我直截了当让他收拾好行李走人。

senses.def: exactly in the place you were aiming for

ex.en: I hit the target fair and square.
ex.cn: 我不偏不斜正中靶子。

senses.def: looking at and judging things in a fair and open way
the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is reasonable

ex.en: the fairness of the judicial system
ex.cn: 司法制度的公正性

senses.def: a pale colour of skin or hair

ex.en: A tan emphasized the fairness of her hair.
ex.cn: 晒黑的皮肤更加衬托出了她那浅色的头发。

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that defends sb who has just been criticized, or that explains another statement that may seem unreasonable
senses.chn: 要公正对待，不能怪（某人）

ex.en: In all fairness to him, he did try to stop her leaving.
ex.cn: 不能怪他，他确实曾设法阻止她离开。

senses.def: the fact of playing a game or acting honestly, fairly and according to the rules

ex.en: a player admired for his sense of fair play
ex.cn: 因公正比赛而受人尊敬的运动员

ex.en: The task of the organization is to ensure fair play when food is distributed to the refugees.
ex.cn: 该组织的任务就是保证把粮食分给难民时要公平合理。

senses.def: used to express approval when sb has done sth that you think is right or reasonable
senses.chn: （表示赞许）做得对，公道，公平合理

senses.def: used to express approval when sb has done sth that you think is right or reasonable
senses.chn: （表示赞许）做得对，公道，公平合理

senses.def: used, especially as an exclamation, to say that you think that an action, decision, etc. is acceptable and appropriate because it means that everyone will be treated fairly
senses.chn: （尤用作感叹词，表示认为行动、决定等可以接受）彼此都要公平，应该公正才是

ex.en: Fair's fair—you can't expect them to cancel everything just because you can't make it.
ex.cn: 彼此都要公平，不可能就因为你不能出席就指望他们取消一切。

senses.def: not particularly good or bad
involving trade which supports producers in developing countries by paying fair prices and making sure that workers have good working conditions and fair pay
senses.chn: 公平贸易的（尤指支持发展中国家在价格、工人工资等方面实行公平政策）

senses.def: the long strip of short grass that you must hit the ball along before you get to the green and the hole
behaving in a particular way or doing a particular activity only when it is pleasant for them
senses.chn: 同甘不共苦的；只在顺境中的

ex.en: a fair-weather friend (= sb who stops being a friend when you are in trouble)
ex.cn: 不能共患难的朋友

senses.def: (in stories) a creature like a small person, who has magic powers
senses.chn: （故事中的）小仙人，仙子，小精灵

ex.en: a good/wicked fairy
ex.cn: 善良的仙子；邪恶的精灵

senses.def: an offensive word for a homosexual man
a small cake, baked in a paper container shaped like a cup and often with icing on top
a person who rescues you when you most need help
the home of fairies
a beautiful, special or unusual place

ex.en: The toyshop is a fairyland for young children.
ex.cn: 玩具店是孩子们的仙境。

senses.def: small coloured electric lights used for decoration, especially on a tree at Christmas
senses.chn: （尤指挂在圣诞树上的）彩色小灯

senses.def: a story about magic or fairies, usually for children
a story that sb tells that is not true; a lie

ex.en: Now tell me the truth: I don't want any more of your fairy stories.
ex.cn: 现在跟我说实话：我不想再听你胡编乱诌了。

senses.def: typical of sth in a fairy tale

ex.en: a fairy-tale castle on an island
ex.cn: 岛上的一座神奇城堡

ex.en: a fairy-tale wedding in the cathedral
ex.cn: 在大教堂举行的童话般的婚礼

senses.def: something that has already happened or been done and that you cannot change
trust in sb's ability or knowledge; trust that sb/sth will do what has been promised

ex.en: I have great faith in you—I know you'll do well.
ex.cn: 我对你有信心，我知道你会干好的。

ex.en: We've lost faith in the government's promises.
ex.cn: 我们不再相信政府的承诺。

ex.en: Her friend's kindness has restored her faith in human nature.
ex.cn: 朋友的善意使她恢复了对人性的信心。

ex.en: He has blind faith (= unreasonable trust) in doctors' ability to find a cure.
ex.cn: 他盲目相信医生有妙手回春的能力。

senses.def: strong religious belief

ex.en: to lose your faith
ex.cn: 失去信仰

ex.en: Faith is stronger than reason.
ex.cn: 信仰比理智更有力。

senses.def: a particular religion

ex.en: the Christian faith
ex.cn: 基督教

ex.en: The children are learning to understand people of different faiths.
ex.cn: 孩子们在学着理解不同宗教信仰的人。

senses.def: the intention to do sth right

ex.en: They handed over the weapons as a gesture of good faith.

senses.def: if a joke, a story, or an event falls flat, it completely fails to amuse people or to have the effect that was intended
senses.chn: （笑话、故事、事件等）完全失败，根本未达到预期效果

senses.def: to fall so that you are lying on your front
to fail completely, usually causing embarrassment

ex.en: His next television venture fell flat on its face.
ex.cn: 他的下一个电视项目丢人现眼，彻底失败了。

senses.def: to be strongly attracted to sb; to fall in love with sb

ex.en: They fell for each other instantly.
ex.cn: 他俩一见钟情。

senses.def: to be tricked into believing sth that is not true

ex.en: I'm surprised you fell for that trick.
ex.cn: 我感到惊奇，你竟中了那个诡计。

senses.def: to lose the trust or respect that people have for you, especially by doing sth wrong or immoral
senses.chn: （尤指因做了错事或不道德之事而）失去信任，失去尊重，失去恩宠

senses.def: a person who is blamed or punished for sth wrong that another person has done
able to make mistakes or be wrong

ex.en: Memory is selective and fallible.
ex.cn: 记忆有选择性而且会出错。

ex.en: All human beings are fallible.
ex.cn: 人人都难免犯错误。

senses.def: if soldiers fall in, they form lines

ex.en: The sergeant ordered his men to fall in.
ex.cn: 中士命令士兵集合。

senses.def: a situation where people are no longer friends, caused by a disagreement or an argument

ex.en: Dave and I had a falling-out.
ex.cn: 戴夫和我闹翻了。

senses.def: to be able to be divided into sth

ex.en: My talk falls naturally into three parts.
ex.cn: 我的讲话可以自然分成三个部分。

senses.def: to decrease in quantity or quality

ex.en: Attendance at my lectures has fallen off considerably.
ex.cn: 听我讲课的学生大大减少了。

senses.def: a reduction in the number, amount or quality of sth

ex.en: a recent fall-off in sales
ex.cn: 近来销售量的减少

senses.def: to be ignored or not noticed by other people
senses.chn: 不被理睬；不被注意；被置若罔闻

ex.en: Her advice fell on deaf ears.
ex.cn: 她的忠告没有受到重视。

senses.def: to fail to produce the result or the effect that you hope for; to have little success
senses.chn: 未产生预期的结果（或效果）；没有开花结果

senses.def: one of the two tubes in the body of a woman or female animal along which eggs pass from the ovaries to the uterus
to become loose and drop

ex.en: His hair is falling out.
ex.cn: 他的头发在脱落。

senses.def: if soldiers fall out, they leave their lines and move away
dangerous radioactive dust that is in the air after a nuclear explosion
the bad results of a situation or an action
to stop working suddenly

ex.en: My spreadsheet keeps falling over.
ex.cn: 我的电子表格程序不断出故障。

fall over yourself to do sth.lemma: fall over yourself to do sth

senses.def: to try very hard or want very much to do sth
senses.chn: 特别卖力；迫不及待；煞费苦心；不遗余力

ex.en: He was falling over himself to be nice to me.
ex.cn: 他尽力对我友好。

senses.def: not used for growing crops, especially so that the quality of the land will improve

ex.en: Farmers are now paid to let their land lie fallow.
ex.cn: 如今农民让土地休耕能得到回报。

senses.def: when nothing is created or produced; not successful
senses.chn: 休闲的；休眠的；不成功的

ex.en: Contemporary dance is coming onto the arts scene again after a long fallow period.
ex.cn: 当代舞蹈经过一段长时期销声匿迹以后现在又回到了艺术舞台。

senses.def: a small European deer with white spots on its back
a pipe for carrying water from a roof down to the ground or to a drain
senses.chn: （从房顶到地面排水的）雨水管

senses.def: to fail to reach the standard that you expected or need

ex.en: The hotel fell far short of their expectations.
ex.cn: 旅馆远没有他们预期的那么好。

senses.def: to become ill/sick
to not be completed, or not happen

ex.en: Our plans fell through because of lack of money.
ex.cn: 我们的计划由于缺钱而落空了。

senses.def: to become very old and in bad condition because of long use

ex.en: Our car is falling to pieces, we've had it so long.
ex.cn: 我们的汽车已破旧不堪，我们已用了它很久了。

senses.def: to stop working; to be destroyed

ex.en: He's worried the business will fall to pieces without him.
ex.cn: 他担心没有了他企业将会倒闭。

senses.def: to become the duty or responsibility of sb

ex.en: With his partner away, all the work now fell to him.
ex.cn: 他的搭档走了以后，工作现在全落在他的身上。

ex.en: It fell to me to inform her of her son's death.
ex.cn: 把她儿子死讯通知她的差事落在了我的头上。

senses.def: to begin to do sth

ex.en: She fell to brooding about what had happened to her.
ex.cn: 她开始愤愤地思忖着自己的遭遇。

senses.def: wrong; not correct or true
senses.chn: 错误的；不正确的；不真实的

ex.en: A whale is a fish. True or false?
ex.cn: 鲸鱼是鱼，对还是错？

ex.en: Predictions of an early improvement in the housing market proved false.
ex.cn: 认为房屋市场很快就好转的预测结果证明是错误的。

ex.en: She gave false information to the insurance company.
ex.cn: 她向保险公司提供了不真实的资料。

ex.en: He used a false name to get the job.
ex.cn: 他用假名得到了这份工作。

senses.def: not natural

ex.en: false teeth/eyelashes
ex.cn: 假牙；假睫毛

ex.en: a false beard
ex.cn: 假胡子

senses.def: not genuine, but made to look real to cheat people

ex.en: a false passport
ex.cn: 假护照

senses.def: not real or sincere

ex.en: false modesty
ex.cn: 假谦虚

ex.en: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
ex.cn: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

senses.def: wrong or mistaken, because it is based on sth that is not true or correct

ex.en: a false argument/assumption/belief
ex.cn: 错误的论据／假设／信念

ex.en: to give a false impression of wealth
ex.cn: 给人以富有的错觉

ex.en: to lull sb into a false sense of security (= make sb feel safe when they are really in danger)
ex.cn: 哄某人产生虚假的安全感

ex.en: They didn't want to raise any false hopes, but they believed her husband had escaped capture.
ex.cn: 他们并不想让人心存奢望，但是他们相信她的丈夫已逃脱追捕。

ex.en: Buying a cheap computer is a false economy (= will not actually save you money).
ex.cn: 买廉价计算机看似省钱，但其实并不划算。

senses.def: not faithful

ex.en: a false lover
ex.cn: 不忠诚的情人

senses.def: by pretending to be sth that you are not, in order to gain some advantage for yourself
senses.chn: 靠欺诈手段；以虚假的借口

ex.en: She was accused of obtaining money under false pretences.
ex.cn: 她被控诈骗钱财。

senses.def: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true
senses.chn: 给人以真实（或空洞、虚假）的印象

ex.en: It may seem a strange story but it rings true to me.
ex.cn: 这个故事也许显得离奇，但我却觉得很真实。

senses.def: a warning about a danger that does not happen; a belief that sth bad is going to happen, when it is not

ex.en: The fire service was called out but it was a false alarm.
ex.cn: 消防人员接到报警后出动，但这是假报火警。

senses.def: a person who has a basic knowledge of a language, but has started to study it again from the beginning
senses.chn: 二次初学者，非真实初学者（对某一语言虽已有基本知识但又从头学习）

senses.def: a situation in which you think that sth good is going to happen but it does not

ex.en: a false dawn for the economy
ex.cn: 经济复苏的假象

senses.def: a person who seems to be your friend, but who is not loyal and cannot be trusted
a word in a foreign language that looks similar to a word in your own language, but has a different meaning

ex.en: The English word 'sensible' and the French word 'sensible' are false friends.
ex.cn: 英语的 sensible 一词和法语的 sensible 一词同形异义。

senses.def: the state of not being true; the act of telling a lie

ex.en: to test the truth or falsehood of her claims
ex.cn: 检验她陈述的真伪

senses.def: a statement that is not true
the crime of illegally keeping sb as a prisoner somewhere
senses.chn: 私禁；非法拘禁；非法拘留

senses.def: a memory of sth that did not actually happen
senses.chn: （对事实上并未发生的事情的）伪记忆

senses.def: an action that is not allowed or not recommended and that may cause a bad result
senses.chn: （可能引起不良后果的）不允行为，不明智行动

ex.en: One false move and the bomb might blow up.
ex.cn: 一步弄错，炸弹就可能会爆炸。

senses.def: an attempt to begin sth that is not successful
senses.chn: 不成功的开端；起步失误

ex.en: After a number of false starts, she finally found a job she liked.
ex.cn: 她起初失败了几次，之后终于找到了喜欢的工作。

senses.def: a situation when sb taking part in a race starts before the official signal has been given
a set of artificial teeth used by sb who has lost their natural teeth
a male singer who sings falsetto
an unusually high voice, especially the voice that men use to sing very high notes
pieces of material used inside a bra to make a woman's breasts seem larger
to change a written record or information so that it is no longer true
senses.chn: 篡改，伪造（文字记录、信息）

senses.def: the state of not being true or genuine
fat, cheerful and eating and drinking a lot
senses.chn: 福斯塔夫式的（源于莎士比亚笔下人物，外形肥胖且喜狂欢闹饮）

ex.en: My uncle was a Falstaffian figure.
ex.cn: 我的叔叔是个福斯塔夫式的人物。

ex.en: artificial flowers
ex.cn: 假花

ex.en: artificial light
ex.cn: 人造光

ex.en: synthetic drugs
ex.cn: 合成药物

ex.en: shoes with synthetic soles
ex.cn: 合成鞋底的鞋

ex.en: false teeth
ex.cn: 假牙

senses.def: to become weaker or less effective

ex.en: The economy shows no signs of faltering.
ex.cn: 经济没有衰退的迹象。

ex.en: Her courage never faltered.
ex.cn: 她从未气馁过。

senses.def: to speak in a way that shows that you are not confident
senses.chn: （嗓音）颤抖；结巴地说；支吾其词

ex.en: His voice faltered as he began his speech.
ex.cn: 他开始演讲时说话结结巴巴。

senses.def: to walk or behave in a way that shows that you are not confident

ex.en: She walked up to the platform without faltering.
ex.cn: 她健步走上了讲台。

ex.en: He never faltered in his commitment to the party.
ex.cn: 他对党始终忠贞不渝。

senses.def: the state of being known and talked about by many people

ex.en: to achieve/win instant fame
ex.cn: 立即获得／迅即赢得名声

ex.en: to rise/shoot to fame overnight
ex.cn: 一夜之间成名

ex.en: Andrew Lloyd Webber of 'Cats' fame (= famous for 'Cats')
ex.cn: 以《猫》闻名的安德鲁 · 劳埃德 · 韦伯

ex.en: The town's only claim to fame is that there was once a riot there.
ex.cn: 这个镇唯一出名之处就是那里有过一次暴乱。

ex.en: She went to Hollywood in search of fame and fortune.
ex.cn: 她为追逐名利去了好莱坞。

senses.def: very well known

ex.en: Las Vegas, famed for its casinos
ex.cn: 以赌场著名的拉斯韦加斯

ex.en: a famed poet and musician
ex.cn: 一位大名鼎鼎的诗人和音乐家

senses.def: related to or typical of a family
affecting several members of a family

ex.en: familial left-handedness
ex.cn: 家族遗传的左撇子

senses.def: well known to you; often seen or heard and therefore easy to recognize
senses.chn: 熟悉的；常见到的；常听说的

ex.en: to look/sound/taste familiar
ex.cn: 看／听／尝起来熟悉

ex.en: He's a familiar figure in the neighbourhood.
ex.cn: 他在这个地区是大家熟悉的人物。

ex.en: Something about her voice was vaguely familiar.
ex.cn: 她的声音有点耳熟。

ex.en: The smell is very familiar to everyone who lives near a bakery.
ex.cn: 住在面包店附近的人都很熟悉这种气味。

ex.en: Violent attacks are becoming all too familiar (= sadly familiar).
ex.cn: 暴力攻击变成了司空见惯的现象。

senses.def: knowing sth very well

ex.en: an area with which I had been familiar since childhood
ex.cn: 我自幼就了若指掌的一个地区

ex.en: Are you familiar with the computer software they use?
ex.cn: 你熟悉他们使用的计算机软件吗？

senses.def: very informal, sometimes in a way that is unpleasant

ex.en: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
ex.cn: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

ex.en: After a few drinks her boss started getting too familiar for her liking.
ex.cn: 老板几杯酒下肚以后就开始令她觉得过分亲昵。

senses.def: the state of knowing sb/sth well; the state of recognizing sb/sth

ex.en: His familiarity with the language helped him enjoy his stay.
ex.cn: 他通晓这种语言，所以逗留期间过得很惬意。

ex.en: When she saw the house, she had a feeling of familiarity.
ex.cn: 她见到这座房子就有一种熟悉的感觉。

senses.def: a friendly informal manner

ex.en: She addressed me with an easy familiarity that made me feel at home.
ex.cn: 她和我谈话亲切随和，使我不感到拘束。

senses.def: knowing sb/sth very well may cause you to lose admiration and respect for them/it
senses.chn: 过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: knowing sb/sth very well may cause you to lose admiration and respect for them/it
senses.chn: 过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: to learn about sth or teach sb about sth, so that you/they start to understand it

ex.en: You'll need time to familiarize yourself with our procedures.
ex.cn: 你需要时间熟悉我们的程序。

senses.def: in a friendly and informal manner, sometimes in a way that is too informal to be pleasant

ex.en: John Hunt, familiarly known to his friends as Jack
ex.cn: 约翰 · 亨特，朋友昵称他为杰克

ex.en: He touched her cheek familiarly.
ex.cn: 他亲昵地碰了碰她的面颊。

senses.def: in the way that is well known to people

ex.en: The elephant's nose or, more familiarly, trunk, is the most versatile organ in the animal kingdom.
ex.cn: 象的鼻子，俗称为 trunk，是动物界中功能最多的器官。

senses.def: a group consisting of one or two parents and their children

ex.en: the other members of my family
ex.cn: 我家的其他成员

ex.en: Almost every family in the country owns a television.
ex.cn: 这个国家几乎家家都有一台电视机。

ex.en: All my family enjoy skiing.
ex.cn: 我们全家都喜欢滑雪。

ex.en: one-parent / single-parent families
ex.cn: 单亲家庭

ex.en: a family of four
ex.cn: 四口之家

ex.en: families with young children
ex.cn: 有小孩的家庭

senses.def: a group consisting of one or two parents, their children and close relations
senses.chn: （大）家庭（包括父母子女及近亲）；亲属

ex.en: All our family came to Grandad's eightieth birthday party.
ex.cn: 我们所有亲属都来参加了祖父的八十寿宴。

ex.en: The support of family and friends is vital.
ex.cn: 亲友的支持极为重要。

ex.en: We've only told the immediate family (= the closest relations).
ex.cn: 我们只告诉了直系亲属。

ex.en: the Royal Family (= the children and close relations of the king or queen)
ex.cn: 王室

ex.en: I always think of you as one of the family.
ex.cn: 我一直把你当成自家人。

ex.en: She's family (= she is a relation).
ex.cn: 她是我们家的人。

senses.def: all the people who are related to each other, including those who are now dead

ex.en: Some families have farmed in this area for hundreds of years.
ex.cn: 有些家族在这个地区务农有几百年了。

ex.en: This painting has been in our family for generations.
ex.cn: 这幅画是我们家的传家宝。

senses.def: a couple's or a person's children, especially young children

ex.en: They have a large family.
ex.cn: 他们的子女成群。

ex.en: I addressed it to Mr and Mrs Jones and family.
ex.cn: 我以此致琼斯伉俪及子女。

ex.en: Do they plan to start a family (= have children)?
ex.cn: 他们打算生孩子吗？

ex.en: to bring up/raise a family
ex.cn: 抚育／抚养孩子

senses.def: a group of related animals and plants; a group of related things, especially languages

ex.en: Lions belong to the cat family.
ex.cn: 狮属于猫科。

ex.en: the Germanic family of languages
ex.cn: 日耳曼语族

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
to be a common feature in a particular family
senses.chn: 为一家人所共有；世代相传

ex.en: Heart disease runs in the family.
ex.cn: 这家人都有心脏病。

senses.def: connected with the family or a particular family

ex.en: family life
ex.cn: 家庭生活

ex.en: your family background
ex.cn: 你的家庭背景

senses.def: owned by a family

ex.en: a family business
ex.cn: 家庭企业

senses.def: suitable for all members of a family, both adults and children

ex.en: a family show
ex.cn: 家庭节目

senses.def: a man who has a wife or partner and children; a man who enjoys being at home with his wife or partner and children
senses.chn: 有妻室儿女的人；恋家的男人；喜欢在家享受天伦之乐的男人

ex.en: I see he's become a family man.
ex.cn: 我发觉他已变得很恋家。

ex.en: a devoted family man
ex.cn: 忠于家庭的男人

senses.def: the part of your name that shows which family you belong to
the process of controlling the number of children you have by using contraception
a room in a house where the family can relax, watch television, etc.
a room in a hotel for three or four people to sleep in, especially parents and children
(in Britain) a room in a pub where children are allowed to sit
a diagram that shows the relationship between members of a family over a long period of time

ex.en: How far back can you trace your family tree?
ex.cn: 你的家谱可以追溯到多少代？

senses.def: a lack of food during a long period of time in a region

ex.en: a severe famine
ex.cn: 严重饥荒

ex.en: disasters such as floods and famine
ex.cn: 水灾和饥荒这一类灾难

ex.en: the threat of widespread famine in the area
ex.cn: 这一地区内大范围的饥荒威胁

ex.en: to raise money for famine relief
ex.cn: 为赈济饥荒筹款

senses.def: very hungry

ex.en: When's lunch? I'm famished!
ex.cn: 什么时候吃午饭？我饿得要死了！

senses.def: known about by many people

ex.en: a famous artist/hotel
ex.cn: 著名的艺术家／旅馆

ex.en: the most famous lake in Italy
ex.cn: 意大利最著名的湖

ex.en: One day, I'll be rich and famous.
ex.cn: 总有一天我会名利双收。

ex.en: He became internationally famous for his novels.
ex.cn: 他以小说享誉国际。

ex.en: She was more famous as a writer than as a singer.
ex.cn: 她作为作家比作为歌手名声要大。

senses.def: people sometimes say Famous last words! when they think sb is being too confident about sth that is going to happen
senses.chn: 吹牛，胡扯（表示某人盲目乐观）

ex.en: 'Everything's under control.' 'Famous last words!'
ex.cn: “一切都在掌握之中。” “净吹牛！”

senses.def: people sometimes say Famous last words! when they think sb is being too confident about sth that is going to happen
senses.chn: 吹牛，胡扯（表示某人盲目乐观）

ex.en: 'Everything's under control.' 'Famous last words!'
ex.cn: “一切都在掌握之中。” “净吹牛！”

senses.def: in a way that is famous

ex.en: Some newspapers, most famously the New York Times, refused to print the word Ms.
ex.cn: 有些报纸拒不刊用 Ms 这个词，其中最著名的是《纽约时报》。

senses.def: to have a very good relationship
a person who admires sb/sth or enjoys watching or listening to sb/sth very much
senses.chn: 迷；狂热爱好者；狂热仰慕者

ex.en: movie fans
ex.cn: 电影迷

ex.en: crowds of football fans
ex.cn: 一群群足球迷

ex.en: a big fan of Rihanna
ex.cn: 蕾哈娜的狂热仰慕者

ex.en: fan mail (= letters from fans to the person they admire)
ex.cn: 狂热仰慕者的来信

senses.def: a machine with blades that go round to create a current of air

ex.en: to switch on the electric fan
ex.cn: 开电扇

ex.en: a fan heater
ex.cn: 风扇式加热器

senses.def: a thing that you hold in your hand and wave to create a current of cool air
when sb in authority finds out about sth bad or wrong that sb has done
senses.chn: 做了坏事（或错事）被发现

ex.en: When the shit hits the fan, I don't want to be here.
ex.cn: 事情一旦败露，我就不想待在这儿了。

senses.def: to make air blow onto sb/sth by waving a fan, your hand, etc.

ex.en: He fanned himself with a newspaper to cool down.
ex.cn: 他用一张报纸给自己扇凉。

senses.def: to make a fire burn more strongly by blowing on it

ex.en: Fanned by a westerly wind, the fire spread rapidly through the city.
ex.cn: 火借助西风迅速蔓延全城。

senses.def: to make a feeling, an attitude, etc. stronger

ex.en: His reluctance to answer her questions simply fanned her curiosity.
ex.cn: 他不爽快地回答她的问题，这就激起了她的好奇心。

senses.def: to make a feeling such as anger, hatred, etc. worse

ex.en: His writings fanned the flames of racism.
ex.cn: 他的写作煽起了种族主义情绪。

senses.def: to spread out or spread sth out over an area

ex.en: The police fanned out to surround the house.
ex.cn: 警察散开包围了这座房子。

ex.en: The bird fanned out its tail feathers.
ex.cn: 这只鸟把尾羽展成扇形。

senses.def: a person who is extremely enthusiastic about sth

ex.en: a fitness/crossword, etc. fanatic
ex.cn: 热衷于健美、纵横填字游戏等的人

senses.def: a person who holds extreme or dangerous opinions

ex.en: religious fanatics
ex.cn: 宗教极端分子

senses.def: extreme beliefs or behaviour, especially in connection with religion or politics
senses.chn: （尤指宗教、政治上的）狂热，入迷

senses.def: a belt that operates the machinery that cools a car engine
senses.chn: （带动冷却汽车引擎散热器的）风扇皮带

senses.def: a person, especially a boy or young man, who is extremely interested in sth such as a particular type of music or software
senses.chn: 迷（尤指痴迷某种音乐、软件等的男孩或年轻男子）

ex.en: a Nintendo fanboy
ex.cn: 任天堂电玩迷

ex.en: Linux fanboys
ex.cn: Linux 操作系统迷

senses.def: sexually attractive
a person who has a special interest in sth, especially sb who keeps or breeds birds, animals or plants
senses.chn: 爱好者；（尤指）饲养迷，园艺迷

ex.en: a pigeon fancier
ex.cn: 喜欢养鸽子的人

senses.def: based on imagination and not facts or reason
decorated in an unusual style that shows imagination
senses.chn: 装饰独出心裁的；式样奇特的；花哨的

ex.en: a fanciful gold border
ex.cn: 别出心裁的金色镶边

senses.def: an organization that a person's fans belong to and that sends them information, etc. about that person
senses.chn: …迷俱乐部；影迷（或歌迷、球迷等）会

senses.def: to want sth or want to do sth

ex.en: Fancy a drink?
ex.cn: 想喝一杯吗？

ex.en: She didn't fancy (= did not like) the idea of going home in the dark.
ex.cn: 她不想在黑夜里回家。

ex.en: Do you fancy going out this evening?
ex.cn: 今晚你想不想外出？

senses.def: to be sexually attracted to sb

ex.en: I think she fancies me.
ex.cn: 我觉得她对我动心了。

senses.def: to think that you are very popular, attractive or intelligent

ex.en: He started to chat to me and I could tell that he really fancied himself.
ex.cn: 他和我聊起天来，我看得出他确实自以为了不起。

senses.def: to like the idea of being sth or to believe, often wrongly, that you are sth

ex.en: She fancies herself (as) a serious actress.
ex.cn: 她自以为是严肃的演员。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or shocked by sth
senses.chn: （表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然

ex.en: Fancy! She's never been in a plane before.
ex.cn: 真想不到！她竟然从未坐过飞机。

ex.en: Fancy meeting you here!
ex.cn: 竟然在这儿遇到你！

ex.en: 'She remembered my name after all those years.' ' Fancy that! '
ex.cn: “过了那么多年她还记得我的名字。” “真是不可思议！”

senses.def: to think that sb/sth will win or be successful at sth, especially in a race
senses.chn: 认为…会成功；（尤指速度竞赛）认为…要赢

ex.en: Which horse do you fancy in the next race?
ex.cn: 下一轮赛马你认为哪匹马会赢？

ex.en: He's hoping to get the job but I don't fancy his chances.
ex.cn: 他希望得到那份工作，不过我认为他的机会不大。

senses.def: to believe or imagine sth

ex.en: She fancied (that) she could hear footsteps.
ex.cn: 她觉得好像听到了脚步声。

senses.def: something that you imagine; your imagination

ex.en: night-time fancies that disappear in the morning
ex.cn: 在早上逝去的夜间幻觉

ex.en: a child's wild flights of fancy
ex.cn: 孩子的异想天开

senses.def: a feeling that you would like to have or to do sth

ex.en: She said she wanted a dog but it was only a passing fancy.
ex.cn: 她说想要一条狗，但这不过是一时心血来潮。

senses.def: a small decorated cake
as/whenever, etc. you feel like doing sth
senses.chn: 当（或无论何时等）想做某事时

ex.en: We bought a camper van so we could go away whenever the fancy took us.
ex.cn: 我们买了一辆野营车，所以我们啥时想去野营就可以去。

senses.def: to attract or please sb

ex.en: She looked through the hotel advertisements until one of them caught her fancy.
ex.cn: 她仔细查看旅馆广告，终于有一家中了她的意。

senses.def: to start liking sb/sth, often without an obvious reason
senses.chn: 喜欢上，爱上（常指没有明显原因）

senses.def: to please or amuse sb

ex.en: See if any of these tickle your fancy.
ex.cn: 看看这里面是否有你喜欢的。

senses.def: unusually complicated, often in an unnecessary way; intended to impress other people

ex.en: a kitchen full of fancy gadgets
ex.cn: 有各式各样小器具的厨房

ex.en: They added a lot of fancy footwork to the dance.
ex.cn: 他们给这个舞蹈增加了许多复杂的舞步。

ex.en: He's always using fancy legal words.
ex.cn: 他总是使用异常复杂的法律词语。

senses.def: with a lot of decorations or bright colours
senses.chn: 精致的；有精美装饰的；绚丽的；花哨的

ex.en: fancy goods (= things sold as gifts or for decoration)
ex.cn: 饰物礼品

senses.def: expensive or connected with an expensive way of life

ex.en: fancy restaurants with fancy prices
ex.cn: 价格昂贵的豪华餐厅

ex.en: Don't come back with any fancy ideas.
ex.cn: 别又说什么美妙的空想。

senses.def: of high quality
clothes that you wear, especially at parties, to make you appear to be a different character

ex.en: guests in fancy dress
ex.cn: 身着化装服的客人们

ex.en: a fancy-dress party
ex.cn: 化装晚会

senses.def: free to do what you like because you are not emotionally involved with anyone

ex.en: I was still footloose and fancy-free (= free to enjoy myself) in those days.
ex.cn: 当时我仍然毫无牵挂、逍遥自在呢。

senses.def: the man/woman with whom a person is having a romantic relationship, especially when one or both of them is married to sb else
senses.chn: （尤指一方或双方已婚的）情夫，情妇

senses.def: the man/woman with whom a person is having a romantic relationship, especially when one or both of them is married to sb else
senses.chn: （尤指一方或双方已婚的）情夫，情妇

senses.def: a lively Spanish dance; a piece of music for this dance
senses.chn: 凡丹戈舞（节奏欢快的西班牙舞蹈）；凡丹戈舞曲

senses.def: a short loud piece of music that is played to celebrate sb/sth important arriving
senses.chn: 号角花彩，号角齐鸣（欢迎仪式等上奏的响亮短曲）

senses.def: a large amount of activity and discussion on television, in newspapers, etc. to celebrate sb/sth

ex.en: The product was launched amid much fanfare worldwide.
ex.cn: 这个产品在世界各地隆重推出。

senses.def: a type of literature, usually written on the Internet, by people who admire a particular novel, film/movie, etc., with characters taken from these stories
senses.chn: 同人小说（由某小说、电影等的爱好者创作，人物取自原作，常为网络文学）

senses.def: either of two long sharp teeth at the front of the mouths of some animals, such as a snake or dog
a small window above a door or another window
senses.chn: 气窗（门或窗上方的小窗）

senses.def: the female sex organs
a person's bottom
a small bag attached to a belt and worn around the waist, to keep money, etc. in
to spread out or spread sth out over an area

ex.en: The police fanned out to surround the house.
ex.cn: 警察散开包围了这座房子。

ex.en: The bird fanned out its tail feathers.
ex.cn: 这只鸟把尾羽展成扇形。

senses.def: a piece of music in a free form, often based on well-known tunes
to imagine that you are doing sth that you would like to do, or that sth that you would like to happen is happening, even though this is very unlikely

ex.en: He sometimes fantasized about winning the gold medal.
ex.cn: 他有时幻想赢得金牌的情景。

senses.def: extremely good; excellent

ex.en: a fantastic beach in Australia
ex.cn: 澳大利亚旖旎的海滩

ex.en: a fantastic achievement
ex.cn: 了不起的成就

ex.en: The weather was absolutely fantastic.
ex.cn: 天气十分宜人。

ex.en: You've got the job? Fantastic!
ex.cn: 你得到那工作了？太好了！

ex.en: We had a great time in Madrid.
ex.cn: 我们在马德里玩得很开心。

ex.en: I think their new song's really cool.
ex.cn: 我认为他们的新歌棒极了。

senses.def: very large; larger than you expected
senses.chn: 很大的；大得难以置信的

ex.en: The response to our appeal was fantastic.
ex.cn: 我们的呼吁引起十分强烈的反应。

ex.en: The car costs a fantastic amount of money.
ex.cn: 这轿车的价钱贵得吓人。

senses.def: strange and showing a lot of imagination
senses.chn: 怪诞的；荒诞不经的；富于想象的

ex.en: fantastic dreams of forests and jungles
ex.cn: 关于森林和热带丛林的怪梦

senses.def: impossible to put into practice
senses.chn: 不切实际的；无法实现的

ex.en: a fantastic scheme/project
ex.cn: 不切实际的计划／方案

senses.def: a pleasant situation that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen

ex.en: his childhood fantasies about becoming a famous football player
ex.cn: 他儿时想成为著名足球运动员的幻想

senses.def: a product of your imagination

ex.en: Her books are usually escapist fantasies.
ex.cn: 她的书通常是逃避现实的幻想作品。

senses.def: the act of imagining things; a person's imagination

ex.en: a work of fantasy
ex.cn: 幻想作品

ex.en: Stop living in a fantasy world.
ex.cn: 别再生活在幻想世界中了。

senses.def: a competition in which you choose players to make your own imaginary team, and score points according to the performance of the real players
senses.chn: 梦幻足球（虚幻比赛方式，组成想象中的球队，根据球员的实际比赛表现计算得分）

senses.def: a magazine that is written and read by fans of a musician, sports team, etc.
senses.chn: （音乐、体育等方面的）爱好者杂志

senses.def: used in writing to mean 'for the attention of' (written on a document or letter to say who should deal with it)
senses.chn: （书写形式）请…注意；（文件或书信用语）由…处理，由…办理

senses.def: used in writing to mean 'frequently asked questions'
senses.chn: 常问问题（全写为 frequently asked questions，书写形式）

senses.def: a long distance away

ex.en: We didn't go far.
ex.cn: 我们没有走远。

ex.en: Have you come far?
ex.cn: 你是远道来的吗？

ex.en: It's not far to the beach.
ex.cn: 到海滩不远。

ex.en: There's not far to go now.
ex.cn: 现在离得不远了。

ex.en: The restaurant is not far from here.
ex.cn: 餐厅离这儿不远。

ex.en: countries as far apart as Japan and Brazil
ex.cn: 像日本和巴西这样相隔遥远的国家

senses.def: used when you are asking or talking about the distance between two places or the distance that has been travelled or is to be travelled
senses.chn: （问到或谈及距离时说）有多远，远（至）

ex.en: How far is it to your house from here?
ex.cn: 从这儿到你家有多远？

ex.en: How much further is it?
ex.cn: 还有多远？

ex.en: We'll go by train as far as London, and then take a bus.
ex.cn: 我们坐火车到伦敦，然后转乘公共汽车。

ex.en: We didn't go as far as the others.
ex.cn: 我们不如其他人走得远。

ex.en: I'm not sure I can walk so far.
ex.cn: 我没有把握能步行这么远。

senses.def: a long time from the present; for a large part of a particular period of time

ex.en: The band made their first record as far back as 1990.
ex.cn: 这个乐队早在 1990 年就录制了他们的第一张唱片。

ex.en: Let's try to plan further ahead.
ex.cn: 咱们尽量计划得更长远些。

ex.en: We worked far into the night.
ex.cn: 我们工作到深夜。

senses.def: very much; to a great degree
senses.chn: 非常；很大程度上；远远；大大

ex.en: That's a far better idea.
ex.cn: 那个主意好得多。

ex.en: There are far more opportunities for young people than there used to be.
ex.cn: 现在年轻人的机会比过去多得多。

ex.en: It had been a success far beyond their expectations.
ex.cn: 成功之大远远超过他们的预期。

ex.en: He's fallen far behind in his work.
ex.cn: 他的工作大大落后了。

ex.en: She always gives us far too much homework.
ex.cn: 她总是让我们做多得不得了的家庭作业。

senses.def: used when you are asking or talking about the degree to which sth is true or possible
senses.chn: （问到或谈及程度时说）有多大，直（至）

ex.en: How far can we trust him?
ex.cn: 我们能够信任他到什么程度？

ex.en: His parents supported him as far as they could.
ex.cn: 他的父母全力支持他。

ex.en: Plan your route in advance, using main roads as far as possible.
ex.cn: 预先安排好你的路线，尽量走大路。

senses.def: used to talk about how much progress has been made in doing or achieving sth

ex.en: How far have you got with that report?
ex.cn: 你那个报告写得怎么样了？

ex.en: I read as far as the third chapter.
ex.cn: 我读到了第三章。

senses.def: to the horizon (= where the sky meets the land or sea)

ex.en: The bleak moorland stretched on all sides as far as the eye could see.
ex.cn: 荒凉的旷野向四面伸展开去，一望无际。

senses.def: used to say that you think you know, remember, understand, etc. sth but you cannot be completely sure, especially because you do not know all the facts
senses.chn: 就我所知；尽我所记得的；依我看

ex.en: As far as we knew, there was no cause for concern.
ex.cn: 就我们所知，没有什么需要担心的。

ex.en: As far as I can see, you've done nothing wrong.
ex.cn: 依我看，你没有做错任何事。

ex.en: She lived in Chicago, as far as I can remember.
ex.cn: 据我所记得的，她过去住在芝加哥。

senses.def: used to give your personal opinion on sth

ex.en: As far as I am concerned, you can do what you like.
ex.cn: 就我而言，你想干什么就可以干什么。

senses.def: used to give facts or an opinion about a particular aspect of sth
to a limited degree, usually less than is sufficient
senses.chn: 在一定程度上（通常指不足）

ex.en: It's a good plan as far as it goes, but there are a lot of things they haven't thought of.
ex.cn: 这计划还算不错，不过还有很多事情没有考虑到。

senses.def: by a great amount

ex.en: The last of these reasons is by far the most important.
ex.cn: 这些理由中最后一条比其他的重要得多。

ex.en: Amy is the smartest by far.
ex.cn: 埃米显然最聪明。

senses.def: to continue doing sth beyond reasonable limits
by a very great amount

ex.en: She's far and away the best player.
ex.cn: 她是当之无愧的最佳选手。

senses.def: over a large area

ex.en: They searched far and wide for the missing child.
ex.cn: 他们四处搜寻失踪的小孩。

senses.def: used when you are just about to disagree with sb or to criticize them and you would like them to think that you do not really want to do this
senses.chn: （要表示不同意和批评但又希望对方感到自己并非真正想要这样做）

ex.en: Far be it from me to interfere in your affairs but I would like to give you just one piece of advice.
ex.cn: 我绝不想干涉你的事，我只不过想给你一个忠告。

senses.def: almost the opposite of sth or of what is expected

ex.en: It is far from clear (= it is not clear) what he intends to do.
ex.cn: 他打算怎样做一点都不清楚。

ex.en: Computers, far from destroying jobs, can create employment.
ex.cn: 计算机远非破坏就业，而是能创造就业。

senses.def: used to say that the opposite of what sb says is true
senses.chn: 完全相反；绝非；远非如此

ex.en: 'You're not angry then?' 'Far from it. I've never laughed so much in my life.'
ex.cn: “那么你不生气？” “非但没有生气，我一生中还没有这样笑过呢。”

senses.def: to be very successful in the future

ex.en: She is very talented and should go far.
ex.cn: 她天赋很高，会很有出息。

senses.def: to achieve all that is wanted

ex.en: The new legislation is welcome but does not go far enough.
ex.cn: 新法规受到欢迎，但力度还不够大。

ex.en: Do these measures go far enough?
ex.cn: 这些措施能不能解决问题？

ex.en: Stop it now. The joke has gone far enough (= it has continued too long).
ex.cn: 行啦，这玩笑开得太久了。

senses.def: to be willing to go to extreme or surprising limits in dealing with sth

ex.en: I wouldn't go as far as to say that he's a liar (= but I think he may be slightly dishonest).
ex.cn: 我倒不想说他是个骗子（不过我认为他可能有点不老实）。

senses.def: to behave in an extreme way that is not acceptable

ex.en: He's always been quite crude, but this time he's gone too far.
ex.cn: 他一向很粗鲁，但这次太过分了。

ex.en: I never thought she'd go this far.
ex.cn: 我绝没有想到她会做得这么过分。

senses.def: to the degree that

ex.en: That's the truth, in so far as I know it.
ex.cn: 就我所知，那是真实情况。

senses.def: almost correct

ex.en: Your guess wasn't far out at all.
ex.cn: 你猜得几乎一点不错。

senses.def: to not be enough to buy a lot of things
senses.chn: 不够买，买不了（许多东西）

ex.en: Five pounds doesn't go very far these days.
ex.cn: 这年头五英镑买不了多少东西。

senses.def: to not be enough for what is needed

ex.en: Four bottles of wine won't go far among twenty people.
ex.cn: 四瓶酒不够二十人喝。

senses.def: until now; up to this point
senses.chn: 到目前为止；迄今为止；到这点为止

ex.en: What do you think of the show so far?
ex.cn: 到目前为止你觉得这场演出怎么样？

ex.en: Detectives are so far at a loss to explain the reason for his death.
ex.cn: 至今侦探仍茫然无法解释他的死因。

senses.def: only to a limited degree
senses.chn: 仅到一定程度；只在有限范围内

ex.en: I trust him only so far.
ex.cn: 我只相信他到这个程度。

senses.def: used to say that things have been successful until now and you hope that they will continue to be successful, but you know that the task, etc. is not finished yet
senses.chn: 到目前为止，一切还算顺利

senses.def: far away from home; to or in places that are not near
senses.chn: 远离家乡；去远处；在远方

ex.en: You can hire a car if you want to explore further afield.
ex.cn: 假如你想逛更远的地方，可以租辆汽车。

ex.en: Journalists came from as far afield as China.
ex.cn: 新闻记者有的来自遥远的中国。

senses.def: not frequent; not happening often
used to comment on sth that was almost successful but in fact failed
at a greater distance away from you

ex.en: I saw her on the far side of the road.
ex.cn: 我看见她在马路那头。

ex.en: at the far end of the room
ex.cn: 在房间的另一头

ex.en: They made for an empty table in the far corner.
ex.cn: 他们走向远处那个角落的空桌子。

senses.def: at the furthest point in a particular direction

ex.en: the far north of Scotland
ex.cn: 苏格兰的最北边

ex.en: Who is that on the far left of the photograph?
ex.cn: 相片上最左边的那个人是谁？

ex.en: She is on the far right of the party (= holds extreme right-wing political views).
ex.cn: 她是党内的极右分子。

senses.def: a long distance away

ex.en: a far country
ex.cn: 远方的国家

senses.def: a very different experience from sth
senses.chn: 和…相去甚远；与…大相径庭

senses.def: a unit for measuring capacitance
by a very great amount

ex.en: She's far and away the best player.
ex.cn: 她是当之无愧的最佳选手。

senses.def: over a large area

ex.en: They searched far and wide for the missing child.
ex.cn: 他们四处搜寻失踪的小孩。

senses.def: a long distance away

ex.en: a war in a faraway country
ex.cn: 在一个远方国家发生的战争

senses.def: an expression on your face that shows that your thoughts are far away from your present surroundings
senses.chn: 心不在焉的；恍惚的；出神的

senses.def: a funny play for the theatre based on ridiculous and unlikely situations and events; this type of writing or performance
senses.chn: 滑稽戏（剧本）；闹剧（剧本）；笑剧（剧本）

ex.en: a bedroom farce (= a funny play about sex)
ex.cn: 床上笑剧

senses.def: a situation or an event that is so unfair or badly organized that it becomes ridiculous

ex.en: The trial was a complete farce.
ex.cn: 这次审判完全是一场闹剧。

senses.def: ridiculous and not worth taking seriously

ex.en: It was a farcical trial.
ex.cn: 那是一次荒唐的审判。

ex.en: a situation verging on the farcical
ex.cn: 近乎荒唐的场面

senses.def: the money that you pay to travel by bus, plane, taxi, etc.

ex.en: bus/taxi fares
ex.cn: 公共汽车费；出租汽车费

ex.en: train/rail fares
ex.cn: 火车票价

ex.en: Children travel (at) half fare.
ex.cn: 儿童交通费减半。

ex.en: When do they start paying full fare?
ex.cn: 他们什么时候开始买全票？

ex.cn: 他认真仔细地准备着这个盛大的日子。

senses.def: not liking things to be dirty or untidy

ex.cn: 她不过分讲究个人卫生。

senses.def: the part of a major road such as a motorway or interstate where vehicles drive fastest

senses.def: where things are most exciting and where a lot is happening

ex.en: He had a good job, plenty of money and he was enjoying life in the fast lane.
ex.cn: 他有份好工作，钱又多，尽情享受着丰富多彩的生活。

senses.def: a place that is thought to be safe because it is difficult to get to or easy to defend
a quick way to achieve sth, for example a high position in a job
senses.chn: 快速晋升之道；迅速成功之路

senses.def: to make sb's progress in achieving sth, for example a high position in a job, quicker than usual
having too much flesh on it and weighing too much

ex.cn: 大胖男人／女人

ex.en: You'll get fat if you eat so much chocolate.
ex.cn: 你如果吃这么多巧克力是会发胖的。

ex.en: He grew fatter and fatter.
ex.cn: 他愈来愈胖了。

ex.en: fat flabby legs
ex.cn: 肥胖松弛的双腿

ex.cn: 我穿这连衣裙显胖吗？

ex.en: I'm a bit overweight.
ex.cn: 我有点超重。

ex.en: a fat volume on American history
ex.cn: 厚厚的一册美国史

senses.def: large in quantity; worth a lot of money

ex.en: a fat sum/profit
ex.cn: 一大笔款子；丰厚的利润

ex.en: He gave me a nice fat cheque.
ex.cn: 他给了我一张大额支票。

senses.def: used for saying that you do not believe sth is likely to happen

ex.en: 'They might let us in without tickets.' 'Fat chance of that!'
ex.cn: “他们也许会让我们免票入场。” “别痴心妄想了！”

senses.def: not at all good or useful

ex.cn: 保罗不会开车，所以我手臂骨折时他一点忙也没帮上。

senses.chn: 最后才能见输赢；不到最后，结果难料

ex.cn: 多余的体内脂肪

ex.en: This ham has too much fat on it.
ex.cn: 这块火腿肥肉太多。

senses.def: a solid or liquid substance from animals or plants, treated so that it becomes pure for use in cooking

ex.en: Cook the meat in shallow fat.
ex.cn: 用少许油煎肉。

senses.def: animal and vegetable fats, when you are thinking of them as part of what a person eats

ex.en: You should cut down on fats and carbohydrates.
ex.cn: 你应该减少摄入脂肪和碳水化合物。

ex.en: foods which are low in fat
ex.cn: 低脂肪食物

ex.en: reduced-fat margarines
ex.cn: 低脂人造黄油

senses.def: to have a long friendly talk with sb about sth
to have enough money to be able to afford expensive things, food, drink, etc.
senses.chn: 过奢侈的生活；锦衣玉食

senses.def: causing or ending in death

ex.en: a fatal accident/blow/illness
ex.cn: 致命的事故／一击／疾病

ex.en: a potentially fatal form of cancer
ex.cn: 潜在致死型癌症

ex.en: If she gets ill again it could prove fatal.
ex.cn: 如果她再患病，就会有性命之忧。

senses.def: causing disaster or failure
senses.chn: 灾难性的；毁灭性的；导致失败的

ex.en: a fatal error/mistake
ex.cn: 灾难性的错误

ex.en: Any delay would be fatal.
ex.cn: 任何延误都可能导致失败。

ex.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
ex.cn: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

ex.en: It'd be fatal to try and stop them now.
ex.cn: 现在要试图制止他们就会导致灾难性后果。

showing a belief in fate and feeling that you cannot control events or stop them from happening
a death that is caused in an accident or a war, or by violence or disease

ex.en: Several people were injured, but there were no fatalities.
ex.cn: 有几个人受伤，但没有人死亡。

senses.def: the fact that a particular disease will result in death

ex.en: to reduce the fatality of certain types of cancer
ex.cn: 降低某些癌症的致命性

ex.en: Different forms of cancer have different fatality rates.
ex.cn: 不同类型的癌症死亡率也不同。

senses.def: the belief or feeling that we have no control over what happens to us

ex.en: A sense of fatality gripped her.
ex.cn: 一种命中注定的意识控制着她。

senses.def: an organized holiday/vacation for fat children during which they are helped to lose weight
a person who earns, or who has, a lot of money (especially when compared to people who do not earn so much)
the things, especially bad things, that will happen or have happened to sb/sth
senses.chn: 命中注定的事（尤指坏事）；命运的安排
