ex.cn: 这三个人命运未卜。

ex.en: She sat outside, waiting to find out her fate.
ex.cn: 她坐在外面，等待命运对她作出的安排。

ex.en: The court will decide our fate/fates.
ex.cn: 法庭将决定我们的命运。

ex.en: Each of the managers suffered the same fate.
ex.cn: 每一个经理命运都是如此。

ex.en: The government had abandoned the refugees to their fate.
ex.cn: 政府抛弃了难民，让他们听天由命。

ex.en: From that moment our fate was sealed (= our future was decided).
ex.cn: 从那时起我们的命运就已经注定了。

senses.def: the power that is believed to control everything that happens and that cannot be stopped or changed

ex.en: Fate was kind to me that day.
ex.cn: 那天我很幸运。

ex.en: By a strange twist of fate, Andy and I were on the same plane.
ex.cn: 由于命运的奇特安排，我和安迪乘坐了同一架飞机。

ex.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
ex.cn: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

ex.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
ex.cn: 这结果可能纯属意外。

ex.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
ex.cn: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

ex.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
ex.cn: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

senses.def: a terrible thing that could happen
to do sth too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end
unable to escape a particular fate; certain to happen because everything is controlled by fate
senses.chn: 命中注定的；命运决定的

ex.en: We were fated never to meet again.
ex.cn: 我们注定了永远不能再相见。

ex.en: He believes that everything in life is fated.
ex.cn: 他相信生命中的一切都是注定的。

senses.def: having an important, often very bad, effect on future events
senses.chn: 对未来有重大（负面）影响的

ex.en: She looked back now to that fateful day in December.
ex.cn: 她现在回顾十二月里那决定性的一天。

senses.def: used to refer to mistakes that are made when typing, usually because one finger hits two keys at the same time
senses.chn: “胖手指”，打字错误（通常因一指同时击两键造成）

ex.en: The data was all wrong—it must have been a case of fat finger!
ex.cn: 数据全错了——这一定是 “胖手指” 造成的！

ex.en: The document was full of fat-finger mistakes.
ex.cn: 文件中打字错误比比皆是。

senses.def: not containing any fat

ex.en: fat-free yogurt
ex.cn: 脱脂酸奶

senses.def: a male parent of a child or an animal; a person who is acting as the father to a child

ex.en: Ben's a wonderful father.
ex.cn: 本是个极好的父亲。

ex.en: You've been like a father to me.
ex.cn: 你对我一直像父亲一样。

ex.en: Our new boss is a father of three (= he has three children).
ex.cn: 我们的新老板是三个孩子的父亲。

ex.en: He was a wonderful father to both his natural and adopted children.
ex.cn: 他对亲生的和领养的子女都很好。

ex.en: Father, I cannot lie to you.
ex.cn: 爸爸，我不能对你说谎。

senses.def: a person's ancestors (= people who are related to you who lived in the past)

ex.en: the land of our fathers
ex.cn: 我们祖先的土地

senses.def: the first man to introduce a new way of thinking about sth or of doing sth
senses.chn: 创始人；奠基者；先驱；鼻祖

ex.en: Henry Moore is considered to be the father of modern British sculpture.
ex.cn: 亨利 · 穆尔被认为是现代英国雕塑之父。

senses.def: used by Christians to refer to God

ex.en: Father, forgive us.
ex.cn: 天父，宽恕我们吧。

ex.en: God the Father
ex.cn: 天父

senses.def: the title of a priest, especially in the Roman Catholic Church and the Orthodox Church
senses.chn: （尤指天主教和东正教的）神父

ex.en: Father Dominic
ex.cn: 多米尼克神父

senses.def: from one generation of a family to the next
used to say that a son's character or behaviour is similar to that of his father
very much older than sb (especially used to suggest that a romantic or sexual relationship between the two people is not appropriate)
senses.chn: 论年龄足以当某人的爹／娘（尤指双方在爱情或性关系方面不相配）

senses.def: we believe a thing because we want it to be true
to become the father of a child by making a woman pregnant

ex.en: He claims to have fathered over 20 children.
ex.cn: 他声称有 20 多个亲生子女。

senses.def: to create new ideas or a new way of doing sth
senses.chn: 创立（新思想）；创造，发明（新方法）

senses.def: an older man that sb respects because he will advise and help them like a father
senses.chn: 父亲般的人；受尊敬的人；长者

senses.def: the state of being a father
the father of your husband or wife
(used especially about Germany) the country where a person, or their family, was born, especially when they feel very loyal towards it
without a father, either because he has died or because he does not live with his children

ex.en: fatherless children/families
ex.cn: 没有父亲的孩子／家庭

senses.def: typical of a good father

ex.en: fatherly advice
ex.cn: 慈父般的忠告

ex.en: He keeps a fatherly eye on his players.
ex.cn: 他像父亲一样照管着他的球员。

senses.def: a day when fathers receive cards and gifts from their children, usually the third Sunday in June
senses.chn: 父亲节（通常为六月的第三个星期日）

senses.def: an imaginary figure who represents time and looks like an old man carrying a scythe and an hourglass
senses.chn: 时间老人（手拿镰刀和沙漏、象征时间的虚构人物）

senses.def: to understand or find an explanation for sth
senses.chn: 理解；彻底了解；弄清真相

ex.en: It is hard to fathom the pain felt at the death of a child.
ex.cn: 丧子之痛是难以体会的。

ex.en: He couldn't fathom out what the man could possibly mean.
ex.cn: 他弄不清这个男人的意思。

senses.def: a unit for measuring the depth of water, equal to 6 feet or 1.8 metres
senses.chn: 英寻（计量水深的单位，合 6 英尺或 1.8 米）

ex.en: The ship sank in 20 fathoms.
ex.cn: 船沉在水下 20 英寻处。

ex.en: She kept her feelings hidden fathoms deep.
ex.cn: 她把感情深深地隐藏在心中。

senses.def: a feeling of being extremely tired, usually because of hard work or exercise

ex.en: physical and mental fatigue
ex.cn: 精疲力竭

ex.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
ex.cn: 这个事故是驾驶员疲劳所致。

ex.en: I was dropping with fatigue and could not keep my eyes open.
ex.cn: 我快要累倒了，眼睛也睁不开了。

senses.def: a feeling of not wanting to do a particular activity any longer because you have done too much of it

ex.en: battle fatigue
ex.cn: 战斗疲劳

senses.def: weakness in metal or wood caused by repeated bending or stretching

ex.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
ex.cn: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

senses.def: loose clothes worn by soldiers
duties, such as cleaning and cooking, that soldiers have to do, especially as a punishment
senses.chn: 士兵杂役（尤指作为惩罚，如做打扫、帮厨）

senses.def: very tired, both physically and mentally
very tiring, both physically and mentally
senses.chn: 令人身心交瘁的；劳心劳力的

senses.def: to make sb/sth fatter, especially an animal before killing it for food; to become fatter
senses.chn: （使）长胖，长肥；（尤指动物宰杀前）育肥

ex.en: The piglets are taken from the sow to be fattened for market.
ex.cn: 这些小猪被从母猪身边带走，好育肥上市。

ex.en: She's very thin after her illness—but we'll soon fatten her up.
ex.cn: 她病后瘦得很，不过我们会使她迅速胖起来的。

senses.def: likely to make you fat

ex.en: fattening cakes
ex.cn: 吃了会发胖的蛋糕

senses.def: unfair treatment of people because of their large body size
containing a lot of fat; consisting of fat
senses.chn: 富含脂肪的；肥胖的；脂肪的

ex.en: fatty foods
ex.cn: 高脂食物

ex.en: fatty tissue
ex.cn: 脂肪组织

senses.def: a fat person

ex.en: Britain is fast becoming a nation of fatties.
ex.cn: 英国很快就会变成胖子国。

senses.def: an acid that is found in fats and oils
stupid

ex.cn: 愚蠢的话语；龇牙咧嘴的傻笑

senses.def: a decision or order made under Islamic law
senses.chn: 法特瓦（伊斯兰律法的裁决或教令）

senses.def: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe

ex.en: the hot/cold faucet
ex.cn: 热水／冷水龙头

ex.en: to turn a faucet on/off
ex.cn: 开／关龙头

senses.def: the responsibility for sth wrong that has happened or been done

ex.en: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?
ex.cn: 不是我的错为什么要我道歉？

ex.en: It's nobody's fault.
ex.cn: 谁都没有错。

ex.en: It was his fault that we were late.
ex.cn: 我们迟到责任在他。

ex.en: It's your own fault for being careless.
ex.cn: 你粗心大意是你自己的过失。

ex.en: Many people live in poverty through no fault of their own.
ex.cn: 很多人生活贫困并非他们自己有什么过错。

ex.en: I think the owners are at fault (= responsible) for not warning us.
ex.cn: 我认为业主没有提醒我们是有责任的。

ex.en: He's proud of his children and blind to their faults.
ex.cn: 他为孩子们感到自豪，对他们的缺点视而不见。

ex.en: I love her for all her faults (= in spite of them).
ex.cn: 尽管她有这么多缺点，我还是爱她。

senses.def: something that is wrong or not perfect; something that is wrong with a machine or system that stops it from working correctly

ex.en: The book's virtues far outweigh its faults.
ex.cn: 这本书优点远远大于缺点。

ex.en: The system, for all its faults, is the best available at the moment.
ex.cn: 这个系统虽然缺点不少，却是现有最好的一个。

ex.en: a major fault in the design
ex.cn: 设计中的一个重大失误

ex.en: a structural fault
ex.cn: 结构缺陷

ex.en: an electrical fault
ex.cn: 电路故障

senses.def: a mistake made when serving

ex.en: He has served a number of double faults in this set.
ex.cn: 他在这盘发球出现了一些双误。

senses.def: a place where there is a break that is longer than usual in the layers of rock in the earth's crust

ex.en: the San Andreas fault
ex.cn: 圣安德烈亚斯断层

ex.en: a fault line
ex.cn: 断层线

senses.def: used to say that sb has a lot, or even too much, of a particular good quality

ex.en: She is generous to a fault.
ex.cn: 她过分慷慨。

senses.def: to look for and discover mistakes in sb/sth; to complain about sb/sth
to find a mistake or a weakness in sb/sth

ex.en: Her colleagues could not fault her dedication to the job.
ex.cn: 她的同事认为她的敬业精神是无可挑剔的。

ex.en: He had always been polite—she couldn't fault him on that.
ex.cn: 他总是彬彬有礼，在这方面她对他无可指摘。

senses.def: the act of looking for faults in sb/sth
having no mistakes
senses.chn: 没有错误的；无缺点的；完美无缺的

ex.en: faultless English
ex.cn: 完美的英语

senses.def: not perfect; not working or made correctly
senses.chn: 不完美的；有错误的；有缺陷的

ex.en: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
ex.cn: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

ex.en: faulty workmanship
ex.cn: 不完美的做工

ex.en: an accident caused by a faulty signal
ex.cn: 错误信号造成的事故

senses.def: wrong or containing mistakes, often resulting in bad decisions

ex.en: faulty reasoning
ex.cn: 错误推理

senses.def: (in ancient Roman stories) a god of the woods, with a man's face and body and a goat's legs and horns
senses.chn: 农牧神（见于古罗马故事，呈人面人身羊腿羊角）

senses.def: all the animals living in an area or in a particular period of history
senses.chn: （某地区或某时期的）动物群，动物区系

ex.en: the local flora and fauna (= plants and animals)
ex.cn: 当地动植物群

ex.en: land and marine faunas
ex.cn: 陆地和海洋动物区系

senses.def: an agreement in which sb agrees to do sth bad or dishonest, in return for money, success or power
senses.chn: 浮士德式的（交易或协议）（为获得财富、成功或权力而不择手段）

senses.def: because there is nothing else that is better

ex.en: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
ex.cn: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。

senses.def: a member of a group of French painters who were important in Fauvism
a style of painting that uses bright colours and in which objects and people are represented in a non-realistic way. It was popular in Paris for a short period from 1905.
senses.chn: 野兽派，野兽主义（一种绘画风格，以鲜明色彩和非现实主义方式表现物体和人物，从 1905 年起在巴黎流行一时）

senses.def: artificial, but intended to look or seem real

ex.en: The chairs were covered in faux animal skin.
ex.cn: 椅子套是人造兽皮的。

ex.en: His accent was so faux.
ex.cn: 他的口音听上去很假。

senses.def: an action or a remark that causes embarrassment because it is not socially correct
senses.chn: 有失检点；失态；失礼；失言

senses.def: a type of round, pale green bean grow together inside a fat pod. Several fava beans grow together inside a fat pod.
a favourite person or thing

ex.en: That song is one of my faves.
ex.cn: 这是我特别喜爱的歌曲之一。

senses.def: a poor area in or near a Brazilian city, with many small houses that are close together and in bad condition
senses.chn: （巴西城市或边缘的）棚户区，贫民窟

senses.def: an icon (1) associated with a website, that usually appears in the line near the top of a page on an Internet browser (1) (= a small symbol) associated with a website, that usually appears in the line near the top of a page on an Internet browser (1) where the address for that website is also displayed
senses.chn: 网页图标，网站头像（通常出现在浏览器页面顶端的网址框）

senses.def: a thing that you do to help sb

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and pick up Sam from school today?
ex.cn: 今天你能帮我个忙去学校接萨姆吗？

ex.en: Can I ask a favour?
ex.cn: 请帮个忙行吗？

ex.en: I would never ask for any favours from her.
ex.cn: 我再也不会请她帮任何忙了。

ex.en: I'm going as a favour to Ann, not because I want to.
ex.cn: 我去是给安一个面子，而不是我想去。

ex.en: I'll ask Steve to take it. He owes me a favour.
ex.cn: 我要让史蒂夫接受，他欠我一个人情。

ex.en: Thanks for helping me out. I'll return the favour (= help you because you have helped me) some time.
ex.cn: 多谢你帮了我个大忙。总有一天我会报答你的。

senses.def: approval or support for sb/sth

ex.en: The suggestion to close the road has found favour with (= been supported by) local people.
ex.cn: 关闭这条路的建议已得到当地人的支持。

ex.en: The programme has lost favour with viewers recently.
ex.cn: 近来这个节目已不受观众欢迎。

ex.en: an athlete who fell from favour after a drugs scandal
ex.cn: 在毒品丑闻以后不再受人喜爱的运动员

ex.en: The government looks with favour upon (= approves of) the report's recommendations.
ex.cn: 政府赞同报告所提出的建议。

ex.en: She's not in favour with (= supported or liked by) the media just now.
ex.cn: 目前她没有媒体的捧场。

ex.en: It seems Tim is back in favour with the boss (= the boss likes him again).
ex.cn: 看来蒂姆又赢得了老板的好感。

senses.def: treatment that is generous to one person or group in a way that seems unfair to others

ex.en: As an examiner, she showed no favour to any candidate.
ex.cn: 作为主考人她没有偏袒任何应试者。

senses.def: agreement to have sex with sb

ex.en: demands for sexual favours
ex.cn: 对性交的要求

senses.def: to do sth that is not helpful to sb or that gives a bad impression of them
senses.chn: 无助于某人；给某人留下坏印象

ex.en: You're not doing yourself any favours, working for nothing.

ex.cn: 收费学校

ex.en: a low hourly rate of pay
ex.cn: 按小时支付的低报酬

ex.en: interest rates
ex.cn: 利率

ex.en: an admission charge
ex.cn: 入场费

senses.def: an amount of money that you pay to join an organization, or to do sth

ex.en: membership fees
ex.cn: 会费

ex.en: There is no entrance fee to the gallery.
ex.cn: 这个美术陈列馆不收门票。

senses.def: very weak

ex.en: a feeble old man
ex.cn: 衰弱的老人

ex.en: The heartbeat was feeble and irregular.
ex.cn: 心搏无力，心律不齐。

senses.def: not effective; not showing determination or energy
senses.chn: 无效的；缺乏决心的；无力的

ex.en: a feeble argument/excuse/joke
ex.cn: 无力的证据；站不住脚的借口；不好笑的笑话

ex.en: a feeble attempt to explain
ex.cn: 无力的试图解释

ex.en: Don't be so feeble! Tell her you don't want to go.
ex.cn: 别那么软弱了！告诉她你不想去。

senses.def: having less than usual intelligence
weak and unable to make decisions
senses.chn: 意志薄弱的；优柔寡断的；无决断的

senses.def: to give food to a person or an animal
senses.chn: 给（人或动物）食物；喂养；饲养

ex.en: Have you fed the cat yet?
ex.cn: 你喂了猫没有？

ex.en: The baby can't feed itself yet (= can't put food into its own mouth).
ex.cn: 这个婴儿还不能自己吃东西。

ex.en: The cattle are fed (on) barley.
ex.cn: 牛要喂大麦。

ex.en: The barley is fed to the cattle.
ex.cn: 牛喂的是大麦。

senses.def: to eat food

ex.en: Slugs and snails feed at night.
ex.cn: 蛞蝓和蜗牛夜间进食。

senses.def: to provide food for a family or group of people

ex.en: They have a large family to feed.
ex.cn: 他们要养活一大家人。

ex.en: There's enough here to feed an army.
ex.cn: 这儿的东西足以养活一支军队。

senses.def: to give a plant a special substance to make it grow

ex.en: Feed the plants once a week.
ex.cn: 每星期要给这些花草施一次肥。

senses.def: to give advice, information, etc. to sb/sth
senses.chn: 提供（意见或信息等）；灌输

ex.en: We are constantly fed gossip and speculation by the media.
ex.cn: 媒体不断给我们灌输流言蜚语和猜测臆断。

ex.en: Gossip and speculation are constantly fed to us by the media.
ex.cn: 媒体不断把流言蜚语和猜测臆断灌输给我们。

senses.def: to supply sth to sb/sth

ex.en: The electricity line is fed with power through an underground cable.
ex.cn: 这条电线的电源是通过地下电缆传输的。

ex.en: Power is fed into the electricity line through an underground cable.
ex.cn: 电力通过地下电缆传输到这条电线。

senses.def: to put or push sth into or through a machine
senses.chn: 把…放进机器；将…塞进机器

ex.en: He fed the meter with coins.
ex.cn: 他把硬币投入停车计时收费器。

ex.en: He fed coins into the meter.
ex.cn: 他把硬币投入停车计时收费器。

ex.en: The fabric is fed through the machine.
ex.cn: 布料放进了机器。

senses.def: to satisfy a need, desire, etc. and keep it strong

ex.en: For drug addicts, the need to feed the addiction takes priority over everything else.
ex.cn: 对于吸毒者来说满足毒瘾胜过一切。

senses.def: to eat a lot of food or too much food
to harm sb who has helped you or supported you
to have an influence on the development of sth by reacting to it in some way
senses.chn: 反过来影响（事物的发展）

ex.en: What the audience tells me feeds back into my work.
ex.cn: 观众给我提的意见反过来对我的作品起到了促进作用。

senses.def: to give information or opinions about sth, especially so that it can be improved

ex.en: Test results will be fed back to the schools.
ex.cn: 测验的成绩将反馈给各学校。

senses.def: to have an influence on the development of sth

ex.en: The report's findings will feed into company policy.
ex.cn: 公司的政策将会考虑到报告的调研结果。

senses.def: to eat sth

ex.en: Butterflies feed on the flowers of garden plants.
ex.cn: 蝴蝶以园林中草木的花为食。

senses.def: to become stronger because of sth else
senses.chn: 因…而壮大；从…中得到滋养

ex.en: Racism feeds on fear.
ex.cn: 恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

senses.def: to reach sb/sth after going through a process or system

ex.en: It will take time for the higher rates to feed through to investors.
ex.cn: 需要时日投资者才能最终得到较高的回报率。

senses.def: to give a lot of food to sb to make them fatter or stronger
a meal of milk for a young baby; a meal for an animal
senses.chn: （婴儿的）一次喂奶，一餐；（动物的）一次喂给的饲料

ex.en: her morning feed
ex.cn: 她早上的一次喂奶

senses.def: food for animals or plants
senses.chn: 动物的饲料；植物的肥料

ex.en: winter feed for the horses
ex.cn: 马的冬季饲料

senses.def: material supplied to a machine
a pipe, device, etc. which supplies a machine with sth

ex.en: the cold feed to the water cylinder
ex.cn: 水缸的冷进水管

ex.en: The printer has an automatic paper feed.
ex.cn: 这台打印机有自动进纸装置。

senses.def: a large meal

ex.en: They needed a bath and a good feed.
ex.cn: 他们需要洗个澡，饱餐一顿。

senses.def: television programmes that are sent from a central station to other stations in a network; the system of sending out these programmes
senses.chn: （电视中心台）网络供给节目（系统）

ex.en: network feed
ex.cn: 网络供给节目系统

senses.def: a special feature on a blog, news website, social networking website, etc. that allows you to see new information that has been added without having to visit the website, usually using a feed reader (= a piece of software that displays this information)
senses.chn: （博客、新闻网站、社交网站等的）信息推送，信息订阅功能

ex.en: an RSS feed
ex.cn: 简易信息聚合订阅

senses.def: advice, criticism or information about how good or useful sth or sb's work is

ex.en: I'd appreciate some feedback on my work.
ex.cn: 如果有人对我的工作提出意见我将感激不尽。

ex.en: The teacher will give you feedback on the test.
ex.cn: 老师会对你的测验提供反馈信息。

ex.en: We need both positive and negative feedback from our customers.
ex.cn: 我们需要顾客正反两方面的反馈意见。

senses.def: the unpleasant noise produced by electrical equipment such as an amplifier when some of the power returns to the system
a bag containing food for a horse, that you hang from its head
an animal or plant that eats a particular thing or eats in a particular way
senses.chn: （动植物）进某种食物者，以…方式进食者

ex.en: plankton feeders
ex.cn: 以浮游生物为食者

senses.def: a part of a machine that supplies sth to another part of the machine
a container filled with food for birds or animals
leading to a bigger road, etc.

ex.en: a feeder road to the motorway/freeway
ex.cn: 汇入高速公路的支路

senses.def: supplying goods, services, etc. to a large organization
senses.chn: （向大机构）供应商品的，提供服务的

senses.def: kept to be killed and used for meat
a school from which most of the children go to a particular secondary school or college in the same area
senses.chn: 直属学校（学生毕业后大多进入本地区特定中学或高校）

senses.def: the act of giving food to a person, an animal or a plant

ex.en: breast/bottle feeding
ex.cn: 母乳／奶瓶喂养

senses.def: a plastic bottle with a rubber top which a baby or young animal can suck milk through
an occasion when a group of sharks or other fish attack sth
a situation in which a lot of people compete with each other in an excited way because they want to get sth
senses.chn: （对某物的）集体狂热追求，疯狂竞争

senses.def: to have an influence on the development of sth

ex.en: The report's findings will feed into company policy.
ex.cn: 公司的政策将会考虑到报告的调研结果。

senses.def: a piece of software that you use to see new information that has been added on a blog, news website, social networking website, etc. without having to visit the website
senses.chn: 推送阅读器，订阅器（用户无须访问网站便可看到博客、新闻网站、社交网站等的更新信息）

senses.def: food for farm animals, especially food that has been processed
to eat a lot of food or too much food
to experience a particular feeling or emotion

ex.en: The heat made him feel faint.
ex.cn: 炎热使他觉得快要晕倒了。

ex.en: She sounded more confident than she felt.
ex.cn: 她的语气听起来比她本人的感觉要有信心。

ex.en: I was feeling guilty.
ex.cn: 我感到歉疚。

ex.en: You'll feel better after a good night's sleep.
ex.cn: 你晚上睡个好觉就会觉得舒服些。

ex.en: She felt betrayed.
ex.cn: 她感到被出卖了。

ex.en: I feel sorry for him.
ex.cn: 我为他感到可惜。

senses.def: to notice or be aware of sth because it is touching you or having a physical effect on you
senses.chn: （通过触觉）注意到，意识到，感觉到

ex.en: I could feel the warm sun on my back.
ex.cn: 我背上感受到了阳光的温暖。

ex.en: She could not feel her legs.
ex.cn: 她的双腿失去了知觉。

ex.en: He felt a hand on his shoulder.
ex.cn: 他感到有只手在他肩上。

ex.en: He felt a hand touching his shoulder.
ex.cn: 他感到有只手在触摸他的肩膀。

ex.en: She could feel herself blushing.
ex.cn: 她可以感到脸都红了。

ex.en: I felt something crawl up my arm.
ex.cn: 我觉得有个东西顺着手臂往上爬。

senses.def: to become aware of sth even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.

ex.en: Can you feel the tension in this room?
ex.cn: 你能感觉到这房间里的紧张气氛吗？

senses.def: to give you a particular feeling or impression

ex.en: It felt strange to be back in my old school.
ex.cn: 我回到母校有一种生疏的感觉。

ex.en: My mouth felt completely dry.
ex.cn: 我感到口干舌燥。

ex.en: The interview only took ten minutes, but it felt like hours.
ex.cn: 面试只用了十分钟，但觉得像几个小时似的。

ex.en: It feels like rain (= seems likely to rain).
ex.cn: 好像快要下雨了。

ex.en: Her head felt as if it would burst.
ex.cn: 她觉得头要爆裂了。

ex.en: It felt as though he had run a marathon.
ex.cn: 他感到好像跑了一个马拉松似的。

senses.def: to have a particular physical quality which you become aware of by touching

ex.en: The water feels warm.
ex.cn: 这水摸着很暖。

ex.en: Its skin feels really smooth.
ex.cn: 它的皮摸起来真光滑。

ex.en: This wallet feels like leather.
ex.cn: 这个钱包摸上去像是皮的。

senses.def: to deliberately move your fingers over sth in order to find out what it is like

ex.en: Can you feel the bump on my head?
ex.cn: 你能摸到我头上那个肿块吗？

ex.en: Try to tell what this is just by feeling it.
ex.cn: 凭手摸摸说出这是什么东西。

ex.en: Feel how rough this is.
ex.cn: 摸摸这有多粗糙。

senses.def: to think or believe that sth is the case; to have a particular opinion or attitude

ex.en: We all felt (that) we were unlucky to lose.
ex.cn: 我们都认为我们输了是运气不好。

ex.en: I felt (that) I had to apologize.
ex.cn: 我以为我得道歉。

ex.en: She felt it to be her duty to tell the police.
ex.cn: 她认为她有责任报警。

ex.en: She felt it her duty to tell the police.
ex.cn: 她认为报警是她的义务。

ex.en: I felt it advisable to do nothing.
ex.cn: 我觉得最好不要作出行动。

ex.en: This is something I feel strongly about.
ex.cn: 这事令我感触颇深。

senses.def: to experience the effects or results of sth, often strongly
senses.chn: 受（强烈）影响；（深深）体验到

ex.en: He feels the cold a lot.
ex.cn: 他很怕冷。

ex.en: Cathy was really feeling the heat.
ex.cn: 凯茜真的感到很热。

ex.en: She felt her mother's death very deeply.
ex.cn: 她深感丧母之痛。

ex.en: The effects of the recession are being felt everywhere.
ex.cn: 经济衰退的影响无所不在。

ex.en: We all felt the force of her arguments.
ex.cn: 我们都体会到了她的论据的分量。

senses.def: to search for sth with your hands, feet, etc.

ex.en: He felt in his pockets for some money.
ex.cn: 他在口袋里摸着想找一些钱。

ex.en: I had to feel about in the dark for the light switch.
ex.cn: 我得在黑暗中摸索寻找电灯开关。

senses.def: to realize that you are getting old, especially compared with people you are with who are younger than you
senses.chn: （尤指与较年轻者比）感到自己上年纪了，意识到自己老了

senses.def: to think or imagine that other people are talking about you
senses.chn: 觉得耳朵在发烧（认为或猜测别人在说自己）

senses.def: used to tell sb that they are allowed to do sth

ex.en: Feel free to ask questions if you don't understand.
ex.cn: 你要是不懂，可以随便提问。

ex.en: 'Can I use your phone?' 'Feel free.'
ex.cn: “我能用你的电话吗？” “随便用吧。”

senses.def: to feel happy, confident, etc.

ex.en: It makes me feel good to know my work is appreciated.
ex.cn: 我知道我的工作得到赏识后感到很高兴。

senses.def: to be certain about sth even though you do not have any direct proof and cannot explain why you are certain
senses.chn: 心中感到；本能预感到；直觉确信

ex.en: I know I'm going to fail this exam—I can feel it in my bones.
ex.cn: 我知道这次考试我过不了关，我有这种直觉。

senses.def: to want to have or do sth

ex.en: I feel like a drink.
ex.cn: 我想喝一杯。

ex.en: We all felt like celebrating.
ex.cn: 我们都想庆祝一番。

ex.en: We'll go for a walk if you feel like it.
ex.cn: 要是你愿意，我们去散散步。

senses.def: to not have enough money

ex.en: Lots of people who have lost their jobs are starting to feel the pinch.
ex.cn: 大量失业者开始感到日子不好过了。

senses.def: to feel as though you will vomit soon

ex.en: Mum! I feel sick.
ex.cn: 妈妈！我觉得恶心。

senses.def: to feel as though you will vomit soon
to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with

ex.en: She was new in the job, still feeling her way.
ex.cn: 她对这项工作不熟悉，还在摸索着干。

senses.def: to not feel healthy and well
senses.chn: 觉得身体不好；感到身体不舒服

senses.def: to look or feel very ill/sick or tired
senses.chn: 看起来病得厉害（或疲惫不堪）；感到很不舒服（或累得要命）

senses.def: to be pleased because sb has made you feel important or special
senses.chn: 被奉承得高兴；感到荣幸

ex.en: He was flattered by her attention.
ex.cn: 她的关注使他感到格外高兴。

ex.en: I felt flattered at being asked to give a lecture.
ex.cn: 承蒙邀请来演讲，我深感荣幸。

senses.def: to be or feel unfairly treated
senses.chn: 受到不公平待遇；感到委屈

ex.en: She has every right to feel hard done by—her parents have given her nothing.
ex.cn: 她完全有理由觉得委屈，她父母什么都没给她。

senses.def: to feel that you must do sth because of your sense of moral duty

ex.en: She felt honour-bound to attend as she had promised to.
ex.cn: 她觉得既然答应了就应该出席。

senses.def: to feel proud and happy

ex.en: I was honoured to have been mentioned in his speech.
ex.cn: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

senses.def: to feel weak because you are nervous
not to feel as well or lively as usual
to look/feel extremely good
to do sth to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation
senses.chn: 突显自己；对（人群或局势）发挥作用

senses.def: to look or feel stupid, weak, ashamed, etc.
senses.chn: 显得（或感觉）矮人一截；愧不如人

senses.def: to have sympathy for sb

ex.en: I really felt for her when her husband died.
ex.cn: 她的丈夫去世，我确实同情她。

ex.en: I do feel for you, honestly.
ex.cn: 说真的，我确实同情你。

senses.def: to touch sb sexually, especially when they do not want you to
to have the strength and energy to do or deal with sth
senses.chn: 觉得有精力（做某事）；感到有能力（处理某事）

ex.en: Do we have to go to the party? I really don't feel up to it.
ex.cn: 我们是不是一定得去参加这次聚会？我实在没有精力应付了。

ex.en: After the accident she didn't feel up to driving.
ex.cn: 事故过后，她开车已力不从心。

senses.def: the feeling you get when you touch sth or are touched

ex.en: You can tell it's silk by the feel.
ex.cn: 你一摸就知道这是丝绸。

ex.en: She loved the feel of the sun on her skin.
ex.cn: 她喜欢太阳照在皮肤上的感觉。

senses.def: an act of feeling or touching

ex.en: I had a feel of the material.
ex.cn: 我摸了一下这种布料。

senses.def: the impression that is created by a place, situation, etc.; atmosphere
senses.chn: （场所、情况等给人的）印象，感受；气氛

ex.en: It's a big city but it has the feel of a small town.
ex.cn: 这是座大城市，却给人小城镇的印象。

ex.en: The room has a comfortable feel to it.
ex.cn: 这个房间令人感到舒适。

senses.def: to become familiar with sth or with doing sth
senses.chn: 开始熟悉，开始熟悉做（某事）

ex.en: I haven't got the feel of the brakes in this car yet.
ex.cn: 我还没有掌握这辆车的刹车性能。

senses.def: to have an understanding of sth or be naturally good at doing it
senses.chn: 善于理解某事物；有…的天才

ex.en: She has a real feel for languages.
ex.cn: 她有语言天才。

senses.def: either of the two long thin parts on the heads of some insects and of some animals that live in shells that they use to feel and touch things with
senses.chn: （某些昆虫和贝壳动物的）触角，触须

senses.def: to try to find out what people think about a particular course of action before you do it
to have sympathy for sb

ex.en: I really felt for her when her husband died.
ex.cn: 她的丈夫去世，我确实同情她。

ex.en: I do feel for you, honestly.
ex.cn: 说真的，我确实同情你。

senses.def: to feel happy, confident, etc.

ex.en: It makes me feel good to know my work is appreciated.
ex.cn: 我知道我的工作得到赏识后感到很高兴。

senses.def: making you feel happy and pleased about life

ex.en: a feel-good movie
ex.cn: 令人愉悦的电影

senses.def: (used especially in newspapers, etc.) the feeling of confidence in the future that is shared by many people
senses.chn: （尤用于报章等）前景美好的氛围

senses.def: something that you feel through the mind or through the senses

ex.en: a feeling of hunger/excitement/sadness, etc.
ex.cn: 饥饿、兴奋、悲伤等的感觉

ex.en: guilty feelings
ex.cn: 内疚感

ex.en: I've got a tight feeling in my stomach.
ex.cn: 我觉得胃部胀痛。

ex.en: 'I really resent the way he treated me.' ' I know the feeling (= I know how you feel).'
ex.cn: “我实在气愤他如此待我。” “我理解你的感受。”

ex.en: 'I'm going to miss you.' ' The feeling's mutual (= I feel exactly the same).'
ex.cn: “我会想念你的。” “我也是。”

senses.def: the idea or belief that a particular thing is true or a particular situation is likely to happen

ex.en: He suddenly had the feeling of being followed.
ex.cn: 他突然觉得被跟踪了。

ex.en: I got the feeling that he didn't like me much.
ex.cn: 我的感觉是他并不很喜欢我。

ex.en: I had a nasty feeling that we were lost.
ex.cn: 我有个不祥的预感：我们迷路了。

senses.def: an attitude or opinion about sth

ex.en: The general feeling of the meeting was against the decision.
ex.cn: 会议上普遍的意见是反对这个决定。

ex.en: I don't have any strong feelings about it one way or the other.
ex.cn: 我对此既不特别喜欢，也不特别讨厌。

ex.en: She had mixed feelings about giving up her job.
ex.cn: 她对辞去工作感到又喜又忧。

ex.en: My own feeling is that we should buy the cheaper one.
ex.cn: 我个人的意见是我们应该买较便宜的那个。

ex.en: Public feeling is being ignored by the government.
ex.cn: 公众的意见遭到了政府忽视。

senses.def: a person's emotions rather than their thoughts or ideas

ex.en: He hates talking about his feelings.
ex.cn: 他讨厌谈他的感情。

ex.en: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings (= offend you).
ex.cn: 我不是故意伤害你的感情。

senses.def: strong emotion

ex.en: She spoke with feeling about the plight of the homeless.
ex.cn: 她激动地讲述了无家可归者的困境。

ex.en: Feelings are running high (= people are very angry or excited).

ex.cn: “我可以再给你取一杯吗？” “不，谢谢。我够了。”

ex.en: This is a fine (= terrible) mess we're in!
ex.cn: 我们的处境好狼狈啊！

ex.en: You're a fine one to talk!(= you are not in a position to criticize, give advice, etc.)
ex.cn: 哪有你说话的分儿！

senses.def: pleasing to look at

ex.en: a fine view
ex.cn: 美景

ex.en: a fine-looking woman
ex.cn: 漂亮女人

ex.en: a fine figure of a man
ex.cn: 身材俊美的男人

senses.def: attractive and delicate

ex.en: fine bone china
ex.cn: 精致的骨瓷

ex.en: She has inherited her mother's fine features (= a small nose, mouth, etc.).
ex.cn: 她遗传了她母亲的清秀面容。

senses.def: bright and not raining

ex.en: a fine day/evening
ex.cn: 晴朗的一天／晚上

ex.en: I hope it stays fine for the picnic.
ex.cn: 我希望野餐那天还是晴天。

senses.def: very thin or narrow

ex.en: fine blond hair
ex.cn: 纤细的金发

ex.en: a fine thread
ex.cn: 细线

ex.en: a brush with a fine tip
ex.cn: 笔头尖细的画笔

senses.def: difficult to see or describe
senses.chn: 难以看出的；很难描述的

ex.en: You really need a magnifying glass to appreciate all the fine detail.
ex.cn: 确实需要放大镜才能欣赏到一切细微之处。

ex.en: There's no need to make such fine distinctions.
ex.cn: 没有必要区分出如此细微的差别。

ex.en: There's a fine line between love and hate (= it is easy for one to become the other).
ex.cn: 爱恨只有一线之隔。

senses.def: made of very small grains
senses.chn: 小颗粒制成的；颗粒细微的

ex.en: fine sand
ex.cn: 细沙

ex.en: Use a finer piece of sandpaper to finish.
ex.cn: 用细砂纸最后磨光。

senses.def: that you have a lot of respect for

ex.en: He was a fine man.
ex.cn: 他是个优秀的人。

senses.def: sounding important and impressive but unlikely to have any effect
senses.chn: 漂亮的；虚饰的；辞藻华丽的

ex.en: His speech was full of fine words which meant nothing.
ex.cn: 他的演讲华而不实。

senses.def: containing only a particular metal and no other substances that reduce the quality

ex.en: fine gold
ex.cn: 纯金

senses.def: to learn to do sth well and efficiently
senses.chn: 把…学到家；学得非常在行

ex.en: I spend so much time travelling that I've got packing down to a fine art.
ex.cn: 我常常旅行，这样便把打点行李学到家了。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism
senses.chn: 直截了当地说，不客气地说（尤指批评）

ex.en: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.
ex.cn: 不客气地说，我认为你在撒谎。

senses.def: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that sb has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
healthy; in good condition
senses.chn: 健康；身心俱佳；状况良好

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.chn: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

ex.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
ex.cn: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

senses.def: in a way that is acceptable or good enough

ex.en: Keep going like that—you're doing fine.
ex.cn: 就这样做下去，你做得蛮不错嘛。

ex.en: Things were going fine until you showed up.
ex.cn: 你一露面就把事情搞糟了。

ex.en: That arrangement suits me fine.
ex.cn: 那种安排对我很合适。

ex.en: An omelette will do me fine (= will be enough for me).
ex.cn: 一份摊鸡蛋我就够了。

senses.def: to leave yourself just enough time to do sth
senses.chn: 把时间扣得很紧；时间上不留余地

ex.en: If we don't leave till after lunch we'll be cutting it very fine.
ex.cn: 我们要是午饭以后才走，时间就紧得很了。

senses.def: a sum of money that must be paid as punishment for breaking a law or rule

ex.en: a parking fine
ex.cn: 违规停车罚款

ex.en: Offenders will be liable to a heavy fine (= one that costs a lot of money).
ex.cn: 违者须付巨额罚金。

ex.en: She has already paid over $2 000 in fines.
ex.cn: 她已经付了 2 000 多美元罚金。

ex.en: a low hourly rate of pay
ex.cn: 按小时支付的低报酬

ex.en: interest rates
ex.cn: 利率

ex.en: an admission charge
ex.cn: 入场费

senses.def: to make sb pay money as an official punishment

ex.en: She was fined for speeding.
ex.cn: 她因超速而被罚款。

ex.en: The company was fined £20 000 for breaching safety regulations.
ex.cn: 这家公司因违反安全条例而被罚款 2 万英镑。

senses.def: forms of art, especially painting, drawing and sculpture, that are created to be beautiful rather than useful
the more conservative of the two main political parties in the Republic of Ireland
senses.chn: 统一党（爱尔兰共和国两大政党之一，保守党派）

senses.def: into very small grains or pieces

ex.en: finely chopped herbs
ex.cn: 剁得很细的香草

senses.def: in a beautiful or impressive way

ex.en: a finely furnished room
ex.cn: 陈设雅致的房间

senses.def: in a very delicate or exact way

ex.en: a finely tuned engine
ex.cn: 精确调整的发动机

ex.en: The match was finely balanced throughout.
ex.cn: 比赛自始至终不分上下。

senses.def: the quality of being made of thin threads or lines very close together

ex.en: fineness of detail
ex.cn: 详情的细微

senses.def: the quality of sth

ex.en: the fineness of the gold
ex.cn: 黄金的成色

senses.def: brightly coloured and elegant clothes and jewellery, especially those that are worn for a special occasion
senses.chn: 高雅华丽的衣服；精美的饰物

senses.def: great skill in dealing with people or situations, especially in a delicate way
to deal with sth in a way that is clever but slightly dishonest

ex.en: to finesse a deal
ex.cn: 略施小计达成一桩交易

senses.def: to do sth with a lot of skill or style
senses.chn: 巧妙地做；派头十足地做

senses.def: a comb in which the pointed parts are thin and very close together
to examine or search sth very carefully
senses.chn: 十分认真地检查；非常仔细地搜查

senses.def: to make very small changes to sth so that it is as good as it can possibly be
one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included)

ex.en: She ran her fingers through her hair.
ex.cn: 她用手指梳理头发。

ex.en: Hold the material between finger and thumb.
ex.cn: 用拇指和另一指拿住这个材料。

ex.en: He was about to speak but she raised a finger to her lips.
ex.cn: 他正要说话，但她举起手指放在唇上示意不要说。

senses.def: having the type of fingers mentioned; having or using the number of fingers mentioned
senses.chn: 有…手指的（指类型）；有（或用）…手指的（指数目）

ex.en: long-fingered
ex.cn: 长手指的

ex.en: nimble-fingered
ex.cn: 手指灵敏的

ex.en: a four-fingered chord
ex.cn: 四指弹奏的和弦

senses.def: the part of a glove that covers the finger
a long narrow piece of bread, cake, land, etc.
senses.chn: 狭长物（如面包、糕饼、土地等）

ex.en: a finger of toast
ex.cn: 长条吐司

ex.en: chocolate fingers
ex.cn: 巧克力条

senses.def: if the finger of suspicion points or is pointed at sb, they are suspected of having committed a crime, being responsible for sth, etc.
used to tell sb to start doing some work or making an effort

ex.en: You're going to have to pull your finger out if you want to pass this exam.
ex.cn: 如果你想通过这次考试就得多加把劲。

senses.def: to raise your middle finger in the air with the back part of your hand facing sb, done to be rude to sb or to show them that you are angry
senses.chn: 向某人竖起中指（手背向外以表示侮辱）

senses.def: to be involved in a lot of different activities and have influence over them, especially when other people think that this is annoying
to be stealing money from the place where you work
senses.chn: 偷自己工作单位的钱；内盗；监守自盗

senses.def: to always be aware of the most recent developments in a particular situation
senses.chn: 始终了解…的最新情况；掌握…的脉搏

senses.def: to touch sb with the intention of hurting them physically
senses.chn: 触碰，动…的一根毫毛（意欲伤害某人）

ex.en: I never laid a finger on her.
ex.cn: 我从来没有碰过她。

senses.def: to not be able to identify what is wrong or different about a particular situation
senses.chn: 看不出（问题所在）；说不出（差别）

ex.en: There was something odd about him but I couldn't put my finger on it.
ex.cn: 他有些古怪，但我说不出到底是什么。

senses.def: to form the shape of a V with the two fingers nearest your thumb and raise your hand in the air with the back part of it facing sb, done to be rude to them or to show them that you are angry
senses.chn: 向某人竖起两指（做出 V 形手势，手背向外以表示侮辱）

senses.def: to work very hard
to suffer as a result of doing sth without realizing the possible bad results, especially in business
senses.chn: （尤指生意上）没有先见之明而蒙受损失，因不慎而吃亏

ex.en: He got his fingers badly burnt dabbling in the stock market.
ex.cn: 他糊里糊涂地进入股票市场，结果赔了老本。

senses.def: used to say that the total number of sb/sth is very small
to hope that your plans will be successful (sometimes putting one finger across another as a sign of hoping for good luck)
senses.chn: 祈求成功（有时使手指交叉为祈求好运的手势）

ex.en: I'm crossing my fingers that my proposal will be accepted.
ex.cn: 但愿我的建议能被采纳。

ex.en: Keep your fingers crossed!
ex.cn: 祈求好运吧！

senses.def: to do nothing to help sb
senses.chn: 一点忙也不帮；油瓶倒了都不扶

ex.en: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.
ex.cn: 孩子们从不帮着做家务。

senses.def: to accuse sb of doing sth

ex.en: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
ex.cn: 那篇文章谴责了当局。

senses.def: to miss or fail to use an opportunity

ex.en: Don't let the chance to work abroad slip through your fingers.
ex.cn: 这个出国工作的机会你可不要错过。

senses.def: to make a sharp noise by moving your second or third finger quickly against your thumb, to attract sb's attention, or to mark the beat of music, for example
senses.chn: 打榧子，弹指头（捻拇指作响）

senses.def: to be likely to steal sth
senses.chn: 好偷东西的；有顺手牵羊的毛病

senses.def: to be awkward with your hands so that you drop things or are unable to do sth
senses.chn: 笨手笨脚；笨拙；手指不灵活

senses.def: to touch or feel sth with your fingers

ex.en: Gary sat fingering his beard, saying nothing.
ex.cn: 加里坐着用手捋着胡子，一言不发。

senses.def: to accuse sb of doing sth illegal and tell the police about it

ex.en: Who fingered him for the burglaries?
ex.cn: 谁告发他入室盗窃？

senses.def: a flat strip on the neck of a musical instrument such as a guitar or violin , against which the strings are pressed to play different notes
a small bowl of water for washing your fingers during a meal
pieces of food that you can easily eat with your fingers
senses.chn: 手取食物（便于用手指取食的食物）

senses.def: the positions in which you put your fingers when playing a musical instrument
a mark made by a finger, for example on a clean surface
the thin hard layer that covers the outer tip of each finger
a style of painting in which you use your fingers instead of brushes; a painting made using this technique
a mark made by the pattern of lines on the tip of a person's finger, often used by the police to identify criminals

ex.en: The kids left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
ex.cn: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污迹斑斑。

ex.en: blood stains
ex.cn: 血迹

ex.en: Her fingerprints were all over the gun.
ex.cn: 那支枪上布满了她的指纹。

ex.en: She had streaks of grey in her hair.
ex.cn: 她头上已是白发绺绺。

ex.en: There isn't a speck of dust anywhere in the house.
ex.cn: 整间房子一尘不染。

ex.en: There were grease spots all over the walls.
ex.cn: 墙上满是油渍。

senses.def: the practice of recording sb's fingerprints, often used by the police to identify criminals
senses.chn: 取（罪犯等的）指纹印；盖手印

senses.def: the end of the finger that is furthest from the hand
to have the information, knowledge, etc. that is needed in a particular situation and be able to find it easily and use it quickly
senses.chn: 掌握（信息等）；熟悉，精通（知识等）；对…了如指掌；有…随时可供使用

senses.def: in every way

ex.en: She's a perfectionist to her fingertips.
ex.cn: 她是个道道地地的完美主义者。

senses.def: a decorative part at the top of a roof, wall, etc.
a decorative part that fits on the end of a curtain pole
too worried about what you eat, wear, etc.; disliking many things
senses.chn: （对衣食等）过分讲究的，过分挑剔的

ex.en: a finicky eater
ex.cn: 过分挑食者

senses.def: needing great care and attention to detail
senses.chn: 需认真仔细对待的；需要注意细节的

ex.en: It's a very finicky job.
ex.cn: 这是个很细致的工作。

senses.def: to stop doing sth or making sth because it is complete

ex.en: Haven't you finished your homework yet?
ex.cn: 难道你还没有完成家庭作业吗？

ex.en: She finished law school last year.
ex.cn: 她去年毕业于法学院。

ex.en: I thought you'd never finish!
ex.cn: 我还以为你会完成不了呢！

ex.en: a beautifully finished piece of furniture
ex.cn: 一件做工精美的家具

ex.en: He put the finishing touches to his painting (= did the things that made it complete).
ex.cn: 他在画上作了最后几处润色。

ex.en: Be quiet! He hasn't finished speaking.
ex.cn: 安静！他还没有讲完。

senses.def: to come to an end; to bring sth to an end

ex.en: The play finished at 10.30.
ex.cn: 比赛于 10:30 结束。

ex.en: The symphony finishes with a flourish.
ex.cn: 交响乐在响亮的乐曲声中结束。

ex.en: A cup of coffee finished the meal perfectly.
ex.cn: 饭后一杯咖啡，美餐圆满结束。

ex.en: I'm afraid time is running out/we're running out of time, so we'll have to make this the final question.
ex.cn: 恐怕时间不多了，所以这将是我们最后一个问题了。

ex.en: We've only got a couple of minutes left, so can we summarize what we've agreed?
ex.cn: 我们只剩下几分钟了，所以概括一下已经达成一致的意见好吗？

ex.en: I'd like to close the session with a few final remarks…
ex.cn: 我想最后说几句来结束这次会议…

senses.def: to eat, drink or use what remains of sth
senses.chn: 吃完，喝光，用尽（所剩之物）

ex.en: He finished off his drink with one large gulp.
ex.cn: 他一大口喝完了饮料。

ex.en: We might as well finish up the cake.
ex.cn: 我们倒不如把蛋糕吃完。

senses.def: to be in a particular state or position at the end of a race or a competition

ex.en: She was delighted to finish second.
ex.cn: 她为竞赛得了第二名而高兴。

ex.en: The dollar finished the day slightly down.
ex.cn: 当日结束时美元汇率略有下跌。

ex.en: He finished 12 seconds outside the world record.
ex.cn: 他的赛跑成绩比世界纪录慢 12 秒。

senses.def: to make sb so tired or impatient that they cannot do any more
senses.chn: 使筋疲力尽；使失去耐心

ex.en: Climbing that hill really finished me off.
ex.cn: 登那座山真把我累得筋疲力尽。

ex.en: A lecture from my parents now would just finish me.
ex.cn: 现在父母教训我简直会使我受不了。

senses.def: to destroy sb/sth, especially sb/sth that is badly injured or damaged
senses.chn: 杀死，彻底摧毁（已严重受伤或受损的人或事物）

ex.en: The hunter moved in to finish the animal off.
ex.cn: 猎人逼到近前，了结了那只动物。

senses.def: to do the last part of sth; to make sth end by doing one last thing

ex.en: I need about an hour to finish off this report.
ex.cn: 我需要一小时左右结束这篇报告。

ex.en: They finished off the show with one of their most famous songs.
ex.cn: 他们用自己的一首最著名的歌曲作演出的压台戏。

senses.def: to be in a particular state or at a particular place after a series of events
senses.chn: 结果成为；以…终结；最终来到

ex.en: If you're not careful, you could finish up seriously ill.
ex.cn: 你要是不小心，可能到头来会得场大病。

senses.def: to end a relationship with sb

ex.en: She finished with her boyfriend last week.
ex.cn: 上星期她和男友分手了。

senses.def: to stop dealing with a person

ex.en: He'll regret he ever said it once I've finished with him.
ex.cn: 我不再和他打交道，他就会后悔他说过那句话。

senses.def: to no longer need to use sth

ex.en: When you've finished with the book, can I see it?
ex.cn: 这本书你看完以后我能看吗？

senses.def: to stop doing sth

ex.en: I've finished with gambling.
ex.cn: 我已戒赌了。

senses.def: to have sth at the end

ex.en: We had a five-course lunch and finished up with coffee and mints.
ex.cn: 我们这顿午餐吃了五道菜，最后是咖啡和薄荷糖。

ex.en: To finish with, we'll listen to a few songs.
ex.cn: 最后我们将听几首歌。

senses.def: the last part or the end of sth

ex.en: a dramatic finish to the race
ex.cn: 赛跑的戏剧性结局

ex.en: It was a close finish, as they had predicted.
ex.cn: 正如他们所预料的，比赛结果难分上下。

ex.en: They won in the end but it was a tight finish.
ex.cn: 他们终于赢了，但比分十分接近。

ex.en: The story was a lie from start to finish.
ex.cn: 这样的讲述自始至终都是骗人的。

ex.en: I want to see the job through to the finish.
ex.cn: 我要看到这项工作做完为止。

senses.def: the last covering of paint, polish, etc. that is put onto the surface of sth; the condition of the surface
senses.chn: 末道漆；抛光；（漆完抛光后的）成品表面

ex.en: a gloss/matt finish
ex.cn: 光泽／无光表面

ex.en: furniture available in a range of finishes
ex.cn: 有各种光泽处理的家具

senses.def: the final details that are added to sth to make it complete

ex.en: The bows will give a feminine finish to the curtains.
ex.cn: 窗帘最后配上蝴蝶结显出女性的柔美。

senses.def: to be unwilling to accept sth or do sth, and to try to avoid it
senses.chn: 不愿接受（或做）某事；回避；躲避

ex.en: Successive governments have fought shy of such measures.
ex.cn: 一届接一届政府均不愿采取这些措施。

senses.def: no longer doing sth or dealing with sb/sth

ex.en: I won't be finished for another hour.
ex.cn: 我还得一小时以后才能完成。

ex.en: I'm not finished with you yet.
ex.cn: 你我还得打交道。

senses.def: no longer powerful, effective or able to continue

ex.en: If the newspapers find out, he's finished in politics.
ex.cn: 如果报界发现这些问题，他的政治生涯就完了。

ex.en: Their marriage was finished.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻破裂了。

senses.def: fully completed, especially in a particular way

ex.en: the finished product/article
ex.cn: 成品；脱稿的文章

ex.en: a beautifully finished suit
ex.cn: 做工精美的一套西服

senses.def: a person or an animal that finishes a race, etc.
the line across a sports track, etc. that marks the end of a race

ex.en: The two horses crossed the finishing line together.
ex.cn: 两匹马同时越过终点线。

senses.def: a private school where young women from rich families are taught how to behave in fashionable society
senses.chn: 精修学校（为富家女子学习上流社会行为所办的私立学校）

senses.def: to end a relationship with sb

ex.en: She finished with her boyfriend last week.
ex.cn: 上星期她和男友分手了。

senses.def: to stop dealing with a person

ex.en: He'll regret he ever said it once I've finished with him.
ex.cn: 我不再和他打交道，他就会后悔他说过那句话。

senses.def: to no longer need to use sth

ex.en: When you've finished with the book, can I see it?
ex.cn: 这本书你看完以后我能看吗？

senses.def: to stop doing sth

ex.en: I've finished with gambling.
ex.cn: 我已戒赌了。

senses.def: having a definite limit or fixed size

ex.en: a finite number of possibilities
ex.cn: 为数有限的可能

ex.en: The world's resources are finite.
ex.cn: 世界的资源是有限的。

senses.def: a finite verb form or clause shows a particular tense, person and number

ex.en: 'Am', 'is', 'are', 'was' and 'were' are the finite forms of 'be'; 'being' and 'been' are the non-finite forms.
ex.cn: am、is、are、was 和 were 是 be 的限定形式，being 和 been 是非限定形式。

senses.def: an unpleasant person
a country in northern Europe
a person from Finland
from or connected with Finland
extra decorative notes added to a melody by an opera singer
an evergreen forest tree with leaves like needles
the hard fruit of the fir tree
the flames, light and heat, and often smoke, that are produced when sth burns

ex.en: Most animals are afraid of fire.
ex.cn: 大多数动物怕火。

senses.def: flames that are out of control and destroy buildings, trees, etc.

ex.en: The car was now on fire.
ex.cn: 小轿车在燃烧。

ex.en: Without education, these children will end up as factory fodder (= only able to work in a factory).
ex.cn: 不受教育，这些孩子将来只能到工厂干活。

ex.en: This story will be more fodder for the gossip columnists.
ex.cn: 这个传闻会是闲谈专栏作家的又一素材。

senses.def: an enemy
a thick cloud of very small drops of water in the air close to the land or sea, that is very difficult to see through

ex.en: Dense/thick fog is affecting roads in the north and visibility is poor.
ex.cn: 浓雾影响了北部的公路，能见度很低。

ex.en: freezing fog
ex.cn: 寒雾

ex.en: Patches of fog will clear by mid-morning.
ex.cn: 上午十时左右，团团浓雾将散去。

ex.en: We get heavy fogs on this coast in winter.
ex.cn: 冬天这片海岸雾气很重。

ex.en: The town was covered in a thick blanket of fog.
ex.cn: 大雾笼罩了这个城镇。

ex.en: The fog finally lifted (= disappeared).
ex.cn: 雾终于散了。

senses.def: a state of confusion, in which things are not clear

ex.en: He went through the day with his mind in a fog.
ex.cn: 整整一天，他的头脑都是昏昏沉沉的。

senses.def: if a glass surface fogs or is fogged up, it becomes covered in steam or small drops of water so that you cannot see through
to make sb/sth confused or less clear

ex.en: I tried to clear the confusion that was fogging my brain.
ex.cn: 我试图解除使我迷茫的困惑。

ex.en: The government was trying to fog the real issues before the election.
ex.cn: 政府企图在选举前混淆实质问题。

senses.def: unable to operate because of fog; unable to travel or to leave a place because of fog
senses.chn: 因雾不能运行的；因雾滞留的

ex.en: a fogbound airport
ex.cn: 因雾关闭的机场

ex.en: fogbound passengers
ex.cn: 因雾滞留的旅客

ex.en: She spent hours fogbound in Brussels.
ex.cn: 她因雾在布鲁塞尔滞留了好几个小时。

senses.def: a person with old-fashioned ideas that he or she is unwilling to change

ex.en: He sounds like such an old fogey!
ex.cn: 他说话听起来真是个老顽固！

senses.def: not clear because of fog

ex.en: foggy conditions
ex.cn: 有雾的环境

ex.en: a foggy road
ex.cn: 雾茫茫的道路

senses.def: to not know anything at all about sth
senses.chn: 完全不知道；一无所知；茫无头绪

ex.en: 'Do you know where she is?' 'Sorry, I haven't the foggiest.'
ex.cn: “你知道她在哪儿吗？” “对不起，我一点也不知道。”

senses.def: an instrument that makes a loud noise to warn ships of danger in fog
senses.chn: 雾角，雾喇叭（向雾中的船只发警告）

ex.en: He's got a voice like a foghorn (= a loud unpleasant voice).
ex.cn: 他那大嗓门像雾角一样刺耳。

senses.def: a very bright light on the front or back of a car to help the driver to see or be seen in fog
a silly habit or a strange or weak aspect of a person's character, that is considered harmless by other people
senses.chn: （性格上无伤大雅的）怪癖，弱点，小缺点

ex.en: We have to tolerate each other's little foibles.
ex.cn: 我们得互相容忍对方的小缺点。

senses.def: metal made into very thin sheets that is used for covering or wrapping things, especially food

ex.en: aluminium foil
ex.cn: 铝箔

ex.en: aluminum foil
ex.cn: 铝箔

senses.def: paper that is covered in very thin sheets of metal

ex.en: The chocolates are individually wrapped in gold foil.
ex.cn: 巧克力用金箔纸一颗颗独立包装。

senses.def: a person or thing that contrasts with, and therefore emphasizes, the qualities of another person or thing

ex.en: The pale walls provide a perfect foil for the furniture.
ex.cn: 浅色的墙壁完全衬托出家具的特色。

senses.def: a long thin light sword used in the sport of fencing
to stop sth from happening, especially sth illegal; to prevent sb from doing sth
senses.chn: 挫败，阻止，制止（非法活动等）

ex.en: to foil a plan/crime/plot
ex.cn: 挫败计划／犯罪／阴谋

ex.en: Customs officials foiled an attempt to smuggle the paintings out of the country.
ex.cn: 海关关员阻截了一次企图走私画作出境的阴谋。

ex.en: They were foiled in their attempt to smuggle the paintings.
ex.cn: 他们走私绘画作品的企图未能得逞。

senses.def: to force sb to accept sb/sth that they do not want

ex.en: The title for her novel was foisted on her by the publishers.
ex.cn: 她的小说书名是出版商强加给她的。

senses.def: to bend sth, especially paper or cloth, so that one part lies on top of another part

ex.en: He folded the map up and put it in his pocket.
ex.cn: 他把地图折叠起来，放进了口袋。

ex.en: First, fold the paper in half/in two.
ex.cn: 首先，把纸对折起来。

ex.en: The blankets had been folded down.
ex.cn: 毛毯已折叠起来。

ex.en: a pile of neatly folded clothes
ex.cn: 一摞折叠整齐的衣服

ex.en: The bird folded its wings.
ex.cn: 那只鸟收起了翅膀。

senses.def: to bend sth so that it becomes smaller or flatter and can be stored or carried more easily; to bend or be able to bend in this way
senses.chn: 折小，叠平，可折小，可叠平（以便贮存或携带）

ex.en: The bed can be folded away during the day.
ex.cn: 这张床在白天可以折叠收起。

ex.en: The table folds up when not in use.
ex.cn: 这桌子不用时可以折叠起来。

ex.en: When she heard the news, her legs just folded under her (= she fell).
ex.cn: 她听到这消息时双腿发软（倒在地上）。

ex.en: The ironing board folds flat for easy storage.
ex.cn: 烫衣板能够折起来，便于存放。

senses.def: to wrap sth around sb/sth

ex.en: She gently folded the baby in a blanket.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地把婴儿裹在毯子里。

ex.en: She folded a blanket around the baby.
ex.cn: 她用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

senses.def: to close because it is not successful
to put one of your arms over the other one and hold them against your body
to bring or hold your hands together

ex.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
ex.cn: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: to put your arms around sb and hold them against your body
to add one substance to another and gently mix them together

ex.en: Fold in the beaten egg whites.
ex.cn: 调入打好的蛋白。

senses.def: a part of sth, especially cloth, that is folded or hangs as if it had been folded

ex.en: the folds of her dress
ex.cn: 她的连衣裙上的褶

ex.en: loose folds of skin
ex.cn: 皮肤松垮的褶皱

senses.def: a mark or line made by folding sth, or showing where sth should be folded
an area in a field surrounded by a fence or wall where sheep are kept for safety
a group of people with whom you feel you belong or who share the same ideas or beliefs
senses.chn: 志趣相同的人们；同一信仰的人们

ex.en: He called on former Republican voters to return to the fold.
ex.cn: 他号召昔日拥护共和党的选民重新回到支持共和党的行列。

senses.def: a curve or bend in the line of the layers of rock in the earth's crust
a hollow place among hills or mountains
in/not in a position where you see it first, for example in the top/bottom part of a newspaper page or web page
senses.chn: （报纸或网页）最上／下面部分，最显眼／不显眼部分

ex.en: Your ad will be placed above the fold for prominent exposure.
ex.cn: 你们的广告将放在页面上端的醒目位置。

senses.def: a cardboard or plastic cover for holding loose papers, etc.
(in some computer systems) a way of organizing and storing computer files
senses.chn: （某些计算机系统中的）文件夹

senses.def: that can be folded, so that it can be carried or stored in a small space

ex.en: a folding chair
ex.cn: 折椅

ex.en: a foldaway bed
ex.cn: 折叠床

senses.def: to put your arms around sb and hold them against your body
to add one substance to another and gently mix them together

ex.en: Fold in the beaten egg whites.
ex.cn: 调入打好的蛋白。

senses.def: that can be made smaller by closing or folding so that it takes up less space
to put one of your arms over the other one and hold them against your body
to bring or hold your hands together

ex.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
ex.cn: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: the leaves of a tree or plant; leaves and branches together

ex.en: dense green foliage
ex.cn: 茂密的绿叶

senses.def: relating to leaves

ex.en: foliar colour
ex.cn: 叶子的颜色

senses.def: a vitamin found in green vegetables, liver and kidney , needed by the body for the production of red blood cells
senses.chn: 叶酸（见于绿色蔬菜、肝、肾的一种维生素，用于造红血球）

senses.def: a book made with large sheets of paper, especially as used in early printing
a single sheet of paper from a book
people in general

ex.en: ordinary working-class folk
ex.cn: 普通劳动大众

ex.en: I'd like a job working with old folk or kids.
ex.cn: 我喜欢与老人或小孩打交道的工作。

ex.en: the folks back home (= from the place where you come from)
ex.cn: 家乡的乡亲父老

senses.def: a friendly way of addressing more than one person

ex.en: Well, folks, what are we going to do today?
ex.cn: 喂，伙计们，我们今天要干什么？

senses.def: the members of your family, especially your parents

ex.en: How are your folks?
ex.cn: 你爸妈好吗？

senses.def: people from a particular country or region, or who have a particular way of life
senses.chn: （某国、某地区或某生活方式的）普通百姓

ex.en: country folk
ex.cn: 乡下人

ex.en: townsfolk
ex.cn: 城里人

ex.en: farming folk
ex.cn: 农民

senses.def: music in the traditional style of a country or community

ex.en: a folk festival/concert
ex.cn: 民间音乐节／音乐会

senses.def: traditional and typical of the ordinary people of a country or community

ex.en: folk art
ex.cn: 民间艺术

ex.en: a folk museum
ex.cn: 民俗博物馆

senses.def: based on the beliefs of ordinary people
senses.chn: 流传民间的；普通百姓的

ex.en: folk wisdom
ex.cn: 民间智慧

ex.en: Garlic is widely used in Chinese folk medicine.
ex.cn: 大蒜广泛应用于中国民间医药。

senses.def: a traditional dance of a particular area or country; a piece of music for such a dance
senses.chn: 土风舞；民间舞蹈；民间舞曲

senses.def: a process by which a word is changed, for example because of a mistaken belief that it is related to another word, or to make a foreign word sound more familiar

ex.en: Folk etymology has created the cheeseburger and the beanburger, but the first hamburgers were in fact named after the city of Hamburg.
ex.cn: 民间词源创造了 cheeseburger 和 beanburger，但最初 hamburger 一词实际上是以德国汉堡市命名的。

senses.def: a person that people in a particular place admire because of sth special he or she has done
the traditions and stories of a country or community
senses.chn: 民间传统；民俗；民间传说

ex.en: Irish/Indian folklore
ex.cn: 爱尔兰／印度民俗

ex.en: The story rapidly became part of family folklore.
ex.cn: 这个故事很快就成为家族传说的一部分。

senses.def: a person who studies folklore, especially as an academic subject
senses.chn: 民俗学家；民俗学研究者

senses.def: a memory of sth in the past that the people of a country or community never forget
senses.chn: 民间共同记忆（一个国家或社群的人不会忘记的事）

senses.def: a style of music that combines elements of folk music and rock
a person who sings folk songs
a song in the traditional style of a country or community
a type of song that became popular in the US in the 1960s, played on a guitar and often about political topics
senses.chn: 仿民歌歌曲（美国 20 世纪 60 年代盛行，吉他伴奏，常以政治为题材）

senses.def: simple, friendly and informal
senses.chn: 淳朴友好自然的；朴实热情随意的

ex.en: They wanted the store to have a folksy small-town image.
ex.cn: 他们希望这家商店具有小城镇那种朴实热情的形象。

senses.def: done or made in a traditional style that is typical of simple customs in the past
senses.chn: 有民间传统的；有民间风味的；土里土气的

ex.en: a folksy ballad
ex.cn: 有民间风味的歌谣

senses.def: a very old traditional story from a particular place that was originally passed on to people in a spoken form
one of the very small holes in the skin which hair grows from
to come or go after or behind sb/sth

ex.en: He followed her into the house.
ex.cn: 他跟随她走进房屋。

ex.en: Follow me please. I'll show you the way.
ex.cn: 请跟我走。我来给你指路。

ex.en: I think we're being followed.
ex.cn: 我认为有人跟踪我们。

ex.en: She followed her mother into the medical profession.
ex.cn: 她走她母亲的路，从事医务工作。

ex.en: Wherever she led, they followed.
ex.cn: 她引向哪里，他们就跟到哪里。

ex.en: Sam walked in, with the rest of the boys following closely behind.
ex.cn: 萨姆走了进来，其他男孩紧跟其后。

senses.def: to come after sth/sb else in time or order; to happen as a result of sth else
senses.chn: （时间或顺序上）在…后发生；因…而发生

ex.en: The first two classes are followed by a break of ten minutes.
ex.cn: 上完头两节课，有十分钟的课间休息。

ex.en: I remember little of the days that followed the accident.
ex.cn: 那次事故以后的日子我记不大清楚了。

ex.en: A period of unrest followed the president's resignation.
ex.cn: 总统辞职之后有一段时期的动荡。

ex.en: A detailed news report will follow shortly.
ex.cn: 下面紧接着是详细的新闻报道。

ex.en: There followed a short silence.
ex.cn: 接着沉默了一会儿。

ex.en: The opening hours are as follows …
ex.cn: 营业时间如下…

senses.def: to do sth after sth else

ex.en: Follow your treatment with plenty of rest.
ex.cn: 你治疗以后要多休息。

ex.en: They follow up their March show with four UK dates next month.
ex.cn: 他们在三月演出以后，就是下个月在英国的四场演出。

senses.def: to be the logical result of sth

ex.en: I don't see how that follows from what you've just said.
ex.cn: 根据你刚才所说的，我不明白怎么会产生那样的结果。

ex.en: If a = b and b = c it follows that a = c.
ex.cn: 设 a = b，b = c，则 a = c。

senses.def: to come or be eaten after another part
senses.chn: 接着是；然后是；下一道是

ex.en: The main course was followed by fresh fruit.
ex.cn: 主菜以后是新鲜水果。

ex.en: I'll have soup and fish to follow.
ex.cn: 我要汤，然后要鱼。

senses.def: to go along a road, path, etc.

ex.en: Follow this road until you get to the school, then turn left.
ex.cn: 沿着这条路走到学校，然后向左拐。

senses.def: to go in the same direction as sth or parallel to sth

ex.en: The lane follows the edge of a wood for about a mile.
ex.cn: 小路沿树林边延伸约一英里。

senses.def: to accept advice, instructions, etc. and do what you have been told or shown to do
senses.chn: 接受，遵循，听从（忠告、指示等）

ex.en: to follow a diet/recipe
ex.cn: 按照规定饮食／菜谱

ex.en: He has trouble following simple instructions.
ex.cn: 简单的指示他都难以照办。

ex.en: Why didn't you follow my advice?
ex.cn: 你为什么不听我的劝告？

senses.def: to accept sb/sth as a guide, a leader or an example; to copy sb/sth
senses.chn: 接受…为指导（或领导、榜样）；追随；拥护；仿效

ex.en: They followed the teachings of Buddha.
ex.cn: 他们信佛教。

ex.en: He always followed the latest fashions (= dressed in fashionable clothes).
ex.cn: 他总是紧跟着服装潮流。

ex.en: I don't want you to follow my example and rush into marriage.
ex.cn: 我不希望你走我的老路，匆忙结婚。

ex.en: The movie follows the book faithfully.
ex.cn: 这部电影忠于原著。

senses.def: to understand an explanation or the meaning of sth

ex.en: Sorry, I don't follow.
ex.cn: 对不起，我不明白。

ex.en: Sorry, I don't follow you.
ex.cn: 对不起，我听不懂你的话。

ex.en: The plot is almost impossible to follow.
ex.cn: 故事情节几乎叫人看不懂。

ex.en: I don't understand the instructions.
ex.cn: 我不懂这些指令的意思。

ex.en: Doctors still don't understand much about the disease.
ex.cn: 医生对这种疾病还了解不多。

ex.en: 'It opens like this.' 'Oh, I see.'
ex.cn: “这样就打开了。” “哦，我明白了。”

senses.def: to watch or listen to sb/sth very carefully

ex.en: The children were following every word of the story intently.
ex.cn: 孩子们一字不漏地专心听故事。

ex.en: Her eyes followed him everywhere (= she was looking at him all the time).
ex.cn: 她一直在注视着他。

senses.def: to take an active interest in sth and be aware of what is happening
senses.chn: 对…产生浓厚兴趣而关注

ex.en: Have you been following the basketball championships?
ex.cn: 你是否一直在关注篮球锦标赛的赛程？

ex.en: Millions of people followed the trial on TV.
ex.cn: 几百万人饶有兴趣地收看了电视转播的审判。

senses.def: to choose to regularly receive messages from a person, company, etc. using a microblogging service

ex.en: I don't follow many celebrities on Twitter any more.
ex.cn: 我不再在推特上关注很多名人了。

senses.def: to be concerned with the life or development of sb/sth

ex.en: The novel follows the fortunes of a village community in Scotland.
ex.cn: 小说叙述了苏格兰一个村落的变迁。

senses.def: to develop or happen in a particular way
senses.chn: 按…方式（或方向）发展；以…方式发生

ex.en: The day followed the usual pattern.
ex.cn: 这一天和平常过得一样。

senses.def: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as sb else, especially sb in your family

ex.en: She works in television, following in her father's footsteps.
ex.cn: 她步父亲的后尘，在电视台工作。

senses.def: to be guided by your sense of smell
to go straight forward

ex.en: The garage is a mile ahead up the hill—just follow your nose.
ex.cn: 汽车修理站在前面一英里处的山坡上，一直往前走就可以到。

senses.def: to act according to what seems right or reasonable, rather than following any particular rules
senses.chn: 凭感觉行事；凭直觉办事

senses.def: to play a card of the same suit that has just been played
senses.chn: 跟牌（跟着别人出同花色的牌）

senses.def: to act or behave in the way that sb else has just done
senses.chn: 跟着某人做；仿效某人；照着做

senses.def: a person who is so good or successful at sth that it will be difficult for anyone else coming after them to be as good or successful
to keep going with sb wherever they go

ex.en: Will you stop following me around!
ex.cn: 你不要再到处跟着我了！

senses.def: to go somewhere after sb else has gone there

ex.en: You go to the beach with the kids and I'll follow on when I've finished work.
ex.cn: 你和孩子们去海滨，我办完事随后就来。

senses.def: to play a second innings (= a period during which a team is batting ) immediately after its first, because it has failed to reach a particular score
senses.chn: 连打（在第一局得分不足时继续在下一局击球）

senses.def: to complete a stroke by continuing to move the club, racket, etc. after hitting the ball
senses.chn: （击球后球拍、球棒等）完成顺势动作

senses.def: to finish sth that you have started
senses.chn: 把…进行到底；完成（开了头的事）

senses.def: to add to sth that you have just done by doing sth else
senses.chn: 对…采取进一步行动；…后接着

ex.en: You should follow up your phone call with an email or a letter.
ex.cn: 你打电话后应该接着发一封电子邮件或写封信。

senses.def: to find out more about sth that sb has told you or suggested to you

ex.en: The police are following up several leads after their TV appeal for information.
ex.cn: 警方在电视上呼吁提供信息后正沿着几条线索继续追查。

senses.def: a person, company, etc. whose messages on a microblogging service people choose to receive regularly

ex.en: I often use Twitter recommendations to select new followees.
ex.cn: 我经常利用推特的推荐来选择新的关注对象。

senses.def: a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas

ex.en: the followers of Mahatma Gandhi
ex.cn: 圣雄甘地的拥护者

senses.def: a person who is very interested in a particular activity and follows all the recent news about it

ex.en: keen followers of football
ex.cn: 足球迷

ex.en: a follower of fashion
ex.cn: 赶时髦者

senses.def: a person who does things after sb else has done them first

ex.en: She is a leader, not a follower.
ex.cn: 她是领导者，不是追随者。

senses.def: a person who chooses to regularly receive sb's messages using a microblogging service

ex.en: a celebrity with thousands of followers on Twitter
ex.cn: 一个在推特上有成千上万关注者的名人

senses.def: next in time

ex.en: the following afternoon/month/year/week
ex.cn: 第二天下午；第二个月；第二年；第二周

ex.en: They arrived on Monday evening and we got there the following day.
ex.cn: 他们是星期一晚上到的，我们次日也抵达那里。

senses.def: that is/are going to be mentioned next

ex.en: Answer the following questions.
ex.cn: 回答下列问题。

ex.en: This study has the following aims: first, to investigate how international students in the UK use humour; second, to examine how jokes can help to establish social relationships; and, third, to explore the role that humour plays in helping overseas students adjust to life in the UK.
ex.cn: 本研究有以下几个目的：第一，调查在英国的留学生如何运用幽默；第二，考察笑话如何帮助建立社交关系；第三，探究幽默对留学生适应英国生活所起的作用。

ex.en: Let us begin by identifying some of the popular joke genres in the UK.
ex.cn: 首先我们来探究一下流行于英国的一些笑话类型。

ex.en: Next, let us turn to / Next, let us consider the question of gender differences in the use of humour.
ex.cn: 接下来，我们来探讨一下运用幽默的性别差异问题。

ex.en: Finally / Lastly, let us briefly examine the role of humour in defining a nation's culture.
ex.cn: 最后，我们来简略地探讨一下幽默在界定民族文化中所起的作用。

senses.def: a wind blowing in the same direction as a ship or other vehicle that helps it move faster
a group of supporters

ex.en: The band has a huge following in Italy.
ex.cn: 这个乐队在意大利有一大批热心的追随者。

senses.def: the thing or things that you will mention next; the person or people that you will mention next

ex.en: The following is a summary of events.
ex.cn: 现将重大事件综述如下。

ex.cn: 已选定下列人员参加：沃茨、霍奇斯和伦诺克斯。

senses.def: after or as a result of a particular event

ex.cn: 父亲死后他就接管了家族企业。

senses.def: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as sb else, especially sb in your family

ex.cn: 她步父亲的后尘，在电视台工作。

senses.def: to go somewhere after sb else has gone there

ex.cn: 你和孩子们去海滨，我办完事随后就来。

senses.def: to play a second innings (= a period during which a team is batting ) immediately after its first, because it has failed to reach a particular score

senses.def: to play a card of the same suit that has just been played
senses.chn: 跟牌（跟着别人出同花色的牌）

senses.def: to act or behave in the way that sb else has just done

senses.def: the actions that sb takes in order to complete a plan

ex.cn: 如果缺少恰当的后续行动，该项目可能失败。

senses.def: an action or a thing that continues sth that has already started or comes after sth similar that was done earlier

ex.cn: 这本书是继她的优秀电视系列片之后的又一力作。

senses.def: to be guided by your sense of smell
to go straight forward

ex.cn: 汽车修理站在前面一英里处的山坡上，一直往前走就可以到。

senses.def: to act according to what seems right or reasonable, rather than following any particular rules
senses.chn: 凭感觉行事；凭直觉办事

senses.def: a lack of good judgement; the fact of doing sth stupid; an activity or idea that shows a lack of judgement

ex.cn: 纯粹愚蠢的行动

ex.cn: 放弃一份稳定的工作似乎愚蠢至极。

ex.cn: 拒绝这个建议是愚蠢之举。

ex.en: the follies of youth
ex.cn: 青年时期的愚蠢行为

senses.def: a building that has no practical purpose but was built in the past for decoration, often in the garden of a large country house

ex.cn: 他们指控他煽动政治动乱。

ex.cn: 经过这么多年，我已相当喜欢她了。

ex.cn: 我爱你。

ex.en: She's nice. I like her.
ex.cn: 她人很好，我喜欢她。

ex.en: I've always been very fond of your mother.
ex.cn: 我一直非常喜欢你的母亲。

ex.cn: 她显然深深地爱着他。

ex.en: They are devoted to their children.
ex.cn: 他们深爱着自己的孩子。

ex.cn: 喜好音乐／烹饪

ex.cn: 我们已经喜欢上了这座房子，不想搬家。

ex.cn: 你喜欢他们的新房子吗？

ex.en: I like to see them enjoying themselves.
ex.cn: 我就愿意看着他们玩得高兴。

ex.en: He loved the way she smiled.
ex.cn: 他喜欢她微笑的样子。

ex.en: We were fond of the house and didn't want to leave.
ex.cn: 我们喜欢上了这座房子，不想搬家。

senses.def: liking to do sth which other people find annoying or unpleasant, and doing it often

ex.cn: 希拉爱对别人指手画脚。

ex.cn: 他太爱讲话了。

senses.def: kind and loving

ex.cn: 慈爱的目光；温情的拥抱；深情的告别

ex.en: I have very fond memories of my time in Spain (= I remember it with affection and pleasure).
ex.cn: 我十分怀念从前在西班牙的时光。

senses.def: a hope about sth that is not likely to happen

ex.cn: 我整天等待，痴心地希望她会回心转意。

senses.def: used to say that when you are away from sb that you love, you love them even more
a thick sweet soft mixture made from sugar and water, used especially to cover cakes

ex.en: fondant icing
ex.cn: 软糖料糖霜

senses.def: a soft sweet/candy that melts in the mouth, made of fondant
to touch and move your hand gently over sb/sth, especially in a sexual way, or in order to show love
senses.chn: （尤指示爱或两性间）爱抚，抚摸

senses.def: in a way that shows great affection

ex.cn: 他深情地望着她。

ex.cn: 我深深地记得我初次工作当记者的情景。

senses.def: in a way that shows hope that is not reasonable or realistic

ex.cn: 我天真地以为你很喜欢我。

senses.def: a Swiss dish of melted cheese and wine into which pieces of bread are dipped
senses.chn: 奶酪火锅（瑞士特色菜，蘸面包片吃）

senses.def: a dish of hot oil into which small pieces of meat, vegetables, etc. are dipped
senses.chn: 热油火锅（在热油中涮肉片、蔬菜等）

senses.def: a large stone bowl in a church that holds water for the ceremony of baptism
senses.chn: 圣洗池（设于教堂中，常为石造）

senses.def: the particular size and style of a set of letters that are used in printing, etc.
a space between the bones of a baby's skull, which makes a soft area on the top of the baby's head
senses.chn: 囟，囟门（婴儿头顶骨未合缝处）

senses.def: things that people or animals eat

ex.en: a shortage of food/food shortages
ex.cn: 粮食短缺

ex.en: food and drink
ex.cn: 食物和饮料

ex.en: the food industry
ex.cn: 食品工业

senses.def: a particular type of food

ex.en: Do you like Italian food?
ex.cn: 你喜欢意大利食物吗？

ex.en: frozen foods
ex.cn: 冷冻食品

ex.en: a can of dog food (= for a dog to eat)
ex.cn: 一罐狗粮

ex.cn: 他不想吃东西。

senses.def: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully
a place where poor people can go to get free food
a series of living creatures in which each type of creature feeds on the one below it in the series

ex.en: Insects are fairly low down (on) the food chain.
ex.cn: 在食物链中，昆虫是级别相当低的生物。

senses.def: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully
a person who is very interested in cooking and eating different kinds of food
a measurement of the distance food has to be transported from the producer to the consumer and the fuel that this uses
senses.chn: 食物里程（指食物从产地运送到消费者手中的距离及油耗）

ex.en: We keep food miles to a minimum by sourcing products locally.
ex.cn: 我们在当地采购产品，从而将食物里程控制在最低。

senses.def: an illness of the stomach caused by eating food that contains harmful bacteria
a piece of equipment that is used to mix or cut up food
senses.chn: 食物料理机；食物加工器

senses.def: the scientific study of food, for example what it is made of, the effects it has on our body, and how to prepare it and store it safely
senses.chn: 食品科学（研究食品成分、对身体的作用及加工和贮存方法等）

senses.def: a piece of paper that is given by the government to poor people, for them to buy food with
any substance that is used as food

ex.cn: 基本食物

senses.def: a system of food chains that are related to and depend on each other
senses.chn: 食物网（即相互关联和依存的食物链体系）

senses.def: a person who you think behaves or speaks in a way that lacks intelligence or good judgement

ex.en: Don't be such a fool!
ex.cn: 别这么傻了！

ex.cn: 我意识到了自己的错误，觉得自己是个傻瓜。

ex.en: He told me he was an actor and I was fool enough to believe him.
ex.cn: 他告诉我他是演员，而我真傻，竟相信了他的话。

senses.def: (in the past) a man employed by a king or queen to entertain people by telling jokes, singing songs, etc.

ex.cn: 别再装傻了，干点实事吧！

ex.cn: 任何人都可以看出她在撒谎。

ex.cn: 她对付难缠的病人很有办法。

senses.def: a person who is not sensible usually spends money too quickly or carelessly, or is cheated by others

ex.cn: 难道你不明白她是在愚弄你？

ex.cn: 他骗取了这份工作。

ex.cn: 你们不许看答案，那是作弊。

ex.cn: 别上当受骗，同他们一起搞什么投资。

ex.en: She deceived him into handing over all his savings.
ex.cn: 她把他所有的积蓄都骗走了。

senses.def: to do sth stupid which makes other people think that you are a fool

ex.cn: 我当众出了大丑了！

senses.def: used to say that you think that sb was stupid to do sth, especially when it causes them problems

ex.cn: 如果你玩火柴，最后可能烧到自己。

senses.def: to waste time instead of doing sth that you should be doing
to have a sexual relationship with another person's partner; to have a sexual relationship with sb who is not your partner

ex.cn: 她一直和一个有妇之夫鬼混。

senses.def: taking unnecessary risks

ex.cn: 这种天气出航就是瞎冒险。

ex.cn: 她不过是个愚蠢虚荣的女人。

ex.cn: 我真蠢，竟相信杰夫和我说的话。
