ex.en: I always wanted to work in TV but it took me two years to get a foot in the door.
ex.cn: 我一直想做电视工作，但花了两年才进了这个圈子。

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

ex.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
ex.cn: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to start doing sth that is new for you
senses.chn: 初次涉足；开始做（新鲜的事情）

ex.en: At that time he was a young actor, just getting his feet wet.
ex.cn: 那时他还是个年轻演员，才初出茅庐。

senses.def: to have a fault or weakness in your character
to have a sensible and realistic attitude to life
to be involved in or connected with two different or opposing groups
to be so old or ill/sick that you are not likely to live much longer
senses.chn: 行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远

senses.def: a strong way of saying that you disagree completely with what has just been said
senses.chn: （完全不同意对方所说）胡说八道

ex.en: 'Ian can't come because he's tired.' 'Tired my foot! Lazy more like!'
ex.cn: “伊恩不能来，因为他累了。” “累个屁！说懒还差不多！”

senses.def: completely well or in a normal state again after an illness or a time of trouble
senses.chn: （困境后）恢复，完全复原；（病后）痊愈

ex.en: Sue's back on her feet again after her operation.
ex.cn: 休手术后又恢复健康了。

ex.en: The new chairman hopes to get the company back on its feet within six months.
ex.cn: 新董事长希望在六个月以内使公司恢复元气。

ex.en: She was too weak to stand.
ex.cn: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

ex.en: Stand still when I'm talking to you!
ex.cn: 我跟你说话，站着别动！

ex.en: We stood talking for a few minutes.
ex.cn: 我们站着谈了几分钟。

ex.en: He stood and looked out to sea.
ex.cn: 他站着向大海望去。

senses.def: to make a great effort to do sth, especially if it is difficult or you are feeling tired
to sit down and relax, especially with your feet raised and supported

ex.en: After a hard day's work, it's nice to get home and put your feet up.
ex.cn: 辛劳一天后回家架起双腿休息是很惬意的。

senses.def: to be very strict in opposing what sb wishes to do

ex.en: You've got to put your foot down and make him stop seeing her.
ex.cn: 你得坚决制止他再见她。

senses.def: to drive faster

ex.en: She put her foot down and roared past them.
ex.cn: 她猛踩油门，从他们旁边呼啸而过。

senses.def: to say or do sth that upsets, offends or embarrasses sb
senses.chn: （在语言或行为上）使人不安，冒犯别人，使人尴尬

ex.en: I really put my foot in it with Ella—I didn't know she'd split up with Tom.
ex.cn: 我真的冒犯了埃拉，我不知道她和汤姆分手了。

senses.def: to make a mistake

ex.en: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.
ex.cn: 他在上两局比赛中几乎一点错都没有出。

senses.def: to enter or visit a place

ex.en: the first man to set foot on the moon
ex.cn: 第一个登上月球的人

ex.en: I vowed never to set foot in the place again.
ex.cn: 我发誓再不去那个地方了。

senses.def: to make sb/sth independent or successful

ex.en: His business sense helped set the club on its feet again.
ex.cn: 他的经营意识使俱乐部又重振雄风。

senses.def: to be independent and able to take care of yourself

ex.en: When his parents died he had to learn to stand on his own two feet.
ex.cn: 他的父母去世后他不得不学会自立。

senses.def: in the way; stopping you from working, etc.
senses.chn: 阻碍，妨碍（工作等）；碍手碍脚

ex.en: I don't want you kids under my feet while I'm cooking.
ex.cn: 我做饭时不希望你们这些孩子在我这儿碍手碍脚的。

senses.def: used to say that a situation has changed so that sb now has power or authority over the person who used to have power or authority over them
senses.chn: 情况正好相反；宾主易位

senses.def: to suddenly become nervous about doing sth that you had planned to do

ex.en: He was going to ask her but he got cold feet and said nothing.
ex.cn: 他本来是想问她的，可事到临头他却胆怯得什么也没有说。

senses.def: to be deliberately slow in doing sth or in making a decision
senses.chn: 故意拖拉；故意延迟（作出决定）

senses.def: to become able to act independently and with confidence
senses.chn: 已能独立而有信心地工作；已适应新环境

ex.en: I only recently joined the firm so I'm still finding my feet.
ex.cn: 我最近才加入这家公司，所以还在适应过程中。

senses.def: to not delay in getting things done
to suddenly spoil sb's idea or plan by doing sth to stop them from continuing with it
senses.chn: 挖某人的墙脚；破坏某人的计划；拆某人的台

senses.def: to tie sb's hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
to prevent sb from doing what they want by creating rules, restrictions, etc.
covering your whole body

ex.en: We were covered from head to foot in mud.
ex.cn: 我们浑身是泥。

senses.def: to want to travel or move to a different place; to want to do sth different
senses.chn: 渴望旅行（或换个地方、做别的事）

senses.def: to be very awkward in your movements, especially when you are dancing or playing a sport
senses.chn: （尤指跳舞或体育运动时）非常笨拙，笨手笨脚

senses.def: a way of referring to children when sb wants, or is going to have, a baby
senses.chn: （用于想要或即将有孩子时）小宝宝的脚步声

ex.en: We can't wait to hear the patter of tiny feet.
ex.cn: 我们恨不得早点儿有个小宝宝。

senses.def: to take help or support away from sb suddenly
used to say that a situation has changed so that sb now has power or authority over the person who used to have power or authority over them
senses.chn: 情况正好相反；宾主易位

senses.def: to do or say sth that will cause you a lot of trouble or harm, especially when you are trying to get an advantage for yourself
to admire sb very much, especially a teacher or sb from whom you try to learn
wearing socks or stockings but not shoes
to make sb fall suddenly and deeply in love with you
senses.chn: 使某人立刻迷上自己；使某人对自己一见倾心

senses.def: to be able to think and react to things very quickly and effectively without any preparation
to show what you think about sth by going or not going somewhere
senses.chn: 用脚投票（用去或不去某处表示想法）

ex.en: Shoppers voted with their feet and avoided the store.
ex.cn: 购物者对那家商店避而远之。

senses.def: to take care of sb's needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.chn: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

senses.def: to make sb walk so far or so fast that they are very tired
to sit down and rest, especially when you are tired
senses.chn: （尤指疲乏时）坐下歇歇脚，坐下喘口气

ex.en: Come and sit down and take the weight off your feet for a while.
ex.cn: 来坐下歇一会儿吧。

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
to be responsible for paying the cost of sth

ex.en: Once again it will be the taxpayer who has to foot the bill.
ex.cn: 这一次掏腰包的又得是纳税人。

senses.def: part of a film showing a particular event

ex.en: old film footage of the moon landing
ex.cn: 一段登月的老影片

senses.def: a disease of cows, sheep, etc., which causes sore places on the mouth and feet
senses.chn: 口蹄疫，口蹄病（牛羊等的疾病，引起口、蹄溃疡）

senses.def: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team's goal.

ex.en: to play football
ex.cn: 踢足球

ex.en: a football match/team/stadium
ex.cn: 足球比赛；足球队；足球场

senses.def: a large round or oval ball made of leather or plastic and filled with air
an issue or a problem that frequently causes argument and disagreement
senses.chn: 屡起争议的课题；被踢来踢去的难题

ex.en: Health care should not become a political football.
ex.cn: 保健问题不应该成为被踢来踢去的政治皮球。

senses.def: a leather shoe with pieces of rubber on the bottom to stop it slipping, worn for playing football (soccer)
senses.chn: 足球鞋（鞋底有防滑橡胶钉）

senses.def: a person who plays football (soccer) , especially as a profession
connected with the game of football (soccer)
senses.chn: 足球的；与足球比赛有关的

ex.en: footballing skills
ex.cn: 足球技巧

senses.def: a form of gambling in Britain in which people try to win money by saying what the results of football (soccer) matches will be
senses.chn: 赌球，足球普尔（猜足球赛结果的赌博）

ex.en: They've had a big win on the football pools.
ex.cn: 他们在赌球中赢了一大笔钱。

senses.def: a brake in a vehicle which is operated using your foot
a narrow bridge used only by people who are walking
a line or block of text that is automatically added to the bottom of every page that is printed from a computer
senses.chn: （计算机打印的每页的）页脚，页尾

senses.def: a line at the bottom of a page on the Internet

ex.en: a website footer
ex.cn: 一个网站页脚

senses.def: the sound of the steps made by sb walking
the number of people that visit a particular shop/store, shopping centre, etc. over a period of time
senses.chn: 客流，人流（商店、购物中心在一段时间内的访客人数）

ex.en: a campaign to increase footfall
ex.cn: 旨在增加客流的活动

senses.def: a mistake that is made by not keeping behind the line when serving
senses.chn: 脚误，脚部犯规（发球踏线）

senses.def: a hill or low mountain at the base of a higher mountain or range of mountains

ex.en: the foothills of the Himalayas
ex.cn: 喜马拉雅山脉山麓丘陵

senses.def: a crack, hole or branch where your foot can be safely supported when climbing
senses.chn: 立足处（攀登时足可踩的缝、洞、树枝等）

senses.def: a strong position in a business, profession, etc. from which sb can make progress and achieve success
senses.chn: （可以此发展或取得成功的）稳固地位，立足点

ex.en: The company is eager to gain a foothold in Europe.
ex.cn: 这家公司急于在欧洲取得一席之地。

senses.def: the position of your feet when they are safely on the ground or some other surface

ex.en: She lost her footing (= she slipped or lost her balance) and fell backwards into the water.
ex.cn: 她脚未站稳，向后一仰掉进水中。

ex.en: I slipped and struggled to regain my footing.
ex.cn: 我滑了一下，但挣扎着站稳了脚跟。

senses.def: the basis on which sth is established or organized

ex.en: The company is now on a sound financial footing.
ex.cn: 该公司现在已是资金稳健。

ex.en: The country has been on a war footing (= prepared for war) since March.
ex.cn: 自三月份起这个国家就准备要打仗。

senses.def: the position or status of sb/sth in relation to others; the relationship between two or more people or groups

ex.en: The two groups must meet on an equal footing.
ex.cn: 这两个集团必须以平等地位会谈。

ex.en: They were demanding to be treated on the same footing as the rest of the teachers.
ex.cn: 他们要求得到和其他老师同等的待遇。

senses.def: a row of lights along the front of the stage in a theatre
senses.chn: 脚灯（舞台前面的一排灯）

senses.def: not important and likely to make you annoyed
senses.chn: 无足轻重的；无聊（而烦人）的

senses.def: free to go where you like or do what you want because you have no responsibilities
senses.chn: 行动无拘无束的；自由自在的

ex.en: Bert was a footloose, unemployed actor.
ex.cn: 伯特是不受雇于任何人的自由演员。

ex.en: Ah, I was still footloose and fancy-free (= free to enjoy myself) in those days.
ex.cn: 啊，那些日子我还是自由自在、无忧无虑的。

senses.def: a male servant in a house in the past, who opened the door to visitors, served food at table, etc.
an extra piece of information that is printed at the bottom of a page in a book
that may be remembered but only as sth/sb that is not important
a narrow bridge used only by people who are walking
a path that is made for people to walk along, especially in the country

ex.en: a public footpath
ex.cn: 人行道

senses.def: the part of a steam train's engine where the driver stands
a mark left on a surface by a person's foot or shoe or by an animal's foot

ex.en: footprints in the sand
ex.cn: 沙地足迹

ex.en: muddy footprints on the kitchen floor
ex.cn: 厨房地板上的泥脚印

senses.def: the amount of space that sth fills, for example the amount of space that a computer takes up on a desk
the area on the earth in which a signal from a communications satellite can be received
a support for your foot or feet, for example on a motorcycle or when you are sitting down
to touch sb's feet lightly with your own feet, especially under a table, as an expression of affection or sexual interest
senses.chn: （在桌下）与某人脚碰脚调情，脚挨脚爱抚

senses.def: a soldier who fights on foot, not on a horse or in a vehicle
a person in an organization who does work that is important but boring, and who has no power or responsibility
senses.chn: （组织中从事乏味工作而不担责任，但又不可或缺的）群众员工

senses.def: having sore or tired feet, especially after walking a long way
the sound or mark made each time your foot touches the ground when you are walking or running

ex.en: the sound of footsteps on the stairs
ex.cn: 楼梯上的脚步声

ex.en: footsteps in the snow
ex.cn: 雪地上的足迹

ex.en: She works in television, following in her father's footsteps.
ex.cn: 她步父亲的后尘，在电视台工作。

senses.def: a low piece of furniture used for resting your feet on when you are sitting
to be responsible for paying the cost of sth

ex.en: Once again it will be the taxpayer who has to foot the bill.
ex.cn: 这一次掏腰包的又得是纳税人。

senses.def: a flat part at the side of a road for people to walk on
things that people wear on their feet, for example shoes and boots

ex.en: Be sure to wear the correct footwear to prevent injuries to your feet.
ex.cn: 一定要穿合适的鞋，以免脚受伤。

senses.def: the way in which a person moves their feet when playing a sport or dancing
the ability to react quickly and skilfully to a difficult situation

ex.en: It was going to take some deft political footwork to save the situation.
ex.cn: 当时得采取一些巧妙的政治手段以挽回局势。

senses.def: a man who is too interested in his clothes and the way he looks
used to show who is intended to have or use sth or where sth is intended to be put

ex.en: There's a letter for you.
ex.cn: 有你一封信。

ex.en: It's a book for children.
ex.cn: 这是本儿童读物。

ex.en: We got a new table for the dining room.
ex.cn: 我们给饭厅添了一张新桌子。

ex.en: This is the place for me (= I like it very much).
ex.cn: 这里很适合我。

senses.def: in order to help sb/sth

ex.en: What can I do for you (= how can I help you)?
ex.cn: 有什么事我可以为你效劳？

ex.en: Can you translate this letter for me?
ex.cn: 你能为我翻译这封信吗？

ex.en: I took her classes for her while she was sick.
ex.cn: 她生病时我为她代课。

ex.en: soldiers fighting for their country
ex.cn: 为祖国战斗的军人

senses.def: concerning sb/sth

ex.en: They are anxious for her safety.
ex.cn: 他们为她的安全担心。

ex.en: Fortunately for us, the weather changed.
ex.cn: 我们运气好，天气变了。

senses.def: as a representative of

ex.en: I am speaking for everyone in this department.
ex.cn: 我代表这个部门全体人员讲话。

senses.def: employed by

ex.en: She's working for IBM.
ex.cn: 她在 IBM 公司工作。

senses.def: meaning

ex.en: Shaking your head for 'No' is not universal.
ex.cn: 以摇头表示 “不”，并非放诸四海而皆准。

senses.def: in support of sb/sth

ex.en: Are you for or against the proposal?
ex.cn: 你支持还是反对这个建议？

ex.en: They voted for independence in a referendum.
ex.cn: 他们在全民公决投票中赞成独立。

ex.en: There's a strong case for postponing the exam.
ex.cn: 有充分理由推迟考试。

ex.en: I'm all for people having fun.
ex.cn: 我完全赞成人们尽情享乐。

senses.def: used to show purpose or function

ex.en: a machine for slicing bread
ex.cn: 面包切片机

ex.en: Let's go for a walk.
ex.cn: 咱们去散散步。

ex.en: Are you learning English for pleasure or for your work?
ex.cn: 你学英语是出于消遣还是为了工作？

ex.en: What did you do that for (= Why did you do that)?
ex.cn: 你为什么干那件事？

senses.def: used to show a reason or cause

ex.en: The town is famous for its cathedral.
ex.cn: 这个城镇以大教堂著名。

ex.en: She gave me a watch for my birthday.
ex.cn: 她送给我一块手表作为生日礼物。

ex.en: He got an award for bravery.
ex.cn: 他因英勇受奖。

ex.en: I couldn't speak for laughing.
ex.cn: 我笑得说不出话来。

senses.def: in order to obtain sth

ex.en: He came to me for advice.
ex.cn: 他来征求我的意见。

ex.en: For more information, call this number.
ex.cn: 欲知详情，请拨打此电话号码。

ex.en: There were over fifty applicants for the job.
ex.cn: 有五十多人申请这个工作。

senses.def: in exchange for sth

ex.en: Copies are available for two dollars each.
ex.cn: 两美元一份。

ex.en: I'll swap these two bottles for that one.
ex.cn: 我要拿这两瓶换那一瓶。

senses.def: considering what can be expected from sb/sth

ex.en: The weather was warm for the time of year.
ex.cn: 在一年的这个时节这天气算是暖和的了。

ex.en: She's tall for her age.
ex.cn: 从她这个年龄看她个子算是高的。

ex.en: That's too much responsibility for a child.
ex.cn: 对于一个孩子来说，这责任是太重了。

senses.def: better, happier, etc. following sth

ex.en: You'll feel better for a good night's sleep.
ex.cn: 你晚上睡个好觉就会觉得好些。

ex.en: This room would look more cheerful for a spot of paint.
ex.cn: 这个房间油漆一下就会显得更加悦目。

senses.def: used to show where sb/sth is going

ex.en: Is this the bus for Chicago?
ex.cn: 这辆公共汽车是去芝加哥的吗？

ex.en: She knew she was destined for a great future.
ex.cn: 她知道她注定要成大器。

senses.def: used to show a length of time

ex.en: I'm going away for a few days.
ex.cn: 我要离开几天。

ex.en: That's all the news there is for now.
ex.cn: 目前新闻就这么多。

senses.def: used to show that sth is arranged or intended to happen at a particular time

ex.en: an appointment for May 12
ex.cn: 5 月 12 日的一次约见

ex.en: We're invited for 7.30.
ex.cn: 我们受到邀请，7 点 30 分出席。

senses.def: used to show the occasion when sth happens

ex.en: I'm warning you for the last time—stop talking!
ex.cn: 我最后一次警告你，闭嘴！

senses.def: used to show a distance

ex.en: The road went on for miles and miles.
ex.cn: 这条道路绵延到很远的地方。

senses.def: used to say how difficult, necessary, pleasant, etc. sth is that sb might do or has done
senses.chn: 对（某人）来说（困难、必需、愉快等）

ex.en: It's useless for us to continue.
ex.cn: 我们继续做下去也无用。

ex.en: There's no need for you to go.
ex.cn: 你不必走。

ex.en: For her to have survived such an ordeal was remarkable.
ex.cn: 她经历了那样的苦难活下来了，真不简单。

ex.en: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
ex.cn: 这只箱子太沉，我搬不动。

ex.en: Is it clear enough for you to read?
ex.cn: 这个你读起来清不清楚？

senses.def: used to show who can or should do sth

ex.en: It's not for me to say why he left.
ex.cn: 由我说出他离开的原因不合适。

ex.en: How to spend the money is for you to decide.
ex.cn: 怎样花这笔钱由你决定。

senses.def: to be going to get into trouble or be punished

ex.en: We'd better hurry or we'll be in for it.
ex.cn: 我们最好赶快，不然要受罚的。

senses.def: despite

ex.en: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
ex.cn: 这本书虽然文体清晰，但读起来并不容易。

senses.def: used to say that sth is not important or of no interest or value to you/sb
senses.chn: （表示对某人不重要、无价值或无所谓）

ex.en: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
ex.cn: 据我所知，她还住在波士顿。

ex.en: You can do what you like, for all I care.
ex.cn: 你想干什么就可以干什么，我才不管呢。

ex.en: For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
ex.cn: 那件事带来的好处不多，我们本不该操心的。

senses.def: used to say that sth is a typical example of its kind

ex.en: She might at least have called to explain. There's gratitude for you.
ex.cn: 她本来至少可以来电话解释一下。她就这么表示感谢。

senses.def: used to introduce the reason for sth mentioned in the previous statement

ex.en: We listened eagerly, for he brought news of our families.
ex.cn: 我们急不可待地听着，因为他带来了我们家人的消息。

ex.en: I believed her—for surely she would not lie to me.
ex.cn: 我相信她的话，因为她肯定不会向我撒谎。

senses.def: to search for food
to search for sth, especially using the hands
food for horses and cows

ex.en: forage crops/grass
ex.cn: 饲料作物；饲草

senses.def: despite

ex.en: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
ex.cn: 这本书虽然文体清晰，但读起来并不容易。

senses.def: used to say that sth is not important or of no interest or value to you/sb
senses.chn: （表示对某人不重要、无价值或无所谓）

ex.en: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
ex.cn: 据我所知，她还住在波士顿。

ex.en: You can do what you like, for all I care.
ex.cn: 你想干什么就可以干什么，我才不管呢。

ex.en: For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
ex.cn: 那件事带来的好处不多，我们本不该操心的。

senses.def: very cheaply; at a low price
used to emphasize the first of a list of reasons, opinions, etc.
senses.chn: （强调一系列理由、意见等的第一条）首先

ex.en: I'm not working there—for a start, it's too far to travel.
ex.cn: 我不去那边干活儿。首先，路太远，去不了。

senses.def: an attempt to become involved in a different activity or profession

ex.en: the company's first foray into the computer market
ex.cn: 该公司对计算机市场的初次涉足

senses.def: a short sudden attack made by a group of soldiers
a short journey to find a particular thing or to visit a new place
senses.chn: 短途（寻物）；短暂访问（新地方）

ex.en: weekend shopping forays to France
ex.cn: 周末赴法国购物

senses.def: to stop yourself from saying or doing sth that you could or would like to say or do
senses.chn: 克制；自制；忍住（不说话或不做某事）

ex.en: He wanted to answer back, but he forbore from doing so.
ex.cn: 他想顶嘴，但是忍住了。

ex.en: She forbore to ask any further questions.
ex.cn: 她克制自己，不再进一步提问。

senses.def: the quality of being patient and sympathetic towards other people, especially when they have done sth wrong
showing forbearance

ex.en: Thank you for being so forbearing.
ex.cn: 感谢您如此宽宏大量。

senses.def: to order sb not to do sth; to order that sth must not be done

ex.en: He forbade them from mentioning the subject again.
ex.cn: 他不准他们再提这个话题。

ex.en: Her father forbade the marriage.
ex.cn: 她的父亲不允许这桩婚事。

ex.en: You are all forbidden to leave.
ex.cn: 你们都不准离开。

ex.en: My doctor has forbidden me sugar.
ex.cn: 医生禁止我吃糖。

ex.en: She knew her mother would forbid her going.
ex.cn: 她知道她妈妈是不会让她去的。

ex.en: I'm sorry, smoking isn't allowed. / You're not allowed to smoke here.
ex.cn: 对不起，不准吸烟。／这里不准吸烟。

senses.def: to make it difficult or impossible to do sth

ex.en: Lack of space forbids further treatment of the topic here.
ex.cn: 由于篇幅所限，这里不能深入阐述这个问题。

senses.def: used to say that you hope that sth will not happen

ex.en: 'Maybe you'll end up as a lawyer, like me.' 'God forbid!'
ex.cn: “也许你会像我一样，最终成为律师。” “但愿不会这样！”

senses.def: not allowed

ex.en: Photography is strictly forbidden in the museum.
ex.cn: 博物馆内禁止摄影。

ex.en: The conversation was in danger of wandering into forbidden territory (= topics that they were not allowed to talk about).
ex.cn: 谈话很可能离题而涉及禁止讨论的领域。

senses.def: a thing that is not allowed and that therefore seems very attractive
senses.chn: 禁果（唯其禁止，故特别诱人）

senses.def: a thing that is not allowed and that therefore seems very attractive
senses.chn: 禁果（唯其禁止，故特别诱人）

senses.def: seeming unfriendly and frightening

ex.en: a forbidding appearance/look/manner
ex.cn: 冷峻的样子／面孔／态度

ex.en: The house looked dark and forbidding.
ex.cn: 房子黑森森的，令人望而生畏。

senses.def: violent physical action used to obtain or achieve sth

ex.en: The release of the hostages could not be achieved without the use of force.
ex.cn: 不使用武力不可能使人质获释。

ex.en: The rioters were taken away by force.
ex.cn: 聚众闹事者被强行带走。

ex.en: The ultimatum contained the threat of military force.
ex.cn: 这份最后通牒含有武力威胁。

ex.en: We will achieve much more by persuasion than by brute force.
ex.cn: 我们通过说服会比使用暴力更有成效。

senses.def: the physical strength of sth that is shown as it hits sth else

ex.en: the force of the blow/explosion/collision
ex.cn: 打击力；爆炸力；碰撞力

ex.en: The shopping centre took the full force of the blast.
ex.cn: 购物中心承受了全部爆炸力。

senses.def: the strong effect or influence of sth

ex.en: They realized the force of her argument.
ex.cn: 他们领悟到了她那论据的威力。

ex.en: He controlled himself by sheer force of will.
ex.cn: 他全凭意志力控制住了自己。

ex.en: She spoke with force and deliberation.
ex.cn: 她讲话铿锵有力，字斟句酌。

senses.def: a person or thing that has a lot of power or influence
senses.chn: 力量大的人（或事物）；影响大的人（或事物）

ex.en: economic/market forces
ex.cn: 经济／市场力量

ex.en: the forces of good/evil
ex.cn: 善／恶的力量

ex.en: Ron is the driving force (= the person who has the most influence) behind the project.
ex.cn: 罗恩是这个计划的主心骨。

ex.en: She's a force to be reckoned with (= a person who has a lot of power and influence and should therefore be treated seriously).
ex.cn: 她是个有影响力的人物，需要认真对待。

ex.en: The expansion of higher education should be a powerful force for change.
ex.cn: 高等教育的发展对变革应该是一个强大的推动力。

senses.def: the authority of sth

ex.en: These guidelines do not have the force of law.
ex.cn: 这些指导原则不具有法律效力。

ex.en: The court ruled that these standards have force in English law.
ex.cn: 法院裁定，这些标准在英格兰法律中有效。

senses.def: a group of people who have been organized for a particular purpose
senses.chn: （为某目的组织起来的）一群人

ex.en: a member of the sales force
ex.cn: 销售团队中的一员

ex.en: A large proportion of the labour force (= all the people who work in a particular company, area, etc.) is unskilled.
ex.cn: 很大一部分劳动力是非熟练工。

senses.def: a group of people who have been trained to protect other people, usually by using weapons

ex.en: a member of the security forces
ex.cn: 安全部队成员

ex.en: rebel/government forces
ex.cn: 反叛／政府武装力量

ex.en: a peace-keeping force
ex.cn: 维和部队

senses.def: the army, navy and air force
senses.chn: 兵力，武装力量（陆海空三军）

ex.en: allied forces
ex.cn: 盟军

senses.def: the weapons and soldiers that an army, etc. has, considered as things that may be used

ex.en: strategic nuclear forces
ex.cn: 战略核部队

senses.def: the police force

ex.en: He joined the force twenty years ago.
ex.cn: 他二十年前加入了警队。

senses.def: an effect that causes things to move in a particular way

ex.en: The moon exerts a force on the earth.
ex.cn: 月球对地球有引力。

ex.en: the force of gravity
ex.cn: 重力

ex.en: magnetic/centrifugal force
ex.cn: 磁力；离心力

senses.def: a unit for measuring the strength of the wind

ex.en: a force 9 gale
ex.cn: 9 级大风

ex.en: a gale force wind
ex.cn: 一场大风级的风

senses.def: to cause a law, rule, etc. to start being used
senses.chn: （使法律、规则等）开始生效，开始实施

ex.en: They are hoping to bring the new legislation into force before the end of the year.
ex.cn: 他们希望在年底前实施新法。

senses.def: to start being used

ex.en: When do the new regulations come into force?
ex.cn: 新规章什么时候开始执行？

senses.def: if you do sth from or out of force of habit, you do it automatically and in a particular way because you have always done it that way in the past
the power of the wind, rain, etc., especially when it causes damage or harm
senses.chn: （尤指造成损害的）自然力；大自然的力量

senses.def: in large numbers

ex.en: Protesters turned out in force.
ex.cn: 有很多抗议者到场。

senses.def: being used

ex.en: The new regulations are now in force.
ex.cn: 新规章现已生效。

senses.def: to work together in order to achieve a shared aim

ex.en: The two firms joined forces to win the contract.
ex.cn: 两家公司联合起来争取合同。

senses.def: a person or group that no longer has any power or influence
senses.chn: 威势不再的人（或集团）；不再有影响力的人（或集团）

senses.def: to make sb do sth that they do not want to do

ex.en: The President was forced into resigning.
ex.cn: 总统被迫辞职。

ex.en: The President was forced to resign.
ex.cn: 总统被迫辞职。

ex.en: I was forced to take a taxi because the last bus had left.
ex.cn: 最后一班公共汽车已经开走，所以我只好叫了一辆出租车。

ex.en: She forced herself to be polite to them.
ex.cn: 她对他们强装客气。

ex.en: Ill health forced him into early retirement.
ex.cn: 他由于健康不佳不得不提前退休。

ex.en: He didn't force me—I wanted to go.
ex.cn: 他没有逼迫我，是我想去的。

senses.def: to use physical strength to move sb/sth into a particular position

ex.en: to force a lock/window/door (= to break it open using force)
ex.cn: 强行打开锁／窗／门

ex.en: to force an entry (= to enter a building using force)
ex.cn: 强行进入建筑物

ex.en: She forced her way through the crowd of reporters.
ex.cn: 她在记者群中挤出一条路。

ex.en: He tried to force a copy of his book into my hand.
ex.cn: 他硬要把他的一本书往我手里塞。

ex.en: The door had been forced open.
ex.cn: 门被强行打开了。

senses.def: to make sth happen, especially before other people are ready
senses.chn: 使发生（尤指趁他人尚未准备好）

ex.en: He was in a position where he had to force a decision.
ex.cn: 他当时的处境是，不得不强行通过一项决定。

ex.en: Building a new road here will force house prices down.
ex.cn: 在这里修建一条新道路将使房价下跌。

senses.def: to make yourself smile, laugh, etc. rather than doing it naturally

ex.en: She managed to force a smile.
ex.cn: 她勉强笑笑。

senses.def: to make fruit, plants, etc. grow or develop faster than normal by keeping them in special conditions
senses.chn: 人工催长；加速（水果、植物等）生长；催熟

ex.en: forced rhubarb
ex.cn: 人工催长的大黄

ex.en: It is unwise to force a child's talent.
ex.cn: 对儿童的才能拔苗助长是不明智的。

senses.def: to make sb do sth that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended
senses.chn: 迫使某人做某事（或提前行动）

senses.def: to do sth to make people take a decision quickly
to run very fast in a race in order to make the other people taking part run faster
to make sb do sth faster than they want to

ex.en: The demonstrations have succeeded in forcing the pace of change.
ex.cn: 示威成功地促使改革进程加快。

senses.def: to try to force sb to listen to and accept your opinions in a way that they find annoying
senses.chn: 强加于人；强迫接受（观点）

senses.def: to make yourself hide an emotion

ex.en: She swallowed hard and forced back her tears.
ex.cn: 她使劲咽了一下口水，强忍住了眼泪。

senses.def: to make yourself eat or drink sth that you do not really want
to make a plane, etc. land, especially by threatening to attack it
to make sb accept sth that they do not want

ex.en: to force your attentions/opinions/company on sb
ex.cn: 强行对（某人）献殷勤；把意见强加给（某人）；硬要陪伴（某人）

senses.def: to make sb tell you sth, especially by threatening them
senses.chn: 强迫说出（尤其通过威胁）

ex.en: I managed to force the truth out of him.
ex.cn: 我设法迫使他说出了实情。

senses.def: happening or done against sb's will

ex.en: forced relocation to a job in another city
ex.cn: 不得已迁移至另一城市工作

ex.en: a forced sale of his property
ex.cn: 强制变卖他的财产

senses.def: not sincere; not the result of genuine emotions

ex.en: She said she was enjoying herself but her smile was forced.
ex.cn: 她说自己很快活，但是她的笑容很勉强。

senses.def: an occasion when sb enters a building illegally, using force
hard physical work that sb, often a prisoner or slave, is forced to do
senses.chn: （对囚犯、奴隶等实施的）强制劳动

senses.def: prisoners or slaves who are forced to work
senses.chn: 强制劳工（如囚犯或奴隶）

ex.en: The mines were manned by forced labour from conquered countries.
ex.cn: 这些矿由来自被征服国家的强制劳工开采。

senses.def: an act of having to land an aircraft unexpectedly in order to avoid a crash

ex.en: to make a forced landing
ex.cn: 强行着陆

senses.def: a long march, usually made by soldiers in difficult conditions
to use force to make sb, especially a prisoner, eat or drink, by putting food or drink down their throat
senses.chn: 强迫进食（尤指把饮食灌进囚犯等口中）

senses.def: a barrier that you cannot see
expressing opinions firmly and clearly in a way that persuades other people to believe them

ex.en: a forceful woman/speaker
ex.cn: 强有力的女人；说话有说服力的人

ex.en: a forceful personality
ex.cn: 坚强的个性

senses.def: expressed firmly and clearly so that other people believe them

ex.en: a forceful argument/speech
ex.cn: 有说服力的论据／演讲

senses.def: using force

ex.en: the forceful suppression of minorities
ex.cn: 对少数族群的武力镇压

senses.def: unexpected circumstances, such as war, that can be used as an excuse when they prevent sb from doing sth that is written in a contract
senses.chn: 不可抗力（如战争，常指未能履行合约的原因）

senses.def: a mixture of meat or vegetables cut into very small pieces, which is often placed inside a chicken, etc. before it is cooked to give it flavour
senses.chn: （常作烹饪填料用的）碎肉，菜末

senses.def: if you do sth from or out of force of habit, you do it automatically and in a particular way because you have always done it that way in the past
a situation in which a player running to a base is out because a fielder is holding the ball at the base
an instrument used by doctors, with two long thin parts for picking up and holding things

ex.en: a pair of forceps
ex.cn: 一把镊子

ex.en: a forceps delivery (= a birth in which the baby is delivered with the help of forceps )
ex.cn: 产钳分娩

senses.def: without doubt

ex.en: I can't say for certain when we'll arrive.
ex.cn: 我说不准我们什么时候能到。

senses.def: to make sb do sth that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended
senses.chn: 迫使某人做某事（或提前行动）

senses.def: to make sb tell you sth, especially by threatening them
senses.chn: 强迫说出（尤其通过威胁）

ex.en: I managed to force the truth out of him.
ex.cn: 我设法迫使他说出了实情。

senses.def: to do sth to make people take a decision quickly
to run very fast in a race in order to make the other people taking part run faster
to make sb do sth faster than they want to

ex.en: The demonstrations have succeeded in forcing the pace of change.
ex.cn: 示威成功地促使改革进程加快。

senses.def: a swear word that many people find offensive, used to show that you are angry, annoyed or surprised
senses.chn: （很多人认为含冒犯意，表示生气、恼火或吃惊）天哪，上帝

ex.en: For Chrissake, listen!
ex.cn: 天哪，听！

senses.def: involving the use of physical force

ex.en: forcible repatriation
ex.cn: 强行遣返

ex.en: The police checked all windows and doors for signs of forcible entry.
ex.cn: 警察检查了所有的门窗以寻找强行闯入的痕迹。

senses.def: in a way that involves the use of physical force

ex.en: Supporters were forcibly removed from the court.
ex.cn: 支持者都被强行从法庭赶走。

senses.def: in a way that makes sth very clear

ex.en: It struck me forcibly how honest he'd been.
ex.cn: 我猛然醒悟他是多么的正直。

senses.def: used to show you are angry or surprised
senses.chn: （表示愤怒或惊讶）哎呀，我的天哪，真是岂有此理

ex.en: For crying out loud! Why did you have to do that?
ex.cn: 真是岂有此理！你为什么非得干那种事？

senses.def: a shallow place in a river where it is possible to drive or walk across
senses.chn: （可涉过或驶过的）河流浅水处

senses.def: to walk or drive across a river or stream
as hard or as fast as possible

ex.en: She was holding on to the rope for dear life.
ex.cn: 她死命抓着那根绳子。

ex.en: Run for your life!
ex.cn: 快跑啊！

senses.def: to be/become important and noticed by people; to play an important part
senses.chn: 变得重要（或突出）；起重要作用

ex.en: The problem has come to the fore again in recent months.
ex.cn: 近几个月来这个问题又成为热点。

ex.en: She has always been to the fore at moments of crisis.
ex.cn: 在危急时刻她总是挺身而出。

senses.def: to make sth become noticed by people
senses.chn: 使处于显要地位；使突出

senses.def: located at the front of a ship, an aircraft or an animal
senses.chn: 在（船、航空器或动物）前部的；在头部的

senses.def: at or towards the front of a ship or an aircraft
senses.chn: 在（或向）船头；在（或向）飞行器头部

senses.def: used in the game of golf to warn people that they are in the path of a ball that you are hitting
senses.chn: 前方注意，看球（打高尔夫球时警告前面球路中的人以免被击中）

senses.def: before; in advance

ex.en: foreword
ex.cn: 前言

ex.en: foretell
ex.cn: 预言

senses.def: in the front of

ex.en: the foreground of the picture
ex.cn: 图画的前景

senses.def: the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist
if you know about problems, dangers, etc. before they happen, you can be better prepared for them
a person in your family who lived a long time ago
a strong feeling that sth unpleasant or dangerous is going to happen
senses.chn: （对不祥或危险事情的）强烈预感

ex.en: She had a sense of foreboding that the news would be bad.
ex.cn: 她预感到这会是坏消息。

ex.en: He knew from her face that his forebodings had been justified.
ex.cn: 他从她的脸上看出，自己不祥的预感是正确的。

senses.def: the front part of the brain
a statement about what will happen in the future, based on information that is available now

ex.en: sales forecasts
ex.cn: 销售预测

ex.en: The forecast said there would be sunny intervals and showers.
ex.cn: 预报间晴，有阵雨。

senses.def: to say what you think will happen in the future based on information that you have now

ex.en: Experts are forecasting a recovery in the economy.
ex.cn: 专家预测经济将复苏。

ex.en: Snow is forecast for tomorrow.
ex.cn: 预报明天有雪。

ex.en: Temperatures were forecast to reach 40°C.
ex.cn: 预报温度将达 40 摄氏度。

ex.en: The report forecasts that prices will rise by 3% next month.
ex.cn: 报告预测下月物价将上涨 3%。

ex.en: It is difficult to forecast how the markets will react.
ex.cn: 很难预测市场会有什么样的反应。

ex.en: The number of people using mobile phones to purchase goods and services is expected / likely to more than double by the end of 2015.
ex.cn: 到 2015 年年底，使用手机购买商品和服务的人数预计／可能会是现在的两倍多。

senses.def: a person who says what is expected to happen, especially sb whose job is to forecast the weather
senses.chn: 预测者；（尤指）天气预报员，气象预报员

ex.en: a weather forecaster
ex.cn: 天气预报员

ex.en: an economic forecaster
ex.cn: 经济预测专家

senses.def: the front part of a ship below the deck, where the sailors live
to take control of sb's property because they have not paid back money that they borrowed to buy it
senses.chn: （因抵押人未如期还贷）取消（抵押品）赎回权

senses.def: to reject sth as a possibility
the act of foreclosing on money that has been borrowed; an example of this
a large open space in front of a building, for example a petrol station/ gas station or hotel, often used for parking cars on
senses.chn: 大片空地（在加油站或旅馆等建筑物前面，常用作停车场）

senses.def: that will not be successful, as if fate has decided this from the beginning

ex.en: Any attempt to construct an ideal society is foredoomed to failure.
ex.cn: 要构建一个完美无缺的社会，这样的努力注定失败。

senses.def: a person (especially a man) in your family who lived a long time ago
the finger next to the thumb
either of the two front feet of an animal that has four feet
in or into an important or leading position in a particular group or activity
senses.chn: 处于最前列；进入重要地位（或主要地位）

ex.en: Women have always been at the forefront of the Green movement.
ex.cn: 妇女总是在环境保护运动的最前列。

ex.en: The new product took the company to the forefront of the computer software field.
ex.cn: 该新产品使这家公司跻身计算机软件业的前列。

ex.en: The court case was constantly in the forefront of my mind (= I thought about it all the time).
ex.cn: 这个诉讼案件一直萦系在我的心头。

senses.def: to meet together in a group
used to refer to sth that has just been mentioned

ex.en: the foregoing discussion
ex.cn: 上述讨论

senses.def: what has just been mentioned
senses.chn: 前面所提到的事物；以上所述

senses.def: if you say that sth is a foregone conclusion, you mean that it is a result that is certain to happen
the part of a view, picture, etc. that is nearest to you when you look at it

ex.en: The figure in the foreground is the artist's mother.
ex.cn: 图画前景中的人是画家的母亲。

ex.en: The picture shows a family gathered around a kitchen table.
ex.cn: 照片中一家人围坐在餐桌旁。

ex.en: This is a picture/photo of a busy city street.
ex.cn: 这张图／照片里是一条繁华的城市街道。

ex.en: In the foreground/background, we can see a group of protesters.

ex.cn: 你是嫌疑犯，不是侦探，给我记住了。

ex.cn: 他当时的无理情有可原。

ex.cn: 我绝不会原谅她做的事。

ex.cn: 如果她从别人那里听到了真相，我永远不会原谅自己。

ex.cn: 我们都得学会宽恕。

ex.cn: 无论他做了什么，她都会原谅他。

ex.cn: 对不起，我就看不出这与我有啥关系。

ex.cn: 请原谅我打岔，不过我确实不同意那一点。

ex.en: Forgive my ignorance, but what exactly does the company do?
ex.cn: 请原谅我的无知，这家公司到底是干什么的？

ex.en: Forgive my interrupting but I really don't agree with that.
ex.cn: 请原谅我打岔，不过我确实不同意那一点。

senses.def: to say that sb does not need to pay back money that they have borrowed

ex.en: The government has agreed to forgive a large part of the debt.
ex.cn: 政府同意免除一大部分债务。

senses.def: used to say that it is easy to understand why sb does or thinks sth, although they are wrong
senses.chn: 某人的做法虽错却是可以理解的

ex.en: Looking at the crowds out shopping, you could be forgiven for thinking that everyone has plenty of money.
ex.cn: 见到人们成群结队地外出购物，难怪你会以为人人都很富有。

senses.def: to stop feeling angry with sb for sth they have done to you and to behave as if it had not happened
to stop feeling angry with sb for sth they have done to you and to behave as if it had not happened
the act of forgiving sb; willingness to forgive sb

ex.en: to pray for God's forgiveness
ex.cn: 祈求上帝宽恕

ex.en: the forgiveness of sins
ex.cn: 对罪的宽恕

ex.en: He begged forgiveness for what he had done.
ex.cn: 他乞求饶恕他的所作所为。

senses.def: willing to forgive

ex.en: She had not inherited her mother's forgiving nature.
ex.cn: 她没有承袭她母亲的宽厚天性。

ex.en: The public was more forgiving of the president's difficulties than the press and fellow politicians.
ex.cn: 公众比报界和总统的政界同人更能体谅他的难处。

senses.def: to decide not to have or do sth that you would like to have or do
senses.chn: 放弃，弃绝（想做的事或想得之物）

ex.en: No one was prepared to forgo their lunch hour to attend the meeting.
ex.cn: 谁都不愿意放弃午餐时间出席会议。

senses.def: permanently

ex.en: This time she's leaving for good (= she will never return).
ex.cn: 她这次走是再也不会回来了。

senses.def: as an extra amount of sth in addition to what has already been done or given
senses.chn: 作为额外增添；外加的项目

ex.en: Use 50g of rice per person and an extra spoonful for good measure.
ex.cn: 按每人 50 克大米的分量，再额外加一勺。

senses.def: written on documents that are sent to sb who needs to know the information in them but does not need to deal with them
for example

ex.en: What would you do, for instance, if you found a member of staff stealing?
ex.cn: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

ex.en: The website has a variety of interactive exercises (e.g. matching games, crosswords and quizzes).
ex.cn: 这个网站有各种各样的互动练习（比如：配对游戏、纵横填字游戏和智力测试）。

ex.en: The website has a variety of interactive exercises, including matching games, crosswords and quizzes.
ex.cn: 这个网站有各种各样的互动练习，包括配对游戏、纵横填字游戏和智力测试。

ex.en: Web 2.0 technologies, such as wikis, blogs and social networking sites, have changed the way that people use the Internet. *
ex.cn: Web 2.0 技术，比如维基、博客及社交网站，改变了人们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Many websites now allow users to contribute information. A good example of this is the 'wiki', a type of website that anyone can edit.
ex.cn: 现在许多网站都允许用户撰写信息。维基就是一个很好的例子，它是一种任何人都可以编辑的网站。

ex.en: Wikis vary in how open they are. For example, some wikis allow anybody to edit content, while others only allow registered users to do this.
ex.cn: 各维基网的开放程度不同。比如，有些维基网允许任何人编辑内容，另一些则只允许注册用户进行内容编辑。

senses.def: a tool with a handle and three or four sharp points (called prongs), used for picking up and eating food

ex.en: to eat with a knife and fork
ex.cn: 用刀叉吃东西

senses.def: a garden tool with a long or short handle and three or four sharp metal points, used for digging
a place where a road, river, etc. divides into two parts; either of these two parts
senses.chn: （道路、河流等的）分岔处，分流处，岔口，岔路

ex.en: Shortly before dusk they reached a fork and took the left-hand track.
ex.cn: 快到黄昏时，他们来到一个岔路口，沿着左边的小径走去。

ex.en: Take the right fork.
ex.cn: 走右边的岔路。

senses.def: a thing shaped like a fork, with two or more long parts

ex.en: a jagged fork of lightning
ex.cn: 锯齿状闪电

senses.def: either of two metal supporting pieces into which a wheel on a bicycle or motorcycle is fitted
to divide into two parts that lead in different directions

ex.en: The path forks at the bottom of the hill.
ex.cn: 小径在山丘脚下分岔。

ex.en: The road forks right after the bridge.
ex.cn: 这条路过桥后岔开分成两条。

senses.def: to turn left or right where a road, etc. divides into two

ex.en: Fork right after the bridge.
ex.cn: 过桥后走右边那条岔路。

senses.def: to move, carry or dig sth using a fork

ex.en: Clear the soil of weeds and fork in plenty of compost.
ex.cn: 清除土中的杂草，然后叉入大量堆肥。

senses.def: to spend a lot of money on sth, especially unwillingly
senses.chn: （尤指不情愿地）大量花钱，大把掏钱

ex.en: Why fork out for a taxi when there's a perfectly good bus service?
ex.cn: 有挺好的公共汽车，干吗要多掏钱坐出租汽车？

ex.en: We've forked out a small fortune on their education.
ex.cn: 我们在他们的教育上可花了不少钱。

senses.def: with one end divided into two parts, like the shape of the letter 'Y'

ex.en: a bird with a forked tail
ex.cn: 有叉形尾羽的鸟

ex.en: the forked tongue of a snake
ex.cn: 蛇的叉形舌

senses.def: the type of lightning that is like a line that divides into smaller lines near the ground
for ever

ex.en: Is it yours for keeps or does he want it back?
ex.cn: 这东西是永远属于你了，还是要还给他？

senses.def: the amount that a fork holds
a vehicle with special equipment on the front for moving and lifting heavy objects
senses.chn: 叉车；叉式装卸车；堆高机

senses.def: appearing lonely and unhappy
senses.chn: 孤苦伶仃的；孤独凄凉的

ex.en: She looked so forlorn, standing there in the rain.
ex.cn: 她站在雨中，显得孤苦伶仃。

senses.def: not cared for and with no people in it

ex.en: Empty houses quickly take on a forlorn look.
ex.cn: 空无一人的房屋很快就显得凄凉。

senses.def: unlikely to succeed, come true, etc.
senses.chn: 不大可能成功的；难以实现的

ex.en: She waited in the forlorn hope that he would one day come back to her.
ex.cn: 她几乎毫无指望地等待他有一天会回到她的身边。

ex.en: His father smiled weakly in a forlorn attempt to reassure him that everything was all right.
ex.cn: 他父亲淡淡地一笑，试图安慰他一切都好，却没什么效果。

senses.def: because you believe it will bring you good luck, or because this is a traditional belief
senses.chn: 图个吉利；为了带来好运

ex.en: Take something blue. It's for luck.
ex.cn: 挑件蓝色的东西吧，求个吉利。

senses.def: for no particular reason

ex.en: I hit him once more for luck.
ex.cn: 我无故又打了他一下。

senses.def: a type or variety of sth

ex.en: forms of transport/government/energy
ex.cn: 运输种类；政体类型；能源种类

ex.en: one of the most common forms of cancer
ex.cn: 最常见的一种癌症

ex.en: all the millions of different life forms on the planet today
ex.cn: 当今地球上所有的几百万生命种类

senses.def: the particular way sth is, seems, looks or is presented

ex.en: The disease can take several different forms.
ex.cn: 这种疾病可能有几种不同的形式。

ex.en: Help in the form of money will be very welcome.
ex.cn: 欢迎以金钱形式予以资助。

ex.en: Help arrived in the form of two police officers.
ex.cn: 来支援的是两名警察。

ex.en: The training programme takes the form of a series of workshops.
ex.cn: 培训课程采取一系列研讨会的形式。

ex.en: Most political questions involve morality in some form or other.
ex.cn: 多数政治问题牵涉到这样或那样的道义性。

ex.en: We need to come to some form of agreement.
ex.cn: 我们需要达成某种形式的协议。

senses.def: an official document containing questions and spaces for answers

ex.en: an application/entry/order form
ex.cn: 申请表；报名表；订货单

ex.en: to fill in a form
ex.cn: 填表

ex.en: to fill out a form
ex.cn: 填表

ex.en: I filled in/out a form on their website.
ex.cn: 我在他们的网站上填了一张表。

ex.en: to complete a form
ex.cn: 填表

ex.en: a booking form
ex.cn: 预订单

senses.def: the shape of sb/sth; a person or thing of which only the shape can be seen

ex.en: her slender form
ex.cn: 她苗条的身段

ex.en: The human form has changed little over the last 30 000 years.
ex.cn: 3 万多年以来，人的体形没有多大变化。

ex.en: They made out a shadowy form in front of them.
ex.cn: 他们认出了前面的模糊人影。

senses.def: the arrangement of parts in a whole, especially in a work of art or piece of writing
senses.chn: （尤指艺术作品或文章的）结构，形式

ex.en: In a novel, form and content are equally important.
ex.cn: 小说的形式和内容同样重要。

ex.en: the structure of the building/human body
ex.cn: 建筑物／人体结构

ex.en: the social structure of society
ex.cn: 社会的社会结构

ex.en: the grammatical structures of a language
ex.cn: 一种语言的语法结构

ex.en: a salary structure
ex.cn: 工资结构

ex.en: The report provides a framework for further research.
ex.cn: 报告提供了进一步研究的原则。

senses.def: how fit and healthy sb is; the state of being fit and healthy

ex.en: After six months' training the whole team is in superb form.
ex.cn: 经过半年的训练，全队状态极佳。

ex.en: I really need to get back in form.
ex.cn: 我实在需要恢复状态。

ex.en: The horse was clearly out of form.
ex.cn: 这匹马显然状态不佳。

senses.def: how well sb/sth is performing; the fact that sb/sth is performing well

ex.en: Midfielder Elliott has shown disappointing form recently.
ex.cn: 中场队员埃利奥特近来表现令人失望。

ex.en: On current/present form the party is heading for another election victory.
ex.cn: 就该党目前情况来看，下届选举又会胜利。

ex.en: She signalled her return to form with a convincing victory.
ex.cn: 她令人信服的胜利显示她已恢复状态。

ex.en: He's right on form (= performing well) as a crazy science teacher in his latest movie.
ex.cn: 他在最近的一部电影中扮演疯狂的理科教师，表现出色。

ex.en: The whole team was on good form and deserved the win.
ex.cn: 全队表现良好，获胜是理所当然的。

ex.en: She was in great form (= happy and cheerful and full of energy) at the wedding party.
ex.cn: 在婚宴上她欢欣雀跃。

senses.def: the usual way of doing sth

ex.en: What's the form when you apply for a research grant?
ex.cn: 申请科研补助金按常规应该怎么办？

ex.en: conventional social forms
ex.cn: 常规社会习俗

ex.en: True to form (= as he usually does) he arrived an hour late.
ex.cn: 他和往常一样迟到了一小时。

ex.en: Partners of employees are invited as a matter of form.
ex.cn: 按惯例，雇员的配偶受到了邀请。

senses.def: the way of doing things that is socially acceptable/not socially acceptable
a way of writing or saying a word that shows, for example, if it is plural or in a particular tense

ex.en: the infinitive form of the verb
ex.cn: 动词不定式

senses.def: a class in a school

ex.en: Who's your form teacher?
ex.cn: 你们的年级老师是谁？

senses.def: a student in the form mentioned at school

ex.en: a third-former
ex.cn: 三年级学生

senses.def: to gradually form into a particular shape; to gradually develop

ex.en: In her body a new life was taking form.
ex.cn: 一个新的生命在她的体内逐渐形成。

senses.def: of any type

ex.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
ex.cn: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

senses.def: to begin to exist and gradually develop into a particular shape; to make sth begin to exist in a particular shape

ex.en: Flowers appeared, but fruits failed to form.
ex.cn: 开了花，但没有结果。

ex.en: Storm clouds are forming on the horizon.
ex.cn: 天边出现了暴雨云。

ex.en: These hills were formed by glaciation.
ex.cn: 这些山丘是冰川作用形成的。

senses.def: to start to exist and develop; to make sth start to exist and develop

ex.en: A plan formed in my head.
ex.cn: 一个计划在我的头脑中形成。

ex.en: I formed many close friendships at college.
ex.cn: 我大学时结交了许多密友。

ex.en: I didn't see enough of the play to form an opinion about it.
ex.cn: 我对这部戏剧了解得不够，说不出什么意见。

ex.en: She makes her own clothes.
ex.cn: 她自己做衣服。

ex.en: She made a good impression on the interviewer.
ex.cn: 她给主持面试者留下了很好的印象。

ex.en: He did a beautiful drawing of a house.
ex.cn: 他画了一栋漂亮的房子。

senses.def: to produce sth in a particular way or make it have a particular shape

ex.en: Bend the wire so that it forms a 'V'.
ex.cn: 把铁丝弯成 V 形。

ex.en: Rearrange the letters to form a new word.
ex.cn: 重新排列字母，组成另一单词。

ex.en: Games can help children learn to form letters.
ex.cn: 游戏可以帮助儿童学会组合字母。

ex.en: Do you know how to form the past tense?
ex.cn: 你知道怎样构成过去时吗？

ex.en: Form the dough into balls with your hands.
ex.cn: 用手把生面团揉成一些球儿。

ex.en: The chain is formed from 136 links.
ex.cn: 这根链条由 136 个环组成。

senses.def: to move or arrange objects or people so that they are in a group with a particular shape; to become arranged in a group like this

ex.en: to form a line/queue/circle
ex.cn: 排成一队／圈

ex.en: First get students to form groups of four.
ex.cn: 首先让学生分成四人一组。

ex.en: Queues were already forming outside the theatre.
ex.cn: 剧院外已经在排队了。

ex.en: The teams formed up into lines.
ex.cn: 各队已整好了队列。

senses.def: to have a particular function or pattern

ex.en: The trees form a natural protection from the sun's rays.
ex.cn: 树木起天然的保护作用，遮挡了太阳的光线。

senses.def: to be sth

ex.en: The castle forms the focal point of the city.
ex.cn: 这座城堡是城市的中心。

ex.en: The survey formed part of a larger programme of research.
ex.cn: 这个调查是研究计划的一部分。

ex.en: These drawings will form the basis of the exhibition.
ex.cn: 这些画作将成为展览的基本部分。

senses.def: to start a group of people, such as an organization, a committee, etc.; to come together in a group of this kind

ex.en: They hope to form the new government.
ex.cn: 他们希望组建新政府。

ex.en: He formed a band with some friends from school.
ex.cn: 他和学校里的一些朋友组成一支乐队。

ex.en: a newly-formed political party
ex.cn: 新建立的政党

ex.en: The band formed in 2007.
ex.cn: 这支乐队成立于 2007 年。

senses.def: to have an influence on the way that sth develops

ex.en: Positive and negative experiences form a child's character.
ex.cn: 正反两方面的经历都影响儿童性格的形成。

senses.def: very correct and suitable for official or important occasions
senses.chn: 适合正式场合的；正规的；庄重的

ex.en: formal evening dress
ex.cn: 晚礼服

ex.en: The dinner was a formal affair.
ex.cn: 这是正式宴会。

ex.en: He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.
ex.cn: 他使这封信保持正式公文的语气。

ex.en: She has a very formal manner, which can seem unfriendly.
ex.cn: 她的举止很是郑重其事，有可能会显得不友好。

senses.def: official; following an agreed or official way of doing things

ex.en: formal legal processes
ex.cn: 正式法律程序

ex.en: to make a formal apology/complaint/request
ex.cn: 正式道歉／投诉／要求

ex.en: Formal diplomatic relations between the two countries were re-established in December.
ex.cn: 两国于十二月重新建立了正式外交关系。

ex.en: It is time to put these arrangements on a slightly more formal basis.
ex.cn: 是应该把这些安排做得略为正式一点的时候了。

senses.def: received in a school, college or university, with lessons, exams, etc., rather than gained just through practical experience

ex.en: He has no formal teaching qualifications.
ex.cn: 他没有正规的教学资历证明。

ex.en: Young children are beginning their formal education sometimes as early as four years old.
ex.cn: 幼儿有时早在四岁时就开始接受正规教育。

senses.def: concerned with the way sth is done rather than what is done
senses.chn: 方式上的；做法上的；形式上的

ex.en: Getting approval for the plan is a purely formal matter; nobody will seriously oppose it.
ex.cn: 计划报批纯粹是一个形式上的问题，没有人会当真反对的。

ex.en: Critics have concentrated too much on the formal elements of her poetry, without really looking at what it is saying.
ex.cn: 评论家过多地集中评论她诗歌的形式，而没有真正看其内容。

senses.def: arranged in a regular manner, according to a clear, exact plan

ex.en: delightful formal gardens, with terraced lawns and an avenue of trees
ex.cn: 精心布置的有片片草坪和林荫道的宜人花园

senses.def: a gas with a strong smell
a liquid made by mixing formaldehyde and water, used for preserving biological, making plastics and as a disinfectant specimens, making plastics and as a disinfectant
a style or method in art, music, literature, science, etc. that pays more attention to the rules and the correct arrangement and appearance of things than to inner meaning and feelings
a thing that you must do as a formal or official part of a legal process, a social situation, etc.

ex.en: to go through all the formalities necessary in order to get a gun licence
ex.cn: 办理取得持枪执照的全部必要手续

ex.en: Let's skip the formalities and get down to business.
ex.cn: 咱们省去繁文缛节，开始讨论实质问题吧。

senses.def: a thing that you must do as part of an official process, but which has little meaning and will not affect what happens

ex.en: He already knows he has the job so the interview is a mere formality.
ex.cn: 他已知道得到了这个工作，所以面试仅仅是走走过场。

senses.def: correct and formal behaviour

ex.en: Different levels of formality are appropriate in different situations.
ex.cn: 不同规格的礼节适用于不同场合。

ex.en: She greeted him with stiff formality.
ex.cn: 她拘谨地按礼节向他致意。

senses.def: to make an arrangement, a plan or a relationship official
senses.chn: 使（安排、计划、关系）成为正式的

ex.en: They decided to formalize their relationship by getting married.
ex.cn: 他们决定结婚，正式确定关系。

senses.def: to give sth a fixed structure or form by introducing rules
senses.chn: （通过规则）使有固定体系，使定形

ex.en: The college has a highly formalized system of assessment.
ex.cn: 这所学院有一套十分固定的评估体系。

senses.def: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of sth

ex.en: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular.
ex.cn: 新的智力竞赛节目的总体安排结果证明很受欢迎。

senses.def: the shape and size of a book, magazine, etc.

ex.en: They've brought out the magazine in a new format.
ex.cn: 他们用新的版式出版这杂志。

senses.def: the way in which data is stored or held to be worked on by a computer
to prepare a computer disk so that data can be recorded on it
to arrange text in a particular way on a page or a screen
the action of forming sth; the process of being formed

ex.en: the formation of a new government
ex.cn: 组成新政府

ex.en: evidence of recent star formation in the galaxy
ex.cn: 银河系新恒星形成的证据

senses.def: a thing that has been formed, especially in a particular place or in a particular way

ex.en: rock formations
ex.cn: 岩层

senses.def: a particular arrangement or pattern

ex.en: aircraft flying in formation
ex.cn: 编队飞行的飞机

ex.en: formation flying
ex.cn: 编队飞行

ex.en: The team usually plays in a 4-4-2 formation.
ex.cn: 这支球队比赛通常排出的是 4–4–2 阵形。

senses.def: having an important and lasting influence on the development of sth or of sb's character
senses.chn: （对某事物或性格的发展）有持续重大影响的

ex.en: the formative years of childhood
ex.cn: 童年性格形成的时期

senses.def: that existed in earlier times

ex.en: in former times
ex.cn: 从前

ex.en: This beautiful old building has been restored to its former glory.
ex.cn: 这座美丽的老建筑物已恢复了昔日的壮观。

senses.def: that used to have a particular position or status in the past

ex.en: former South African president Nelson Mandela
ex.cn: 南非前总统纳尔逊 · 曼德拉

ex.en: my former boss/colleague/wife
ex.cn: 以前的老板／同事；前妻

ex.en: the countries of the former Soviet Union
ex.cn: 前苏联加盟共和国

senses.def: used to refer to the first of two things or people mentioned

ex.en: The former option would be much more sensible.
ex.cn: 前一种选择要明智得多。

senses.def: to not have the strength, influence, etc. that you used to have
senses.chn: 失去昔日的力量（或影响等）；威风不再；不如当年

senses.def: the first of two things or people mentioned

ex.en: He had to choose between giving up his job and giving up his principles. He chose the former.
ex.cn: 他得在放弃工作和放弃原则二者中择其一。他选择了前者。

ex.en: However, the former are excluded.
ex.cn: 不过，前者被排除在外。

senses.def: a person or thing that forms sth

ex.en: opinion formers and policy makers
ex.cn: 意见领袖和政策制定者

senses.def: in earlier times

ex.en: Namibia, formerly known as South West Africa
ex.cn: 纳米比亚，旧称西南非洲

ex.en: I learnt that the house had formerly been an inn.
ex.cn: 我得知这座房子以前是家客栈。

ex.en: John Marsh, formerly of London Road, Leicester, now living in France
ex.cn: 约翰 · 马什，以前家在莱斯特市伦敦路，现居住在法国

senses.def: an acid made from carbon monoxide and steam. It is also present in a liquid produced by some ants.
if people, things or situations are formidable, you feel fear and/or respect for them, because they are impressive or powerful, or because they seem very difficult
senses.chn: 可怕的；令人敬畏的；难对付的

ex.en: In debate he was a formidable opponent.
ex.cn: 在辩论中他是位难应付的对手。

ex.en: She has a formidable list of qualifications.
ex.cn: 她有一长串令人敬畏的资历。

ex.en: The two players together make a formidable combination.
ex.cn: 这两个选手配对儿，难以对付。

ex.en: The task was a formidable one.
ex.cn: 这任务非常艰巨。

ex.en: They had to overcome formidable obstacles.
ex.cn: 他们得克服重重障碍。

senses.def: without a clear or definite shape or structure
senses.chn: 无明确形状的；无定形的；结构不清的

ex.en: formless dreams
ex.cn: 杂乱的梦

senses.def: a series of letters, numbers or symbols that represent a rule or law

ex.en: This formula is used to calculate the area of a circle.
ex.cn: 这个公式用于计算圆的面积。

senses.def: letters and symbols that show the parts of a chemical compound, etc.

ex.en: CO is the formula for carbon monoxide.
ex.cn: CO 是一氧化碳的分子式。

senses.def: a particular method of doing or achieving sth

ex.en: They're trying to work out a peace formula acceptable to both sides in the dispute.
ex.cn: 他们正在设法制定出一个争执双方都可以接受的和平方案。

ex.en: There's no magic formula for a perfect marriage.
ex.cn: 没有一个达到完美婚姻的神奇方法。

senses.def: a list of the things that sth is made from, giving the amount of each substance to use

ex.en: the secret formula for the blending of the whisky
ex.cn: 调配威士忌的秘方

senses.def: a type of liquid food for babies, given instead of breast milk
a class of racing car, based on engine size, etc.
senses.chn: 方程式（按发动机大小等对赛车的分级）

ex.en: Formula One™ racing
ex.cn: 一级方程式赛车

senses.def: a fixed form of words used in a particular situation

ex.en: legal formulae
ex.cn: 法律惯用词语

ex.en: The minister keeps coming out with the same tired formulas.
ex.cn: 这个部长开口便是千篇一律、使人厌倦的套话。

senses.def: made up of fixed patterns of words or ideas
senses.chn: 由固定套话堆砌的；公式化构思的

ex.en: Traditional stories make use of formulaic expressions like 'Once upon a time…'.
ex.cn: 传统故事采用 “从前…” 一类的套语。

senses.def: to create or prepare sth carefully, giving particular attention to the details

ex.en: to formulate a policy/theory/plan/proposal
ex.cn: 制定政策；创立理论；构想计划；准备建议

ex.en: The compost is specially formulated for pot plants.
ex.cn: 此混合肥料专门用于盆栽植物。

ex.en: This new kitchen cleaner is formulated to cut through grease and dirt.
ex.cn: 这种新的厨房清洁剂能去除油渍和污垢。

senses.def: to express your ideas in carefully chosen words

ex.en: She has lots of good ideas, but she has difficulty formulating them.
ex.cn: 她有很多好主意，但就是不善于表达。

senses.def: in my opinion

ex.en: For my money, he's one of the greatest comedians of all time.
ex.cn: 依我看，历来的喜剧演员，他是数一数二的。

senses.def: to have sex with sb that you are not married to
without payment

ex.en: She's always trying to get something for nothing.
ex.cn: 她总想不劳而获。

senses.def: with no reward or result
senses.chn: 无酬劳；毫无结果；白白地

ex.en: All that preparation was for nothing because the visit was cancelled.
ex.cn: 访问被取消，所有的准备工作都白费了。

senses.def: if you do sth for old times' sake, you do it because it is connected with sth good that happened to you in the past
senses.chn: 看在旧日的情分上；念及老交情

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular person does sth and that you believe other people do too
senses.chn: 就是其中之一（表达意见时用以加强语气）

ex.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
ex.cn: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

senses.def: used to introduce one of two or more reasons for doing sth
senses.chn: （用以引出两个以上的理由之一）一来，一方面

ex.en: 'Why don't you get a car?' 'Well, for one thing, I can't drive!'
ex.cn: “你为什么不买辆汽车呢？” “啊，首先，我不会开车！”

senses.def: as a beginning or first part of a process
genuine or serious

ex.en: This is not a fire drill—it's for real.
ex.cn: 这不是救火演习，是真失火了。

ex.en: He managed to convince voters that he was for real.
ex.cn: 他使得投票者相信了他是严肃认真的。

senses.def: available to rent
to leave sb/sth, especially when you have a responsibility to stay
senses.chn: 抛弃，遗弃，离开（尤指不履行责任）

ex.en: He had made it clear to his wife that he would never forsake her.
ex.cn: 他明确地向妻子说，永远不离开她。

senses.def: to stop doing sth, or leave sth, especially sth that you enjoy
senses.chn: 摒弃，离开（尤指喜爱的事物）

ex.en: She forsook the glamour of the city and went to live in the wilds of Scotland.
ex.cn: 她抛开城市的绚烂，去苏格兰荒原居住。

senses.def: available to be bought, especially from the owner
senses.chn: 待售；供出售（尤指从物主手里）

ex.en: I'm sorry, it's not for sale.
ex.cn: 抱歉，这个不卖。

ex.en: They've put their house up for sale.
ex.cn: 他们的房子现在出售。

ex.en: an increase in the number of stolen vehicles being offered for sale
ex.cn: 用于售卖的被盗车辆在数量上的增加

ex.en: a 'for sale' sign
ex.cn: “待售” 标志

senses.def: especially in order to help or be useful to sb
senses.chn: 为帮助某人；为某人的利益

ex.en: I have typed out some lecture notes for the benefit of those people who were absent last week.
ex.cn: 我帮上星期缺席的人打印了些课堂笔记。

ex.en: Don't go to any trouble for my benefit!
ex.cn: 别为我费功夫！

senses.def: to be seen only by a particular person

ex.en: I'll lend you the letters but they're for your eyes only.
ex.cn: 我会把这些信借给你，但只准你一个人看。

senses.def: intended to be seen but not used
senses.chn: 供展览的；装门面的；中看不中用的

ex.en: These items are just for show—they're not for sale.
ex.cn: 这些物品仅供展览，不卖。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement, especially in order to show surprise
senses.chn: （用以强调，尤为表示惊讶）实在，确实

senses.def: used to emphasize the first of a list of reasons, opinions, etc., or to say what happens first
senses.chn: （强调一系列理由、意见等的第一条或表示首先发生的事）首先，作为开头

senses.def: because of the interest or value sth has, not because of the advantages it may bring
senses.chn: 为某事本身的缘故；鉴于某事本身的价值

ex.en: I believe in education for its own sake.
ex.cn: 我相信教育本身就是有价值的。

ex.en: art for art's sake
ex.cn: 为艺术而艺术

senses.def: without doubt

ex.en: No one knows for sure what happened.
ex.cn: 没有人确切地知道发生了什么事。

ex.en: I think he'll be back on Monday, but I can't say for sure.
ex.cn: 我想他星期一会回来，不过我不敢肯定。

ex.en: One thing is for sure —it's not going to be easy.
ex.cn: 有一点可以肯定，事情不会很容易。

ex.en: 'Will you be there?' 'For sure.'
ex.cn: “你去吗？” “肯定去。”

senses.def: to stop doing or using sth; to make a promise that you will stop doing or using sth

ex.en: The group forswears all worldly possessions.
ex.cn: 这个团体放弃一切尘世财物。

ex.en: The country has not forsworn the use of chemical weapons.
ex.cn: 该国并未保证禁用化学武器。

senses.def: a bush that has small bright yellow flowers in the early spring
senses.chn: 连翘，金钟花（灌木，早春开小黄花）

senses.def: a building or buildings built in order to defend an area against attack
a place where soldiers live and have their training

ex.en: Fort Drum
ex.cn: 德拉姆堡

senses.def: to have the responsibility for sth or care of sb while other people are away or out
senses.chn: 代为负责（某事）；代为照看（某人）

ex.en: Why not have a day off? I'll hold the fort for you.
ex.cn: 干吗不休息一天？我来为你代管。

senses.def: a city in the US state of Colorado
senses.chn: 柯林斯堡（美国科罗拉多州城市）

senses.def: a thing that sb does particularly well

ex.en: Languages were never my forte.
ex.cn: 语言从来就不是我的强项。

senses.def: played or sung loudly
involving or relating to things that cannot be explained by science
senses.chn: 反常现象的；无法用科学解释的；超自然的；神秘莫测的

senses.def: away from a place; out

ex.en: They set forth at dawn.
ex.cn: 他们在黎明时出发。

ex.en: Huge chimneys belched forth smoke and grime.
ex.cn: 巨大的烟囱冒出烟和灰尘。

senses.def: towards a place; forwards

ex.en: Water gushed forth from a hole in the rock.
ex.cn: 水从岩洞里涌出。

senses.def: beginning on that day; from that time
from one place to another and back again repeatedly

ex.en: ferries sailing back and forth between the islands
ex.cn: 往返于岛屿之间的渡船

senses.def: used at the end of a list to show that it continues in the same way

ex.en: We discussed everything—when to go, what to see and so on.
ex.cn: 我们什么都商量过了，什么时候走、看什么等等。

senses.def: used to add a comment on sth that you have just said

ex.en: I didn't like it much. Nor did the kids, for that matter.
ex.cn: 我不怎么喜欢它。孩子们也同样不喜欢。

senses.def: going to happen, be published, etc. very soon

ex.en: the forthcoming elections
ex.cn: 即将举行的选举

ex.en: a list of forthcoming books
ex.cn: 近期将出版书籍的目录

ex.en: the band's forthcoming UK tour
ex.cn: 乐队即将在英国的巡回演出

senses.def: ready or made available when needed

ex.en: Financial support was not forthcoming.
ex.cn: 财政支援尚未到手。

senses.def: willing to give information about sth

ex.en: She's never very forthcoming about her plans.
ex.cn: 她一直不大愿意说出自己的计划。

senses.def: if you can have sth for the asking, it is very easy for you to get it if you ask for it
senses.chn: 只需要求，一经索取（便可获得）

ex.en: The job is yours for the asking.
ex.cn: 只要开口，这份工作就是你的了。

senses.def: until the end of a particular situation
just for pleasure rather than for a reason
however hard you try

ex.en: I cannot for the life of me imagine why they want to leave.
ex.cn: 我怎么也想象不出他们为什么要走。

senses.def: used when you are expressing anger and the fact that you are impatient
senses.chn: （表示愤怒和不耐烦）看在上帝的分上，哎呀，求求你

ex.en: For the love of God, tell me what he said!
ex.cn: 看在上帝的分上，告诉我他说了些什么！

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: I'm changing my email address but for the meantime you can use the old one.
ex.cn: 我要更换电邮地址，不过那个旧的暂时也还可以用。

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: We need some new curtains, but these will do for the meanwhile.
ex.cn: 我们需要一些新的窗帘，但这些暂时还可以用。

senses.def: mostly; usually

ex.en: The contributors are, for the most part, professional scientists.
ex.cn: 投稿者大多是专业科学家。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

ex.en: Senior management posts are predominantly held by men.
ex.cn: 高层管理职位大多由男性担任。

senses.def: apart from that; as far as other matters are concerned

ex.en: The book has some interesting passages about the author's childhood. For the rest, it is extremely dull.
ex.cn: 这本书中关于作者童年的一些章节倒还有意思。除此之外，便无聊至极。

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: You can leave your suitcase here for the time being.
ex.cn: 你可以暂时把衣箱留在这儿。

senses.def: direct and honest in manner and speech
senses.chn: 直率的；直截了当的；坦诚的

ex.en: a woman of forthright views
ex.cn: 观点明确的女子

senses.def: immediately; at once

ex.en: The agreement between us is terminated forthwith.
ex.cn: 我们之间的协议立即终止。

senses.def: a tower, wall, gun position, etc. built to defend a place against attack
senses.chn: 碉堡；围墙；炮台；防御工事

ex.en: the ramparts and fortifications of the Old Town
ex.cn: 旧城区的城墙和城堡

senses.def: the act of fortifying or making sth stronger

ex.en: plans for the fortification of the city
ex.cn: 城市设防计划

senses.def: to make a place more able to resist attack, especially by building high walls
senses.chn: 筑防御工事；（尤指）筑城防御

ex.en: a fortified town
ex.cn: 设防的城镇

senses.def: to make sb/yourself feel stronger, braver, etc.

ex.en: He fortified himself against the cold with a hot drink.
ex.cn: 他喝了一杯热饮御寒。

senses.def: to make a feeling or an attitude stronger

ex.en: The news merely fortified their determination.
ex.cn: 这消息只是增强了他们的决心。

senses.def: to increase the strength or quality of food or drink by adding sth to it
senses.chn: （加入某物）强化（食品或饮料）；提高（营养价值）

ex.en: Sherry is fortified wine (= wine with extra alcohol added).
ex.cn: 雪利酒是添加了酒精的葡萄酒。

ex.en: cereal fortified with extra vitamins
ex.cn: 添加维生素的谷类食物

senses.def: very loudly
played or sung very loudly
courage shown by sb who is suffering great pain or facing great difficulties
senses.chn: （在巨大痛苦或困难面前表现出的）勇气，胆量，刚毅

senses.def: to be strongly built, often with many locks, strong doors, guards, etc., so that it is difficult for people to enter and the things kept there are safe
senses.chn: 坚固且戒备森严；固若金汤

ex.en: This home of yours is like Fort Knox.
ex.cn: 你这所房子可以说是固若金汤。

senses.def: a city in the US state of Florida
senses.chn: 劳德代尔堡（美国佛罗里达州城市）

senses.def: two weeks

ex.en: a fortnight's holiday
ex.cn: 两周的假期

ex.en: a fortnight ago
ex.cn: 两星期以前

ex.en: in a fortnight's time
ex.cn: 在两周的时间内

ex.en: He's had three accidents in the past fortnight.
ex.cn: 在过去两周他出了三次事故。

senses.def: happening once a fortnight

ex.en: Meetings take place at fortnightly intervals.
ex.cn: 每两周开一次会。

senses.def: a high-level computer language used especially for doing scientific calculations *
senses.chn: Fortran 语言，公式翻译程序语言（尤用于科学计算）

senses.def: a building or place that has been made stronger and protected against attack
senses.chn: 城堡；堡垒；要塞；设防的地方

ex.en: a fortress town enclosed by four miles of ramparts
ex.cn: 由四英里长的城墙围着的设防城镇

ex.en: Fear of terrorist attack has turned the conference centre into a fortress.
ex.cn: 由于害怕恐怖分子袭击，会议中心已变成了堡垒。

senses.def: happening by chance, especially a lucky chance that brings a good result
senses.chn: 偶然发生的；（尤指）巧合的

senses.def: having or bringing an advantage, an opportunity, a piece of good luck, etc.
senses.chn: 幸运的；交好运的；吉利的

ex.en: I have been fortunate enough to visit many parts of the world as a lecturer.
ex.cn: 我很有福气，去过世界许多地方作演讲。

ex.en: I was fortunate in having a good teacher.
ex.cn: 我很幸运，有位好老师。

ex.en: Remember those less fortunate than yourselves.
ex.cn: 要记住那些不如你们幸运的人。

ex.en: It was very fortunate for him that I arrived on time.
ex.cn: 算他运气好，我准时到了。

senses.def: by good luck
senses.chn: 幸运地；交好运地；吉利地

ex.en: I was late, but fortunately the meeting hadn't started.
ex.cn: 我迟到了，不过幸好会议还没有开始。

ex.en: Fortunately for him, he was very soon offered another job.
ex.cn: 他运气好，很快就有人聘请他做另一个工作。

senses.def: chance or luck, especially in the way it affects people's lives

ex.en: I have had the good fortune to work with some brilliant directors.
ex.cn: 我有幸与一些卓越的主管人员共事。

ex.en: By a stroke of fortune he found work almost immediately.
ex.cn: 他运气好，几乎立刻找到了工作。

ex.en: Fortune smiled on me (= I had good luck).
ex.cn: 我交了好运。

senses.def: a large amount of money

ex.en: He made a fortune in real estate.
ex.cn: 他在房地产上发了财。

ex.en: She inherited a share of the family fortune.
ex.cn: 她继承了家庭的一份财产。

ex.en: A car like that costs a small fortune.
ex.cn: 像这样的轿车要花一大笔钱。

ex.en: You don't have to spend a fortune to give your family tasty, healthy meals.
ex.cn: 让家里人吃味道好又健康的餐食并不需要花许多钱。

ex.en: She is hoping her US debut will be the first step on the road to fame and fortune.
ex.cn: 她希望她在美国的首次演出将是她走上名利双收之路的第一步。

ex.en: That ring must be worth a fortune.
ex.cn: 那枚戒指肯定要值好多钱。

senses.def: the good and bad things that happen to a person, family, country, etc.
senses.chn: （个人、家庭、国家等的）发展变化的趋势，命运，际遇

ex.en: the changing fortunes of the film industry
ex.cn: 电影业的变迁

ex.en: the fortunes of war
ex.cn: 战争的局势

ex.en: a reversal of fortune(s)
ex.cn: 命运的扭转

senses.def: a person's fate or future

ex.en: She can tell your fortune by looking at the lines on your hand.
ex.cn: 她可凭看手纹替你算命。

senses.def: something that you have, or have promised to do, that could cause trouble or worry in the future
senses.chn: 可能招惹麻烦（或担忧）的东西（或许诺）；造成后患的事物

senses.def: to try to find a way to become rich, especially by going to another place
senses.chn: 外出寻找发财机会；外出闯荡；闯世界

senses.def: a thin hollow biscuit/cookie, served in Chinese restaurants, containing a short message that predicts what will happen to you in the future
senses.chn: 签饼（中国餐馆提供的薄脆饼，内有预测命运的小纸条）

senses.def: a person who tries to become rich by marrying sb with a lot of money
senses.chn: （企图通过跟有钱人结婚）猎财的人，攀龙附凤的人

senses.def: a person who claims to have magic powers and who tells people what will happen to them in the future
senses.chn: 算命先生；给人算命的人

senses.def: a town in the Highlands in western Scotland
senses.chn: 威廉堡（苏格兰西部高地城镇）

senses.def: used to say that you would like to do sth, even though you know that it would not be sensible

ex.en: I'd kill him for two pins.
ex.cn: 我恨不得杀了他。

senses.def: a city in the US state of Texas, close to Dallas
senses.chn: 沃思堡（美国得克萨斯州城市，靠近达拉斯）

senses.def: numbers, years or temperatures from 40 to 49
between the ages of 40 and 49 *
a short sleep, especially during the day

ex.en: I'll feel much better when I've had forty winks.
ex.cn: 我打个盹儿就会感到好得多。

senses.def: a place where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue; a meeting organized for this purpose
senses.chn: 公共讨论场所；论坛；讨论会

ex.en: Television is now an important forum for political debate.
ex.cn: 电视现在成了政治辩论的重要平台。

ex.en: an Internet forum
ex.cn: 互联网论坛

ex.en: to hold an international forum on drug abuse

ex.en: freak weather conditions
ex.cn: 反常的天气状况

ex.cn: 我父母看见我的头发时大惊失色。

ex.cn: 反常的天气；怪异的行为

an event that people watch because it is very strange
very strange or unusual
a small, pale brown spot on a person's skin, especially on their face, caused by the sun
the capital of the Canadian province of New Brunswick
senses.chn: 弗雷德里克顿（加拿大新不伦瑞克省首府）

senses.chn: 能随自己意愿的；随心所欲的

ex.cn: 我没有雄心大志，只求自由自在地过幸福生活。

ex.en: Students have a free choice of courses in their final year.
ex.cn: 学生在最后一学年可以自由选修课程。

ex.cn: 你来去自由。

ex.cn: “我能用一下电话吗？” “请便吧。”

ex.cn: 人们呼吁要有包括言论自由和新闻自由在内的真正民主。

ex.cn: 该国的第一次自由选举

ex.cn: 他们让我自由查阅所有档案资料。

senses.chn: 自由的（不是囚犯或奴隶）

ex.cn: 他获释出狱，成为自由人。

senses.chn: 未拴住的；非关在笼中的

ex.cn: 研究人员把鸟放了。

senses.def: costing nothing

ex.cn: 免费入场。

ex.en: free samples/tickets/advice
ex.cn: 免费样品／票／咨询

ex.en: We're offering a fabulous free gift with each copy you buy.
ex.cn: 购买一册就可以得到一份免费好礼。

ex.en: You can't expect people to work for free (= without payment).
ex.cn: 你不能指望人无偿工作。

senses.def: clear; not blocked

ex.cn: 要确保机器周围空气畅通。

senses.def: not containing or affected by sth harmful or unpleasant
senses.chn: 不含有害物的；不受…伤害（或影响等的）

ex.en: free from difficulty/doubt/fear
ex.cn: 没有困难；不怀疑；不害怕

ex.en: free from artificial colours and flavourings
ex.cn: 不含人工色素和人工调味料

ex.cn: 过了几星期他的疼痛才完全消除。

senses.def: without the thing mentioned

ex.en: virtually fat-free yogurt
ex.cn: 几乎无脂的酸奶

ex.en: tax-free earnings
ex.cn: 免税收入

ex.en: a trouble-free life
ex.cn: 无忧无虑的生活

senses.def: not attached to sth or trapped by sth

ex.cn: 轻拉绳索松开的一端。

ex.en: They had to be cut free from their car after the accident.
ex.cn: 事故后，得破开汽车把他们救出来。

ex.en: She finally managed to pull herself free.
ex.cn: 她终于设法挣脱了。

senses.def: not being used

ex.en: He held out his free hand and I took it.
ex.cn: 他伸出空着的一只手，我就抓住了。

ex.en: Is this seat free?
ex.cn: 这个座位空着吗？

senses.chn: 没有安排活动的；空闲的

ex.cn: 如果萨拉有空吃午饭，我就带她出去吃。

ex.cn: 把星期五晚上空出来，参加我的聚会。

ex.cn: 你闲暇时喜欢干什么？

ex.cn: 他太随便发表意见了。

ex.cn: 生活绝不会再那样无拘无束了。

senses.chn: 可以全权处理；有自主权

ex.cn: 我获准全权制订教学大纲。

senses.chn: 白白得到好处（因他人已代付款）

senses.chn: （有人建议不应做某事时用于回答）这是个自由的国家

ex.cn: 这是个自由的国家，我想说什么就说什么！

senses.def: used to say that it is not possible to get sth for nothing
senses.chn: （表示白得东西是不可能的）没有免费的午餐

ex.cn: 我能看见终点线了，我想我终于成功了。

senses.chn: 对…不加约束；放任自由；充分表达（感情）

ex.cn: 设计者可以自由发挥。

ex.cn: 剧本允许她充分展现她那夸张的表演风格。

ex.en: By the end of May nearly 100 of an estimated 2 000 political prisoners had been freed.
ex.cn: 至五月底，估计 2 000 名政治犯中已经有近 100 人获释。

ex.en: The hijackers agreed to free a further ten hostages.
ex.cn: 劫持者同意再释放十名人质。

senses.def: to move sb/sth that is caught or fixed on sth

ex.en: Three people were freed from the wreckage.
ex.cn: 有三人被救出残骸。

ex.en: She struggled to free herself.
ex.cn: 她挣扎着以求脱身。

ex.en: These exercises help free the body of tension.
ex.cn: 这些锻炼可使紧张的身体放松。

ex.cn: 警方决心消灭该城镇的暴力犯罪。

ex.en: The centre aims to free young people from dependency on drugs.
ex.cn: 这个中心的宗旨是使年轻人解除对毒品的依赖。

senses.def: to make sb/sth available for a particular purpose

ex.cn: 我们每周都腾出时间开一次项目会议。

ex.cn: 政府保证调拨更多资源用于教育。

senses.def: to give sb the extra time to do sth that they want to do

ex.cn: 获奖使他能腾出时间整天作画。

senses.def: without payment

ex.en: Children under five travel free.
ex.cn: 五岁以下儿童免费乘坐。

senses.def: away from or out of a position in which sb/sth is stuck or trapped

ex.cn: 这节货车车厢脱离了列车。

to be allowed to go where it likes; not tied to anything or kept in a cage

senses.chn: 有自主权的人；行动自由的人

senses.chn: 随便；无拘束；轻松；自由自在

ex.cn: 生活绝不会再那样无拘无束了。

the activity of smoking freebase
something that is given to sb without payment, usually by a company

ex.cn: 他取了可得的全部免费品。

ex.cn: 免费度假

ex.cn: 言论／思想／表达／信仰自由

ex.cn: 对新闻、学术等自由的威胁

ex.cn: 宪法保障的权利和自由

ex.cn: 行动／选择自由

ex.cn: 由于有了汽车，美国人很快就获得了前所未有的行动自由。

ex.cn: 按照自己意愿行事的绝对自由

senses.chn: 自由民地位（不是囚犯或奴隶）

ex.cn: 他蹲了二十年监狱以后终于获得了自由。

senses.chn: 没有…的情况；不受…影响的状态

ex.cn: 免于恐惧、痛苦、饥饿等

ex.cn: 我获得整座房子的自由使用权。

ex.cn: 股价猛跌不只。

ex.cn: 自由浮动汇率

ex.cn: 降低贸易壁垒导致出口商各自为政。

senses.chn: 混战；众人激烈争辩；大吵大闹

senses.chn: 自由语素；自由形式；自由形位

ex.cn: 表示复数的 s 不是自由语素，必须附着于名词。

senses.chn: 不按传统格式的；独创的

ex.cn: 自由创作的爵士乐即兴演出

senses.chn: 徒手画的；不用仪器画的

senses.chn: 白吃白占的人；寄生虫；爱占便宜的人

senses.chn: 不受限制地；无拘无束地；自由地

ex.cn: 该国第一次自由选举出的总统

ex.cn: 欧盟国家的公民现在可以在成员国之间自由旅行。

senses.def: without anything stopping the movement or flow of sth

ex.en: When the gate is raised, the water can flow freely.
ex.cn: 闸门提起时水就可以畅流。

ex.en: Traffic is now moving more freely following an earlier accident.
ex.cn: 早些时候的交通事故过后，现在交通顺畅些了。

ex.en: The book is now freely available in the shops (= it is not difficult to get a copy).
ex.cn: 现在这本书在商店可以随时买到。

ex.en: The wine flowed freely (= there was a lot of it to drink).
ex.cn: 葡萄酒无限量供应。

senses.def: without trying to avoid the truth even though it might be unpleasant or embarrassing

ex.en: I freely admit that I made a mistake.
ex.cn: 我爽快地承认我犯了错误。

senses.def: in an honest way without worrying about what people will say or do

ex.en: For the first time he was able to speak freely without the fear of reprisals against his family.
ex.cn: 他第一次能够直言不讳而不怕家人遭到报复。

senses.def: in a willing and generous way

ex.cn: 为响应救济地震灾民的呼吁，几百万人慷慨相助。

senses.chn: 以意译方法；不拘于原文

a person who is not a slave

ex.cn: 她是自由市场经济的拥护者。

senses.def: a person who believes that prices should be allowed to rise and fall according to supply and demand and not be controlled by the government
a man belonging to a secret society whose members help each other and communicate using secret signs
the system and practices of Freemasons
the friendship that exists between people who have the same profession or interests

ex.en: the freemasonry of actors
ex.cn: 演员的志趣相投

ex.cn: 其他网站采用免费增值模式，免费提供部分内容，以诱使用户付费获取高价值内容。

ex.en: free-range eggs
ex.cn: 放养的鸡产的蛋

senses.chn: 全能滑雪板（在各种雪上使用）

senses.chn: 游卫，自由后卫（没有特定防守对象）
