ex.en: The temperature varies from 30 degrees to minus 20.
ex.cn: 温度在 30 度至零下 20 度之间变化。

ex.en: The store sells everything from shoelaces to computers.
ex.cn: 这家商店出售的商品从鞋带到计算机应有尽有。

ex.en: Conditions vary from school to school.
ex.cn: 各所学校的情况不同。

senses.def: used to show the state or form of sth/sb before a change
senses.chn: （表示改变前的状态或形式）从…（到）

ex.en: Things have gone from bad to worse.
ex.cn: 情况越来越糟。

ex.en: translating from English to Spanish
ex.cn: 从英语译成西班牙语

ex.en: You need a break from routine.
ex.cn: 你需要从日常工作中解脱出来去休息一下。

senses.def: used to show that sb/sth is separated or removed

ex.en: The party was ousted from power after eighteen years.
ex.cn: 该党执政十八年后被赶下台。

senses.def: used to show that sth is prevented

ex.en: She saved him from drowning.
ex.cn: 她救了他一命，使他免遭淹死。

senses.def: used to show the reason for sth

ex.en: She felt sick from tiredness.
ex.cn: 她累得浑身不对劲。

senses.def: used to show the reason for making a judgement
senses.chn: （表示进行判断的原因）根据，从…来看

ex.en: You can tell a lot about a person from their handwriting.
ex.cn: 根据一个人的笔迹可以了解很多有关他的情况。

ex.en: From what I heard the company's in deep trouble.
ex.cn: 就我所听到的，这家公司已深陷困境。

senses.def: used when distinguishing between two people or things

ex.en: Is Portuguese very different from Spanish?
ex.cn: 葡萄牙语与西班牙语区别很大吗？

ex.en: I can't tell one twin from the other.
ex.cn: 我分不出双胞胎中谁是谁。

senses.def: starting at the time mentioned and continuously after that

ex.en: From now on you can work on your own.
ex.cn: 从现在起你可以独自工作。

ex.en: She never spoke to him again from that day on.
ex.cn: 从那天起她就再没和他说话。

senses.def: from a long distance away

ex.en: He loved her from afar (= did not tell her he loved her).
ex.cn: 他暗恋着她。

senses.def: a type of very soft cheese, similar to yogurt
senses.chn: 新鲜软干酪（类似酸乳酪）

senses.def: from one place to another

ex.en: For me a car is just a means of getting from A to B.
ex.cn: 在我看来，汽车只不过是从一地到另一地的代步工具。

senses.def: including everything there is to know about sth

ex.en: He knew his subject from A to Z.
ex.cn: 他通晓自己的学科。

senses.def: from the beginning

ex.en: It's never worked from day one.
ex.cn: 这从一开始就行不通。

senses.def: with no thoughts or plans for the future

ex.en: They live from day to day, looking after their sick daughter.
ex.cn: 他们过一天算一天，日复一日地照顾着生病的女儿。

senses.def: if a situation changes from day to day, it changes often
senses.chn: 天天，一天又一天（指经常变化）

ex.en: A baby's need for food can vary from day to day.
ex.cn: 婴儿对食物的需要天天都在变化。

senses.def: from one generation of a family to the next
from beginning to end; during the whole time

ex.en: It's a fine performance that commands attention from first to last.
ex.cn: 这是个精彩的演出，自始至终都扣人心弦。

senses.def: used to describe a very unpleasant person or thing; the worst that you can imagine

ex.en: They are the neighbours from hell.
ex.cn: 这些邻居太可恶了。

from one day to the next.lemma: from one day to the next

senses.def: if a situation changes from one day to the next, it is uncertain and not likely to stay the same each day
senses.chn: 一天又一天（表示不知未来如何）

ex.en: I never know what to expect from one day to the next.
ex.cn: 一天又一天我从不知道会发生什么。

senses.def: without any previous preparation or knowledge

ex.en: I learned German from scratch in six months.
ex.cn: 我从零学起，六个月学会了德语。

senses.def: from the very beginning, not using any of the work done earlier

ex.en: They decided to dismantle the machine and start again from scratch.
ex.cn: 他们决定拆掉机器，从头再来。

senses.def: moving to the left and then to the right and then back again

ex.en: He shook his head slowly from side to side.
ex.cn: 他慢慢地摇了摇头。

ex.en: The ship rolled from side to side.
ex.cn: 船左右摇晃。

senses.def: from beginning to end

ex.en: She told me the whole story from soup to nuts.
ex.cn: 她把事情的来龙去脉都告诉了我。

senses.def: all the way from the front of a ship to the back

from the cradle to the grave.lemma: from the cradle to the grave

senses.def: a way of referring to the whole of a person's life, from birth until death

from the sublime to the ridiculous.lemma: from the sublime to the ridiculous

senses.def: used to describe a situation in which sth serious, important or of high quality is followed by sth silly, unimportant or of poor quality
senses.chn: 从高超到荒谬；从高妙到低俗

senses.def: occasionally but not regularly

ex.en: She has to work at weekends from time to time.
ex.cn: 她偶尔周末还得工作。

senses.def: going to every part of a place in a very thorough way

ex.en: We cleaned the house from top to bottom.
ex.cn: 我们把房子彻底打扫了一遍。

senses.def: completely; all over
senses.chn: 从头到脚；浑身上下；全部

ex.en: She was dressed in green from top to toe.
ex.cn: 她从头到脚穿了一身绿。

senses.def: a long leaf of some plants or trees, especially palms or ferns. Fronds are often divided into parts along the edge.
senses.chn: （尤指棕榈类或蕨类的）叶；蕨叶

senses.def: a long piece of seaweed that looks like one of these leaves
senses.chn: （海藻长条形的）植物体，叶状体

senses.def: the part or side of sth that faces forward; the side of sth that you look at first

ex.en: The front of the building was covered with ivy.
ex.cn: 大楼的正面爬满了常春藤。

ex.en: The book has a picture of Rome on the front.
ex.cn: 书的封面有一张罗马的照片。

ex.en: The front of the car was badly damaged.
ex.cn: 轿车的前面严重损坏。

senses.def: the position that is in the direction that sb/sth is facing

ex.en: Keep your eyes to the front and walk straight ahead.
ex.cn: 两眼看着正前方径直往前走。

ex.en: There's a garden at the front of the house.
ex.cn: 房子的前面有一座花园。

senses.def: the part of sth that is furthest forward

ex.en: I prefer to travel in the front of the car (= next to the driver).
ex.cn: 我喜欢坐在轿车的前座。

ex.en: The teacher made me move my seat to the front of the classroom.
ex.cn: 老师把我的座位调到教室的前面。

ex.en: Write your name in the front of the book (= the first few pages).
ex.cn: 在前面的书页写上你的名字。

ex.en: I'll meet you in front of/outside your hotel.
ex.cn: 我在你的旅馆前面／外面接你。

ex.en: There's a bus stop in front of the house(= on the same side of the road).
ex.cn: 房子前面有一个公共汽车站（在公路的这面）。

ex.en: There's a bus stop opposite the house(= on the other side of the road).
ex.cn: 房子对面有一个公共汽车站（在公路的对面）。

senses.def: the part of sb's body that faces forwards; sb's chest

ex.en: She was lying on her front.
ex.cn: 她俯卧着。

ex.en: I spilled coffee down my front.
ex.cn: 我把咖啡溅到了前襟上。

senses.def: the side of a large building, especially a church, that faces west, north, etc.
senses.chn: （建筑物，尤指教堂朝西、北、东、南等的）面

ex.en: the west front of the cathedral
ex.cn: 大教堂的西侧

senses.def: the road or area of land along the edge of the sea, a lake or a river
senses.chn: 海滨；湖畔；河边；沿海（或湖、河）道路

ex.en: Couples walked hand in hand along the front.
ex.cn: 对对情侣手牵手沿河边散步。

senses.def: an area where fighting takes place during a war

ex.en: More British troops have been sent to the front.
ex.cn: 更多的英国部队已派往前线。

ex.en: to serve at the front
ex.cn: 在前方服役

ex.en: fighting a war on two fronts
ex.cn: 在两条战线上战斗

senses.def: a particular area of activity

ex.en: Things are looking unsettled on the economic front.
ex.cn: 经济战线上的情况显得不稳定。

ex.en: Progress has been made on all fronts.
ex.cn: 各方面都取得了进展。

senses.def: behaviour that is not genuine, done in order to hide your true feelings or opinions

ex.en: Rudeness is just a front for her shyness.
ex.cn: 她的粗鲁只是为了掩饰羞怯。

ex.en: It's not always easy to put on a brave front for the family.
ex.cn: 常为家人装出勇敢的样子并不容易。

ex.en: The prime minister stressed the need to present a united front (= show people that all members of the group have the same opinion about things).
ex.cn: 首相强调必须表现出团结一致。

senses.def: a person or an organization that is used to hide an illegal or secret activity
senses.chn: 非法（或秘密）活动掩护者

ex.en: The travel company is just a front for drug trafficking.
ex.cn: 这家旅行社不过是毒品交易的掩护场所。

senses.def: used in the names of some political organizations

ex.en: the Animal Liberation Front
ex.cn: 动物解放阵线

senses.def: the line where a mass of cold air meets a mass of warm air

ex.en: a cold/warm front
ex.cn: 冷锋；暖锋

senses.def: in or into the most important position
in a position that is further forward than sb/sth but not very far away

ex.en: Their house is the one with the big garden in front.
ex.cn: 他们的房子是前面有大花园的那一座。

senses.def: in first place in a race or competition

ex.en: The blue team is currently in front with a lead of six points.
ex.cn: 蓝队目前以六分领先。

senses.def: in a position that is further forward than sb/sth but not very far away

ex.en: The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I had to brake.
ex.cn: 我前面那辆车突然停下来，我也只好刹车。

ex.en: The bus stops right in front of our house.
ex.cn: 公共汽车就停在我们的房子前面。

ex.en: He was standing in front of me in the line.
ex.cn: 在队列中他站在我的前面。

ex.en: She spends all day sitting in front of (= working at) her computer.
ex.cn: 她整天坐在计算机前（工作）。

senses.def: if you do sth in front of sb, you do it when they are there

ex.en: Please don't talk about it in front of the children.
ex.cn: 请不要当着孩子们的面谈那件事。

senses.def: still to come; not yet passed

ex.en: Don't give up. You still have your whole life in front of you.
ex.cn: 不要放弃，你的前面还有一辈子呢。

senses.def: in the part of a theatre, restaurant, etc. where the public sits

ex.en: There's only a small audience out front tonight.
ex.cn: 今夜观众席上人很少。

senses.def: in the area near to the entrance to a building

ex.en: I'll wait for you out (the) front.
ex.cn: 我在大门外等你。

senses.def: as payment in advance

ex.en: We'll pay you half up front and the other half when you've finished the job.
ex.cn: 我们先付一半给你，工作完成后再付另一半。

senses.def: in a forward position

ex.en: to play up front
ex.cn: 担任前锋

senses.def: if you put on a piece of clothing back to front, you make a mistake and put the back where the front should be

ex.en: I think you've got that sweater on back to front.
ex.cn: 我觉得你把毛衣前后穿反了。

senses.def: with immediate payment of cash

ex.en: to pay for sth cash down
ex.cn: 用现款支付

senses.def: in sb's presence; in front of sb
senses.chn: 当着某人的面；就在某人的眼皮底下

ex.en: He had seen his life's work destroyed before his very eyes.
ex.cn: 他曾看到他毕生的劳动成果就在自己的眼前毁于一旦。

senses.def: to take an active part in what you are telling or persuading others to do
on or at the front of sth
senses.chn: 前面的；前部的；在前的；正面的

ex.en: front teeth
ex.cn: 门牙

ex.en: the front wheels of the car
ex.cn: 汽车的前轮

ex.en: We had seats in the front row.
ex.cn: 我们坐在前排座位。

ex.en: an animal's front legs
ex.cn: 动物的前腿

ex.en: Let's go through to the front room (= the main room in a house where people sit and entertain guests).
ex.cn: 咱们穿过去直到客厅。

ex.en: a front-seat passenger
ex.cn: 前排座位的一个乘客

senses.def: produced with the front of the tongue in a higher position than the back, for example /iː/ in English
being given a lot of attention because it is considered important
senses.chn: 处于前列重要地位；受到重视；为当务之急

ex.en: Anything that keeps education on the front burner is good.
ex.cn: 任何重视教育的事都是好事。

senses.def: to face sth or be in front of sth; to have the front pointing towards sth

ex.en: The cathedral fronts the city's main square.
ex.cn: 大教堂面向城市的主广场。

ex.en: The line of houses fronted straight onto the road.
ex.cn: 这排房子正对着马路。

senses.def: to have the front covered with sth

ex.en: a glass-fronted bookcase
ex.cn: 正面是玻璃的书柜

senses.def: to lead or represent an organization, a group, etc.

ex.en: He fronts a multinational company.
ex.cn: 他领导一家跨国公司。

ex.en: A former art student fronted the band (= was the main singer).
ex.cn: 乐队的主唱曾是一位艺术院校学生。

senses.def: to present a television programme, a show, etc.
to give more importance to a part of a sentence by placing it at or near the beginning of the sentence, as in 'That I would like to see.'
senses.chn: （为强调而）将（句子某一部分）前置

senses.def: to represent a group or an organization and try to hide its secret or illegal activities

ex.en: He fronted for them in several illegal property deals.
ex.cn: 他为他们在几次非法房地产交易中作了掩护。

senses.def: the front of a building, especially when this faces a road or river
senses.chn: （建筑物，尤指临街或临河的）正面

ex.en: the baroque frontage of Milan Cathedral
ex.cn: 米兰大教堂巴罗克风格的正面

senses.def: land that is next to a building, a street or an area of water
senses.chn: 临街（或建筑物、河等的）土地

ex.en: They bought two miles of river frontage along the Colorado.
ex.cn: 他们买了两英里科罗拉多河沿河的土地。

senses.def: connected with the front of sth

ex.en: Airbags protect the driver in the event of a severe frontal impact.
ex.cn: 汽车若遇到正面猛烈撞击，安全气囊可以保护驾车者。

senses.def: a frontal attack is very strong and direct
senses.chn: （攻击或抨击）正面的，劈头盖脸的，直截了当的

ex.en: They launched a frontal attack on company directors.
ex.cn: 他们直截了当地对公司董事进行抨击。

senses.def: connected with a weather front

ex.en: a cold frontal system
ex.cn: 冷锋系

senses.def: connected with the front part of the head

ex.en: the frontal lobes of the brain
ex.cn: 大脑额叶

senses.def: either of the two parts at the front of the brain that are concerned with behaviour, learning and personality
senses.chn: 额叶（与行为、学习和个性有关）

senses.def: in or into the most important position
an important member of the government or the opposition in the British parliament, who sits in the front rows of seats
the desk inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go when they first arrive
the main entrance to a house, usually at the front

ex.en: There's someone at the front door.
ex.cn: 前门有个人。

senses.def: directly used by a user, and allowing the user to use other devices or programs
senses.chn: 前端的；前置的；用户直接调用的

senses.def: a large vehicle with machinery for digging worked by a system of hydraulics
a line that separates two countries, etc.; the land near this line

ex.en: the frontier between the land of the Saxons and that of the Danes
ex.cn: 撒克逊人土地和古斯堪的纳维亚人土地的边界

ex.en: a customs post on the frontier with Italy
ex.cn: 与意大利交界的边境上的海关关卡

ex.en: a frontier town/zone/post
ex.cn: 边陲小镇；边疆地带；边防站

ex.en: a national park on the border between Kenya and Tanzania
ex.cn: 位于肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚边界的国家公园

ex.en: The fence marked the boundary between my property and hers.
ex.cn: 那道篱笆曾是我和她的房产之间的地界。

ex.en: The river formed the frontier between the land of the Saxons and that of the Danes.
ex.cn: 这条河曾是撒克逊人与古斯堪的纳维亚人土地的分界线。

senses.def: the edge of land where people live and have built towns, beyond which the country is wild and unknown, especially in the western US in the 19th century
senses.chn: （尤指 19 世纪美国西部的）开发地区边缘地带，边远地区

ex.en: a remote frontier settlement
ex.cn: 边远地区定居点

senses.def: the limit of sth, especially the limit of what is known about a particular subject or activity

ex.en: to push back the frontiers of science (= to increase knowledge of science)
ex.cn: 开拓科学新领域

ex.en: to roll back the frontiers of government (= to limit the powers of the government)
ex.cn: 限制政府权力

senses.def: a man living on the frontier especially one who lived in the western US during the 19th century
senses.chn: （尤指 19 世纪美国西部的）开拓者，拓荒者，边远地区居民

senses.def: a picture at the beginning of a book, on the page opposite the page with the title on it
senses.chn: （与书名页相对一页上的）卷首插图

senses.def: to spread the costs of a project so that more of the money is spent in the earlier stages
senses.chn: 将（成本）的大头提前花费

ex.en: a need to front-load budget spending
ex.cn: 前期花费大部分预算支出的需要

ex.en: the positive effects of front-loading funds
ex.cn: 前期投入大部分资金的好处

senses.def: to organize work on a project or information in a document so that the more important work or information is done or placed first
senses.chn: 将（项目或文章）的重点前置

ex.en: Teach your students to front-load their research.
ex.cn: 教学生从事研究时学会前紧后松。

senses.def: a person who represents an organization and tries to make its activities seem acceptable to the public, although in fact they may be illegal
senses.chn: （某组织的）代表，头面人物；（非法活动的）掩护者

ex.en: He acted as a frontman for a drugs cartel.
ex.cn: 他给一个毒品集团当掩护。

senses.def: the leader of a group of musicians
a person who presents a television programme
the part of a business concerned with managing things or dealing with the public
senses.chn: （企业的）管理部门，与公众打交道的部门

senses.def: the parts of a theatre that are used by the audience
the business of dealing with an audience at a theatre, for example selling tickets and programmes
senses.chn: （剧院的）前台事务，观众厅工作

senses.def: the first page of a newspaper, where the most important news is printed

ex.en: The story was on the front pages of all the tabloids.
ex.cn: 所有小报都在头版报道了这件事。

senses.def: a person, an animal or an organization that seems most likely to win a race or competition
senses.chn: （赛跑或竞赛中）最可能获胜者，领先者

senses.def: a system in which power from the engine is sent to the front wheels of a vehicle
a weather condition in which the temperature drops below 0°C (= freezing point ) so that a thin white layer of ice forms on the ground and other surfaces, especially at night
senses.chn: 严寒天气；霜冻；冰点以下的温度

ex.en: It will be a clear night with some ground frost.
ex.cn: 今夜晴，部分地面有霜冻。

ex.en: a sharp/hard/severe frost
ex.cn: 酷寒

ex.en: There were ten degrees of frost (= the temperature dropped to −10°C) last night.
ex.cn: 昨夜零下 10 摄氏度。

ex.en: frost damage
ex.cn: 霜冻害

senses.def: the thin white layer of ice that forms when the temperature drops below 0°C

ex.en: The car windows were covered with frost.
ex.cn: 车窗玻璃结了霜。

senses.def: to cover sth or to become covered with a thin white layer of ice

ex.en: The mirror was frosted up.
ex.cn: 镜子蒙了一层霜。

ex.en: The windows had frosted over.
ex.cn: 窗子结满了霜。

senses.def: to cover a cake with icing/ frosting
a medical condition in which parts of the body, especially the fingers and toes, become damaged as a result of extremely cold temperatures
that has been given a rough surface, so that it is difficult to see through
covered with icing/ frosting
covered with frost

ex.en: the frosted garden
ex.cn: 寒霜覆盖的花园

senses.def: containing very small shiny pieces

ex.en: frosted eyeshadow
ex.cn: 闪光点眼影

senses.def: the crime of stealing a vehicle that has been left with the engine running in cold weather so that the engine warms up
senses.chn: （冷天趁发动机预热车辆无人看管时下手的）盗窃车辆罪

senses.def: extremely cold; cold with frost

ex.en: a frosty morning
ex.cn: 严寒的早晨

ex.en: He breathed in the frosty air.
ex.cn: 他吸进冰冷的空气。

senses.def: covered with frost

ex.en: frosty fields
ex.cn: 结霜的田地

senses.def: unfriendly, in a way that suggests that sb does not approve of sth

ex.en: a frosty look/reply
ex.cn: 冷冰冰的样子；冷淡的答复

ex.en: The latest proposals were given a frosty reception.
ex.cn: 对最新的建议反应冷淡。

senses.def: a mass of small bubbles, especially on the surface of a liquid

ex.en: a glass of beer with thick froth on top
ex.cn: 上面有厚厚一层泡沫的一杯啤酒

ex.en: He taught me the fundamentals of the job.
ex.cn: 他教给了我这工作的基本知识。

senses.def: a force that is a property (= characteristic) of everything in the universe. There are four fundamental forces including gravity and electromagnetism .
senses.chn: 基本力（宇宙万物所具有的特性，包括引力和电磁力等四种）

senses.def: the practice of following very strictly the basic rules and teachings of any religion
senses.chn: 原教旨主义（认为应严格奉行宗教原则和教义）

senses.def: (in Christianity) the belief that everything that is written in the Bible is completely true
senses.chn: （基督教的）基要主义，原教旨主义（强调直解《圣经》）

senses.def: in every way that is important; completely

ex.en: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
ex.cn: 这两种方法完全不同。

ex.en: By the 1960s the situation had changed fundamentally.
ex.cn: 到 20 世纪 60 年代形势已发生了根本的变化。

ex.en: They remained fundamentally opposed to the plan.
ex.cn: 他们依然从根本上反对这项计划。

senses.def: used when you are introducing a topic and stating sth important about it
senses.chn: （引入话题时说）从根本上说，基本上

ex.en: Fundamentally, there are two different approaches to the problem.
ex.cn: 从根本上说，这个问题有两种不同的处理方法。

senses.def: used when you are saying what is the most important thing about sb/sth
senses.chn: （表示最重要的方面）根本上，基本上

ex.en: She is fundamentally a nice person, but she finds it difficult to communicate.
ex.cn: 她基本上是个好人，但她觉得难以和人沟通。

senses.def: the tone that represents the lowest frequency of sth such as a string or bell when it vibrates
senses.chn: 基音，根音（代表弦振动或钟摆动的最低频率的音）

senses.def: a person or an organization that provides money for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 资金赞助者；资金提供者

senses.def: a person who is very skilled at sth or who has gained a lot of knowledge about a particular subject

ex.en: a computer fundi
ex.cn: 电脑高手

ex.en: He's become quite a fundi on wine.
ex.cn: 他成了葡萄酒的行家。

senses.def: money for a particular purpose; the act of providing money for such a purpose
senses.chn: 基金；资金；提供基金；提供资金

ex.en: There have been large cuts in government funding for scientific research.
ex.cn: 政府提供的科研资金已大幅度削减。

senses.def: a person who collects money for a charity or an organization
a social event or an entertainment held in order to collect money for a charity or an organization
a ceremony, usually a religious one, for burying or cremating(= burning) a dead person

ex.en: Hundreds of people attended the funeral.
ex.cn: 数百人参加了葬礼。

ex.en: a funeral procession
ex.cn: 送葬队伍

ex.en: a funeral march (= a sad piece of music suitable for funerals)
ex.cn: 丧礼进行曲

senses.def: used to tell sb that they, and nobody else, will have to deal with the unpleasant results of their own actions
a place where dead people are prepared for being buried or cremated (= burned) and where visitors can see the body
of or used at a funeral

ex.en: funerary monuments/rites
ex.cn: 墓碑；丧葬仪式

senses.def: suitable for a funeral; sad

ex.en: a funereal atmosphere
ex.cn: 悲哀肃穆的气氛

senses.def: of or caused by fungus

ex.en: a fungal infection
ex.cn: 真菌感染

senses.def: a substance that kills fungus
like a fungus

ex.en: a fungoid growth
ex.cn: 真菌式赘生物

senses.def: an organism and mildew (= a living thing) that is similar to a plant without leaves, flowers or green colouring, and that usually grows on plants or on decaying matter. Mushrooms and mildew are both fungi.
a covering of mould or a similar fungus, for example on a plant or wall

ex.en: fungus infections
ex.cn: 霉菌感染

senses.def: a building at an amusement park containing mirrors that produce strange images, moving floors, and other devices for scaring and amusing people
senses.chn: 奇幻屋，欢乐屋（内设哈哈镜、活动地板等惊险有趣的设施）

senses.def: a railway on a steep slope, used to transport passengers up and down in special cars by means of a moving cable
a type of dance music with a strong rhythm, developed by African American musicians in the 1960s
senses.chn: 放克音乐（20 世纪 60 年代美国黑人音乐家创造，节奏感强）

senses.def: a state of fear or anxiety
a strong unpleasant smell
to avoid doing sth because you are afraid to or find it difficult
with a strong rhythm that is easy to dance to

ex.en: a funky disco beat
ex.cn: 动感强劲的迪斯科节奏

senses.def: fashionable and unusual

ex.en: She wears really funky clothes.
ex.cn: 她穿的衣服真是时髦又独特。

senses.def: having a strong unpleasant smell
liking to enjoy themselves
a device that is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into a small opening
a metal chimney, for example on a ship or an engine, through which smoke comes out
to move or make sth move through a narrow space, or as if through a funnel
senses.chn: （使）流经狭窄空间，经过漏斗形口子

ex.en: Wind was funnelling through the gorge.
ex.cn: 风吹过峡谷。

ex.en: Huge pipes funnel the water down the mountainside.
ex.cn: 巨大的管道把水沿山坡输送下山。

ex.en: Barricades funnelled the crowds towards the square.
ex.cn: 设置的路障控制人流涌向广场。

ex.en: Some $10 million in aid was funnelled into the country through government agencies.
ex.cn: 约 1 000 万美元援助款已通过政府各部门发放到农村。

senses.def: in a strange way
used to show that you expect people to find a particular fact surprising

ex.en: Funnily enough, I met her only yesterday.
ex.cn: 说来也巧，昨天我才碰见了她。

senses.def: used to show that you expect people to find a particular fact surprising

ex.en: Funnily enough, I met her only yesterday.
ex.cn: 说来也巧，昨天我才碰见了她。

senses.def: making you laugh; amusing

ex.en: a funny story
ex.cn: 滑稽的故事

ex.en: That's the funniest thing I've ever heard.
ex.cn: 那是我听过的最滑稽可笑的事。

ex.en: It's not funny! Someone could have been hurt.
ex.cn: 这并不好玩！可能有人已经受到伤害。

ex.en: I was really embarrassed, but then I saw the funny side of it.
ex.cn: 我感到非常尴尬，但接着我发现了事情好笑的一面。

ex.en: Oh very funny! You expect me to believe that?
ex.cn: 哦，真滑稽！你认为我会相信那个？

ex.en: ' What's so funny?' she demanded.
ex.cn: “什么事这么好笑？” 她问道。

senses.def: difficult to explain or understand
senses.chn: 奇怪的；难以解释的；难理解的

ex.en: A funny thing happened to me today.
ex.cn: 今天我碰上了一件奇怪的事。

ex.en: It's funny how things never happen the way you expect them to.
ex.cn: 真是不懂，事情总是出人意表的。

ex.en: That's funny —he was here a moment ago and now he's gone.
ex.cn: 真怪，他刚才还在这儿，现在就没影了。

ex.en: The funny thing is it never happened again after that.
ex.cn: 奇怪的是从那以后这事再也没有发生过。

ex.en: The engine's making a very funny noise.
ex.cn: 发动机发出一种很怪的声音。

ex.en: I'm pleased I didn't get that job, in a funny sort of way.
ex.cn: 我没有得到那份工作，但我有一种说不清楚的高兴。

senses.def: suspicious and probably illegal or dishonest
senses.chn: 可疑的；非法的；不诚实的

ex.en: I suspect there may be something funny going on.
ex.cn: 我怀疑可能有某种非法勾当在进行。

ex.en: If there has been any funny business, we'll soon find out.
ex.cn: 如果有任何非法的事，我们会很快发现的。

senses.def: humorous in a way that shows a lack of respect for sb

ex.en: Don't you get funny with me!
ex.cn: 你不要对我放肆！

senses.def: slightly ill/sick
senses.chn: 小病的；微恙的；稍有不适的

ex.en: I feel a bit funny today—I don't think I'll go to work.
ex.cn: 我今天感到有点不舒服，不想去上班了。

senses.def: slightly crazy; not like other people
senses.chn: 疯疯癫癫的；不很正常的

ex.en: That Dave's a funny chap, isn't he?
ex.cn: 那个戴夫疯疯癫癫的，是不是？

ex.en: She went a bit funny after her husband died.
ex.cn: 丈夫死后她神志就有点不大正常了。

senses.def: not working as it should

ex.en: My computer keeps going funny.
ex.cn: 我的计算机老出故障。

senses.def: used to show that 'funny' is being used with the meaning of 'amusing'
used to show that 'funny' is being used with the meaning of 'strange'
the part of the elbow containing a very sensitive nerve that is painful if you hit it against sth
senses.chn: 麻筋儿，鹰嘴突，肘的尺骨端（肘端神经敏感部位）

senses.def: a hospital for people who are mentally ill
used to show that 'funny' is being used with the meaning of 'amusing'
a currency (= the money used in one country) which is not worth much and whose value can change quickly
senses.chn: 币值低（或不稳定）的货币

senses.def: money that has been forged(= is not real) or stolen or that has come from illegal activities
senses.chn: 假币；来路不明的钱；黑钱

senses.def: used to show that 'funny' is being used with the meaning of 'strange'
an event in which people run a long distance, for fun, and to collect money for charity
the soft thick mass of hair that grows on the body of some animals
the skin of an animal with the fur still on it, used especially for making clothes

ex.en: a fur coat
ex.cn: 毛皮大衣

ex.en: the fur trade
ex.cn: 毛皮贸易

ex.en: a fur farm (= where animals are bred and killed for their fur)
ex.cn: 毛皮动物饲养场

ex.en: The animal is hunted for its fur.
ex.cn: 狩猎这种动物是为了获取其毛皮。

ex.en: fur-lined gloves
ex.cn: 毛皮衬里手套

senses.def: an artificial material that looks and feels like fur
a piece of clothing, especially a coat or jacket, made of real or artificial fur
senses.chn: 毛皮衣服，裘皮衣服（尤指大衣或短上衣）

ex.en: elegant ladies in furs
ex.cn: 穿着裘皮衣服的高雅贵妇

senses.def: a greyish-white layer that forms on a person's tongue, especially when they are ill/sick
very angry

ex.en: She was absolutely furious at having been deceived.
ex.cn: 她受了骗，怒不可遏。

ex.en: He was furious with himself for letting things get so out of control.
ex.cn: 他对自己很恼火，怪自己竟让事情变得如此不可收拾。

ex.en: I'm furious that I wasn't told about it.
ex.cn: 这事没有跟我说，我十分气愤。

senses.def: with great energy, speed or anger
senses.chn: 激烈的；猛烈的；高速的；盛怒的

ex.en: a furious debate
ex.cn: 激烈的辩论

ex.en: She drove off at a furious pace.
ex.cn: 她驾车飞驰而去。

senses.def: full of rapid action and sudden changes
senses.chn: 情节节奏快且变化多端

ex.en: In his latest movie, the action is fast and furious.
ex.cn: 在他的最新电影中，情节起伏跌宕。

senses.def: to roll and fasten sth such as a sail, a flag or an umbrella
a unit for measuring distance, equal to 220 yards or 201 metres; one eighth of a mile
senses.chn: 弗隆，浪（长度单位，相当于 220 码、201 米或 ¹⁄₈ 英里）

senses.def: permission to leave your duties for a period of time, especially for soldiers working in a foreign country
senses.chn: （尤指在国外服役士兵的）休假（许可）

senses.def: permission for a prisoner to leave prison for a period of time
a period of time during which workers are told not to come to work, usually because there is not enough money to pay them
senses.chn: （通常因发不出工资而给的）准假

senses.def: a space surrounded on all sides by walls and a roof for heating metal or glass to very high temperatures

ex.en: It's like a furnace (= very hot) in here!
ex.cn: 这里热得像火炉！

senses.def: to put furniture in a house, room, etc.

ex.en: The room was furnished with antiques.
ex.cn: 房间里摆放了古董。

senses.def: to supply or provide sb/sth with sth; to supply sth to sb
senses.chn: 向（某人或某事物）供应，提供

ex.en: She furnished him with the facts surrounding the case.
ex.cn: 她向他提供了与案件有关的事实。

senses.def: containing furniture

ex.en: furnished accommodation (= to rent complete with furniture)
ex.cn: 连家具出租房

ex.en: The house was simply furnished.
ex.cn: 这房子陈设简单。

senses.def: the furniture, carpets, curtains, etc. in a room or house

ex.en: soft furnishings
ex.cn: 织物制成的室内陈设

ex.en: The wallpaper should match the furnishings.
ex.cn: 墙纸应和家具陈设协调。

senses.def: objects that can be moved, such as tables, chairs and beds, that are put into a house or an office to make it suitable for living or working in

ex.en: a piece of furniture
ex.cn: 一件家具

ex.en: garden/office, etc. furniture
ex.cn: 花园、办公室等处的家具

ex.en: We need to buy some new furniture.
ex.cn: 我们需要买一些新家具。

ex.en: I worked there so long that I became part of the furniture.
ex.cn: 我在那里工作得太久，都不为人注意了。

senses.def: great anger or excitement shown by a number of people, usually caused by a public event

ex.en: His novel about Jesus caused a furore among Christians.
ex.cn: 他关于耶稣的小说激起了基督教徒的公愤。

ex.en: the recent furore over the tax increases
ex.cn: 近来因增税引起的骚动

senses.def: a piece of information or a story that people talk about but that may not be true
covered with fur or with sth that looks like fur
senses.chn: 覆盖毛皮的；穿戴毛皮衣物的；长舌苔的

ex.en: a furred tongue
ex.cn: 长苔的舌头

senses.def: a person who prepares or sells clothes made from fur
a long narrow cut in the ground, especially one made by a plough for planting seeds in
a deep line in the skin of the face
to do things that other people do not do, or be interested in things that other people are not interested in
senses.chn: 自耕孤畴（指自行其是或自得其乐）

senses.def: to make a furrow in the earth

ex.en: furrowed fields
ex.cn: 犁过的田地

senses.def: if your brows or eyebrows furrow or are furrowed, you pull them together, usually because you are worried, and so produce lines on your face
covered with fur

ex.en: small furry animals
ex.cn: 毛茸茸的小动物

senses.def: like fur

ex.en: The moss was soft and furry to the touch.
ex.cn: 苔藓柔软，摸起来像绒毛。

senses.def: at or to a greater distance

ex.en: We had walked further than I had realized.
ex.cn: 在我不知不觉中我们已走得很远。

ex.en: Two miles further on we came to a small town.
ex.cn: 我们又走了两英里，来到了一座小镇。

ex.en: The hospital is further down the road.
ex.cn: 沿这条路走下去就是医院。

ex.en: Can you stand a bit further away?
ex.cn: 你能不能站远一点？

senses.def: a longer way in the past or the future

ex.en: Think further back into your childhood.
ex.cn: 再往前回想你的童年。

ex.en: How will the company be doing ten years further on?
ex.cn: 十年以后公司的情况将如何呢？

senses.def: to a greater degree or extent
senses.chn: 进一步；在更大程度上；在更大范围内

ex.en: The police decided to investigate further.
ex.cn: 警方决定作进一步调查。

ex.en: My life is further complicated by having to work such long hours.
ex.cn: 我得工作这么长的时间，因此生活中的麻烦事就更多了。

ex.en: Nothing could be further from the truth.
ex.cn: 绝不是那回事。

senses.def: in addition to what has just been said

ex.en: Further, it is important to consider the cost of repairs.
ex.cn: 此外，重要的是要考虑修理费用。

ex.en: I have to travel further/farther to work now.
ex.cn: 现在我得走更远的路去上班。

ex.en: Let's consider this point further.
ex.cn: 让我们更深入地考虑这一点。

ex.en: Are there any further questions?
ex.cn: 还有什么问题吗？

senses.def: to say more about sth, or make a more extreme point about it
senses.chn: 进一步说；提出更极端的意见

ex.en: I would go even further and suggest that the entire government is corrupt.
ex.cn: 我甚至进而想要说，整个政府都是腐败的。

senses.def: to last longer; to serve more people

ex.en: They watered down the soup to make it go further.
ex.cn: 他们往汤里掺水，好让更多的人喝。

senses.def: if you tell sb that a secret will go no further, you promise not to tell it to anyone else
to take more serious action about sth or speak to sb at a higher level about it
senses.chn: 采取进一步行动；把…向上级反映

ex.en: I am not satisfied with your explanation and intend to take the matter further.
ex.cn: 我对你的解释不满意，打算进一步探讨这个问题。

senses.def: far away from home; to or in places that are not near
senses.chn: 远离家乡；去远处；在远方

ex.en: You can hire a car if you want to explore further afield.
ex.cn: 假如你想逛更远的地方，可以租辆汽车。

ex.en: Journalists came from as far afield as China.
ex.cn: 新闻记者有的来自遥远的中国。

senses.def: more; additional
senses.chn: 更多的；更进一步的；附加的

ex.en: Cook for a further 2 minutes.
ex.cn: 再煮两分钟。

ex.en: Have you any further questions?
ex.cn: 你还有问题吗？

ex.en: For further details call this number.
ex.cn: 欲知详情，请拨打这个电话号码。

ex.en: We have decided to take no further action.
ex.cn: 我们决定不采取进一步行动。

ex.en: The museum is closed until further notice (= until we say that it is open again).
ex.cn: 博物馆现在闭馆，开馆时间另行通知。

ex.en: Bilingual children do better in IQ tests than children who speak only one language. In addition / What is more, they seem to find it easier to learn third or even fourth languages.
ex.cn: 讲两种语言的儿童比只讲一种语言的儿童智商测试得分更高。此外／而且，讲两种语言的儿童似乎在学习第三种甚至第四种语言时觉得更容易。

senses.def: to help sth to develop or be successful

ex.en: They hoped the new venture would further the cause of cultural cooperation in Europe.
ex.cn: 他们希望这个新项目将促进欧洲文化合作事业。

ex.en: She took the new job to further her career.
ex.cn: 她接受了这个新工作以进一步发展她的事业。

senses.def: the process of helping sth to develop or to be successful

ex.en: He took these actions purely in (the) furtherance of his own career.
ex.cn: 他采取这些行动纯粹是为了促进自己的事业发展。

senses.def: education that is provided for people after leaving school, but not at a university
senses.chn: 继续教育，进修教育（为中学毕业后的人举办，但非大学）

senses.def: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument.

ex.en: He said he had not discussed the matter with her. Furthermore, he had not even contacted her.
ex.cn: 他说他没有和她讨论过这个问题。而且，甚至没有和她联系过。

ex.en: Bilingual children do better in IQ tests than children who speak only one language. In addition / What is more, they seem to find it easier to learn third or even fourth languages.
ex.cn: 讲两种语言的儿童比只讲一种语言的儿童智商测试得分更高。此外／而且，讲两种语言的儿童似乎在学习第三种甚至第四种语言时觉得更容易。

ex.en: Learning another language not only improves children's job prospects in later life, but also boosts their self-esteem.
ex.cn: 学习另一种语言不仅可以提升儿童未来的职业前景，而且可以增强他们的自尊心。

ex.en: Teaching children a second language improves their job prospects in later life. Other benefits include increased self-esteem and greater tolerance of other cultures.
ex.cn: 教儿童第二语言可以提升他们未来的职业前景。此外，还可以使他们获得更强的自尊心、对其他文化更包容。

ex.en: Another / One further / One additional reason for encouraging bilingual education is that it boosts children's self-esteem.
ex.cn: 另一个鼓励双语教育的原因是它能增强儿童的自尊心。

ex.en: Studies suggest that bilingual children find it easier to learn additional languages. There is, moreover, increasing evidence that bilingual children perform better across a range of school subjects, not just foreign languages.
ex.cn: 研究表明，讲两种语言的儿童学习其他语言觉得更容易。此外，越来越多的证据表明，讲两种语言的儿童不仅在外语学习上，同时在其他各门学科的学习上都表现得更好。

senses.def: located at the greatest distance from sth

ex.en: at the furthermost end of the street
ex.cn: 在街尾

senses.def: used in letters, emails, etc. to refer to a previous letter, email, conversation, etc.
senses.chn: （用于书信、电邮等）关于，至于，考虑到

ex.en: Further to our conversation of last Friday, I would like to book the conference centre for 26 June.
ex.cn: 按我们上星期五说过的，我想预约 6 月 26 日使用会议中心。

senses.def: behaving in a way that shows that you want to keep sth secret and do not want to be noticed
senses.chn: 偷偷摸摸的；鬼鬼祟祟的；遮遮掩掩的

ex.en: She cast a furtive glance over her shoulder.
ex.cn: 她偷偷往背后瞥了一下。

ex.en: He looked sly and furtive.
ex.cn: 他显得偷偷摸摸，鬼鬼祟祟。

senses.def: extreme anger that often includes violent behaviour
senses.chn: 狂怒；暴怒；狂暴；大发雷霆

ex.en: Her eyes blazed with fury.
ex.cn: 她的双眼迸发出暴怒之火。

ex.en: Fury over tax increases (= as a newspaper headline )
ex.cn: 对增税极端愤怒（报纸标题）

ex.en: There was no shelter from the fury of the storm.
ex.cn: 那时没有地方可以躲避狂风暴雨。

senses.def: a state of being extremely angry about sth

ex.en: He flew into a fury when I refused.
ex.cn: 我拒绝，他就勃然大怒。

senses.def: (in ancient Greek stories) three goddesses who punish people for their crimes
with great effort, power, speed, etc.
used to refer to sb, usually a woman, who has reacted very angrily to sth, especially the fact that her husband or lover has been unfaithful
senses.chn: （尤指女人因丈夫或情人不忠而）大发雷霆；醋劲大发

senses.def: a small wire or device inside a piece of electrical equipment that breaks and stops the current if the flow of electricity is too strong

ex.en: to change a fuse
ex.cn: 换保险丝

ex.en: Check whether a fuse has blown.
ex.cn: 检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

senses.def: a long piece of string or paper which is lit to make a bomb or a firework explode
a device that makes a bomb explode when it hits sth or at a particular time

ex.en: He set the fuse to three minutes.
ex.cn: 他把引信设定为三分钟起爆。

ex.en: The bombs inside were on a one-hour fuse.
ex.cn: 炸弹内装有一小时起爆的引信。

senses.def: to get very angry
to have a tendency to get angry quickly and easily
senses.chn: 动辄发火；性情暴躁；脾气不好

ex.en: You may find your temper on a short fuse when confronting your teenager.
ex.cn: 对付十几岁的半大孩子，你可能动不动就会生气。

senses.def: when one thing fuses with another, or two things fuse or are fused, they are joined together to form a single thing

ex.en: As they heal, the bones will fuse together.
ex.cn: 骨头愈合时将会连接在一起。

ex.en: Our different ideas fused into a plan.
ex.cn: 我们不同的想法融合成一项计划。

ex.en: The sperm fuses with the egg to begin the process of fertilization.
ex.cn: 精子与卵子结合开始受精过程。

ex.en: The two companies have been fused into a single organization.
ex.cn: 两家公司合并成一个机构。

ex.en: Atoms of hydrogen are fused to make helium.
ex.cn: 氢原子可熔合成氦。

senses.def: when a substance, especially metal, fuses, or you fuse it, it is heated until it melts
to stop working or to make sth stop working because a fuse melts

ex.en: The lights have fused.
ex.cn: 保险丝烧断，灯都灭了。

ex.en: I've fused the lights.
ex.cn: 我把保险丝烧断了，灯都灭了。

senses.def: to put a fuse in a circuit or in a piece of equipment
senses.chn: 在（电路或电器）中安装保险丝

ex.en: Is this plug fused?
ex.cn: 这个插头有没有安装保险丝？

senses.def: a small box or cupboard that contains the fuses of the electrical system of a building
the main part of an aircraft in which passengers and goods are carried
thin wire used in an electrical fuse
(in the past) a soldier who carried a light gun
senses.chn: （旧时的）燧发枪士兵，明火枪士兵

senses.def: a rapid series of shots fired from one or more guns; a rapid series of objects that are thrown
senses.chn: （枪炮的）连发，连续齐射；（某物的）连续投掷

ex.en: a fusillade of bullets/stones
ex.cn: 枪林弹雨；雨点般投掷的石头

ex.en: He faced a fusillade of questions from the waiting journalists.
ex.cn: 正在等候的记者们向他发出连珠炮似的提问。

senses.def: pasta with a twisted shape
the process or result of joining two or more things together to form one

ex.en: the fusion of copper and zinc to produce brass
ex.cn: 铜与锌熔合成黄铜

ex.en: The movie displayed a perfect fusion of image and sound.
ex.cn: 这部电影展示了影像与音响的完美结合。

senses.def: the act or process of combining the nuclei (= central parts) of atoms to form a heavier nucleus, with energy being released
music that is a mixture of different styles, especially jazz and rock
senses.chn: 合成音乐，混合音乐（尤指爵士乐和摇滚乐）

senses.def: cooking that is a mixture of different styles

ex.en: French–Thai fusion
ex.cn: 法泰式混合烹饪

senses.def: a bomb that gets its energy from nuclear fusion, especially a hydrogen bomb
senses.chn: 聚变弹；热核弹；（尤指）氢弹

senses.def: a musician who plays fusion music
unnecessary excitement, worry or activity
senses.chn: 无谓的激动（或忧虑、活动）；大惊小怪

ex.en: He does what he's told without any fuss.
ex.cn: 他不声不响地按照吩咐办事。

ex.en: All that fuss over a few pounds!
ex.cn: 为几英镑就那么大惊小怪的！

ex.en: It's a very ordinary movie—I don't know what all the fuss is about (= why other people think it is so good).
ex.cn: 这是部很普通的电影，我不懂为什么就会轰动。

ex.en: It was all a fuss about nothing.
ex.cn: 这完全是瞎折腾。

ex.en: We'd like a quiet wedding without any fuss.
ex.cn: 我们喜欢静静举行婚礼，不大事铺张。

senses.def: anger or complaints about sth, especially sth that is not important

ex.en: I'm sorry for making such a fuss about the noise.
ex.cn: 对不起，我为吵闹声发了这么大的牢骚。

ex.en: Steve kicks up a fuss every time I even suggest seeing you.
ex.cn: 每次我即使只是提议看望你，史蒂夫就大吵大闹。

senses.def: to pay a lot of attention to sb, usually to show how much you like them

ex.en: They made a great fuss of the baby.
ex.cn: 他们对婴儿呵护备至。

ex.en: The dog loves being made a fuss of.
ex.cn: 这狗喜欢受到宠爱。

senses.def: to do things, or pay too much attention to things, that are not important or necessary
senses.chn: 瞎忙一气；过分关心（枝节小事）

ex.en: Stop fussing around and find something useful to do!
ex.cn: 别瞎忙活了，找点有用的事干！

ex.en: Don't fuss with your hair!
ex.cn: 不要老摆弄你的头发了！

senses.def: to worry about things that are not very important

ex.en: Don't fuss, Mum, everything is all right.
ex.cn: 别瞎操心了，妈妈，一切都好。

senses.def: to not mind about sth; to not have feelings about sth

ex.en: It'd be good to be there, but I'm not that fussed.
ex.cn: 去那里当然好，不过我无所谓。

senses.def: to pay a lot of attention to sb
to pay a lot of attention to sb
a person who is often worried about unimportant things and is difficult to please
senses.chn: 大惊小怪的人；好挑剔的人；爱吹毛求疵的人

senses.def: too concerned or worried about details or standards, especially unimportant ones
senses.chn: 无谓忧虑（或担心）的；大惊小怪的；挑剔的

ex.en: fussy parents
ex.cn: 瞎操心的父母

ex.en: Our teacher is very fussy about punctuation.
ex.cn: 我们老师对标点符号十分挑剔。

ex.en: She's such a fussy eater.
ex.cn: 她太挑食。

ex.en: 'Where do you want to go for lunch?' 'I'm not fussy (= I don't mind).'
ex.cn: “你想去哪儿吃午餐？” “我无所谓。”

senses.def: doing sth with small, quick, nervous movements

ex.en: a fussy manner
ex.cn: 局促不安的举止

ex.en: the quick, fussy movements of her small hands
ex.cn: 她的一双小手快速而紧张不安的动作

senses.def: having too much detail or decoration
senses.chn: 过分琐碎的；装饰太多的

ex.en: The costume designs are too fussy.
ex.cn: 这些服装设计过于花哨。

senses.def: a thick strong cotton cloth with a slightly rough surface, used in the past for making clothes
senses.chn: 纬起绒布（旧时用作衣料）

senses.def: language that sounds impressive but does not mean much
smelling old, damp or not fresh

ex.en: a dark fusty room
ex.cn: 阴暗霉湿的房间

senses.def: old-fashioned

ex.en: fusty ideas
ex.cn: 守旧的思想

ex.en: a fusty old professor
ex.cn: 古板的老教授

senses.def: having no purpose because there is no chance of success

ex.en: a futile attempt/exercise/gesture
ex.cn: 徒然的尝试／练习／表示

ex.en: Their efforts to revive him were futile.
ex.cn: 他们努力使他苏醒，但失败了。

ex.en: It would be futile to protest.
ex.cn: 抗议也无用。

ex.en: My appeal proved futile.
ex.cn: 我的申诉白费了。

senses.def: a Japanese mattress, often on a wooden frame, that can be used for sitting on or rolled out to make a bed
senses.chn: 日本床垫（折叠可坐，铺开可卧）

senses.def: the time that will come after the present or the events that will happen then

ex.en: We need to plan for the future.
ex.cn: 我们需要为将来作好打算。

ex.en: What will the cities of the future look like?
ex.cn: 未来的城市会是什么样子呢？

ex.en: The movie is set in the future.
ex.cn: 这部电影以未来为背景。

ex.en: The exchange rate is likely to fall in the near future (= soon).
ex.cn: 汇率可能不久就要下跌。

ex.en: What does the future hold?
ex.cn: 未来将会如何？

senses.def: what will happen to sb/sth at a later time
senses.chn: 未来的事；将来发生的事；前景

ex.en: Her future is uncertain.
ex.cn: 她前途未卜。

ex.en: This deal could safeguard the futures of the 2 000 employees.
ex.cn: 这个协议可以保障 2 000 名雇员今后的生活。

senses.def: the possibility of being successful or surviving at a later time

ex.en: She has a great future ahead of her.
ex.cn: 她前程远大。

ex.en: I can't see any future in this relationship.
ex.cn: 我看不出这个关系会有什么前途。

senses.def: goods or shares that are bought at agreed prices but that will be delivered and paid for at a later time

ex.en: oil futures
ex.cn: 石油期货

ex.en: the futures market
ex.cn: 期货市场

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses what will happen after the present
from now on

ex.en: Please be more careful in future.
ex.cn: 今后请多加小心。

ex.en: In future, make sure the door is never left unlocked.
ex.cn: 从今以后，千万别忘记锁好门。

senses.def: not a long time in the future but fairly soon
for/in the period of time when you can predict what is going to happen, based on the present circumstances

ex.en: The statue will remain in the museum for the foreseeable future.
ex.cn: 短期内这座雕像将留在博物馆。

ex.en: It's unlikely that the hospital will be closed in the foreseeable future (= soon).
ex.cn: 这家医院不大可能很快就关闭。

senses.def: taking place or existing at a time after the present
senses.chn: 将来的；未来的；将来发生的

ex.en: future generations
ex.cn: 子孙后代

ex.en: at a future date
ex.cn: 将来某个时候

ex.en: future developments in computer software
ex.cn: 计算机软件的未来发展

ex.en: He met his future wife at law school.
ex.cn: 他在法学院结识了他未来的妻子。

senses.def: designed to continue working or to be effective after changes that may happen in the future

ex.en: future-proof website design
ex.cn: 常青而实用的网站设计

senses.def: to make sth future-proof

ex.en: The firm claims that it future-proofs its software.
ex.cn: 这家公司声称其软件不会被时间淘汰。

senses.def: a movement in art and literature in the 1920s and 30s that did not try to show realistic figures and scenes but aimed to express confidence in the modern world, particularly in modern machines
senses.chn: 未来主义（20 世纪 20 和 30 年代的文艺运动，强调对技术时代的赞叹）

senses.def: extremely modern and unusual in appearance, as if belonging to a future time

ex.en: futuristic design
ex.cn: 未来感设计

senses.def: imagining what the future will be like
senses.chn: 幻想未来的；想象未来情况的

ex.en: a futuristic novel
ex.cn: 幻想未来的小说

senses.def: the time that will come after the present and what will happen then

ex.en: a vision of futurity
ex.cn: 对未来的展望

senses.def: a person who is an expert in futurology
the study of how people will live in the future
short soft fine hair or fur that covers sth, especially a person's face or arms
senses.chn: 茸毛，绒毛（尤指人脸或手臂的）

senses.def: a mass of hair in tight curls

ex.en: a fuzz of blonde hair
ex.cn: 一团金色鬈发

senses.def: the police
something that you cannot see clearly

ex.en: I saw it as a dim fuzz through the binoculars.
ex.cn: 我从双筒望远镜只看见一团模模糊糊的东西。

senses.def: a device that is used to change the sound of an electric guitar or other instrument by making the notes sound noisier and less clear
covered with short soft fine hair or fur
in a mass of tight curls
not clear in shape or sound

ex.en: a fuzzy image
ex.cn: 模糊的形象

ex.en: The soundtrack is fuzzy in places.
ex.cn: 这电影声带有些地方模糊不清。

senses.def: confused and not expressed clearly

ex.en: fuzzy ideas/thinking
ex.cn: 糊涂的想法／思想

senses.def: a type of logic that is used to try to make computers behave like the human brain
senses.chn: 模糊逻辑（尝试使计算机模拟人脑）

senses.def: used in writing to mean 'for what it's worth'
used to replace a word beginning with F that you do not want to say, especially the offensive swear word 'fuck' *
senses.chn: F 开头的词（用以替代不想说出口的以 F 开头的词，尤其是粗俗的骂人话 fuck）

ex.en: He was shocked at how often she used the F-word.
ex.cn: 她脏话不离口，使他感到震惊。

senses.def: a short way of writing special effects
a short way of writing foreign exchange
used mainly in writing to mean 'for your information'
senses.chn: 供参考（for your information 的书写形式）
